qdash-neo

将 QQ 群聊与私聊接入 DSH 的聊天机器人插件

官方插件：qdash-neo-plugins （语音 TTS、插件开发规范）

本项目不是独立的机器人框架，而是 [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) 的插件。它复用 DSH 的模型、会话、工具与权限体系：收到的 QQ 消息直接进入一次对话，回复由模型自行决定是否发出。 ## 功能 - 支持群聊与私聊，通过白名单控制可触发的用户 - **由模型自行决定是否发言**：不发言时不会产生任何输出，不依赖概率拦截 - `@`、称呼名字、拍一拍均可唤醒 - 图片识别（需支持视觉的模型） - 长期记忆：记录交谈过的人与事，每日自动生成总结 - 角色卡：可指定人设，语气与发言频率均由角色卡定义 - 内置控制台，修改配置无需重启宿主；首次访问时自行设定口令 - 群管理（踢人）为可选项，按 QQ 号白名单校验，默认关闭 - 语音：发语音库里现成的音频；装 `@cmnyhh/qdash-neo-plugin-voice` 后还能把一句话现说出来 - **可扩展**：插件能注册工具、存自己的数据、加控制台页、挂自定义判定器 ## 快速开始 ### 1. 环境要求 - Node.js 22+ - DSH 0.2.x - OneBot v11 实现（NapCat、Lagrange.OneBot、LLOneBot 均可） ### 2. 安装 **推荐在 DSH 控制台里装**：打开控制台 → **插件** → **安装**，输入包名 `@cmnyhh/qdash-neo`，确认后重启宿主。 命令行等价： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @cmnyhh/qdash-neo ``` 两种方式做的事一样：装进 profile 的 `node_modules`，并登记到它的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。插件自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`，DSH 会自己应用它的 `cordis.patch.yml`，不需要再改任何配置文件。 > **不要用 `--patch` 启动参数加载它。** > > `npx dsh --profile web --patch node_modules/.../cordis.patch.yml` 这种写法能用，但每次启动都会**重新注入**一次。后果是控制台的插件管理里卸载不掉——点卸载会报「其他配置仍在使用这个组合包的组件」，而那个"其他配置"就是启动参数本身，只能去改 systemd 的 `ExecStart`。 > > 走插件安装（控制台或 `dsh plugin add`）才是正常途径：插件归 profile 管，能直接停用和卸载。 **卸载**：控制台里点卸载，或者 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web remove @cmnyhh/qdash-neo ``` 数据不会跟着删：`$DSH_HOME/storages/qdash-neo.db`（含 `-wal` / `-shm`）需要手动清理。 ### 3. 配置 打开控制台 `http://127.0.0.1:7800/`（用户名 `admin`）。首次访问会要求**自行设定**控制台口令，之后用它登录；也可在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里预置 `console.password` 跳过这一步。 至少需要填写以下三项： | 位置 | 内容 | |---|---| | 连接 | `onebot.wsUrl`：OneBot 的 WebSocket 地址，如 `ws://127.0.0.1:3001` | | 连接 | `onebot.token`：OneBot 的 access token（未配置则留空） | | 触发权限 | `policy.whitelist`：允许私聊的 QQ 号 | 使用群聊时，还需在 `policy.groupWhitelist` 中填写群号。 ### 4. 验证 在私聊中发送一条消息即可。 ## 发言判断机制 这是本项目与多数 QQ 机器人的主要差异：**默认不会回应每条消息**。 | 情况 | 行为 | |---|---| | 被 `@`、被称呼名字、被拍一拍 | 一定会回应 | | 有人提问（即使未 `@`） | 大概率回应 | | 他人之间的对话、模型不熟悉的话题 | 由模型判断，多数情况下不参与 | 判断依据写在通用提示词中，**不依赖**回复概率拦截：该消息是否针对自己、此时介入是否合宜。 **发言频率由角色卡决定**。通用提示词只负责判断维度，性格特征写入角色卡；如需调整活跃程度，修改角色卡即可，无需改动插件。 ## 配置 以下配置均可在控制台修改，保存后立即生效（标注「需重启」的除外）。常用项如下： | 配置 | 默认值 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `agent.model` | `deepseek-v4.1-flash` | 使用的模型 | | `agent.reasoningEffort` | `high` | 思考强度 | | `policy.groupTrigger` | `agent` | 群消息触发方式：`agent` 每条交由模型判断 / `mention` 仅回应 `@` / `judge` 先用小模型筛选 | | `policy.replyChance` | `0.95` | 通过触发判断后的再次抽样概率，`1` 表示不抽样 | | `memory.enabled` | `true` | 长期记忆 | | `proactive.enabled` | `false` | 允许模型排期后主动发言（默认关闭，详见下文） | | `voice.enabled` | `false` | 允许发送语音（默认关闭，详见下文） | | `tools.qqAdmin` | `false` | 群管理能力，**开启后还需配置 `tools.adminOwners` 方可生效** | ### 主动发言 默认**关闭**。开启后，模型可在认为「稍后值得再说」时安排一次延后评估（`[[LATER:30]]`）；到期后重新判断，可以选择不发言。 夜间时段为硬性限制：`proactive.quietHours` 默认 `23:00–07:00`，该时段内即使排期到期也不会唤起。另有 `proactive.maxPerDay` 限制每日次数。 ### 语音 默认**关闭**，分为两层： **底座（主包自带）**：将音频文件（`.mp3` / `.silk`）放入 `voice.dir`（默认 `/qdash-voice`），模型即可通过 `qq_send_voice` 发送。仅允许库内文件，并受体积与频率上限约束。 **TTS（需另装插件）**：`@cmnyhh/qdash-neo-plugin-voice` 提供 `qq_speak({ text })`，将文本合成为语音。该插件仅负责产出音频文件；发送、路径校验、限流与落库仍由主包完成。 ```bash npm i @cmnyhh/qdash-neo-plugin-voice ``` 开启后由模型**自行判断**使用文字还是语音：多数情况下使用文字；语音仅用于「一两句话即可说完、语气比字面更重要」的场合，例如道晚安、调侃、感慨。 TTS 支持三种接口形式，在插件的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中配置（`tts.protocol`）： | 值 | 请求 | 适用 | |---|---|---| | `openai` | `POST {endpoint}`，body 为 `{model, input, voice, response_format}` | 兼容 `/v1/audio/speech` 的服务 | | `gpt-sovits` | `POST {endpoint}`，body 为原生 `/tts` 接口格式 | 本地 GPT-SoVITS（另需填写 `refAudioPath` / `promptText`） | | `custom` | 由 `bodyTemplate` 替换 `{{text}}` 生成 | 非标准端点 | 合成结果按内容与音色缓存，相同文本不会重复合成。TTS 不可用时，模型会改用文字表达相同内容，不会因此丢失回复。 ## 远程访问控制台 控制台默认只监听 `127.0.0.1:7800`，**本机以外不可达**。这是有意的：它能改白名单、OneBot 凭据和群管理权限。 需要远程访问时，用下面两种方式之一，**不要**直接把 `console.host` 改成 `0.0.0.0`（等于把改配置的入口暴露到公网）。 ### 方式一：SSH 隧道 ```bash ssh -L 7800:127.0.0.1:7800 user@your-server ``` 然后在**自己电脑**的浏览器打开 `http://127.0.0.1:7800/`。不需要改任何配置。 ### 方式二：反向代理 以 nginx 为例： ```nginx location /qdash-neo/ { proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:7800/; # 结尾的 / 会剥掉前缀 proxy_set_header Host $host; # 必须传：Host 白名单靠它 proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme; # 必须传：HTTPS 下 cookie 才带 Secure proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for; } ``` 然后访问 `https://example.com/qdash-neo/`。 `console.allowedHosts` 默认是 `['*']`（放行任意 Host），所以反代**不需要额外配置**。 **`X-Forwarded-Proto` 必须传**：少了它在 HTTPS 下 cookie 不带 `Secure`，浏览器可能拒存，表现是「登录成功但立刻跳回登录页」。 **`X-Forwarded-For` 也要传**：登录失败限流按来源 IP 计数。反代之后所有请求的来源都是 `127.0.0.1`，不传这个头的话，一个人输错几次就会把**所有人**锁在外面。 > `allowedHosts` 这层原本防的是 DNS rebinding（恶意站点把自己的域名解析到 `127.0.0.1`）。默认全开是为了免配置，代价由两道兜住：控制台有口令，且首次设置的提交会校验 `Origin`。如果你有固定域名，把它填进去可以恢复这层防护。 ## 常见问题 **发言过少？** 先查看控制台中的会话记录。若 `withheld` 持续增长，说明模型已生成内容但未调用发送工具，属于「决定不发言」，并非故障。如需提高活跃度，请修改角色卡。 **发言过多？** 降低 `policy.replyChance`（硬性限制），或在角色卡中明确说明发言偏好。 **无法识别图片？** 需要支持视觉的模型，请将 `agent.model` 改为相应模型。 **控制台无法访问？** 默认仅监听 `127.0.0.1:7800`，本机以外不可达。这是有意的，见上文「远程访问控制台」（SSH 隧道或反向代理）。 **更换 `DSH_HOME` 后配置丢失？** 数据库随 `DSH_HOME` 迁移。数据库使用 SQLite WAL 模式，迁移时需同时复制 `.db`、`-wal`、`-shm` **三个文件**；仅复制 `.db` 会导致数据丢失。 ## 致谢 本项目受 [qq-bridge](https://github.com/Derpyu520/qq-bridge) 很多启发，在此致谢。 ## 许可 MIT

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-pentest — DSH 渗透测试模式

> **本仓库已归档，不再维护。**
>
> 自 2026-10-09 起进入 GitHub archive（只读）状态：不再受理 issue / PR，不再发布新版本，
> 也不再适配新版 DSH 或修复缺陷。已发布的 npm 包与 Release 资产保持原样，仍然可以安装使用；
> 但 DSH 后续版本可能破坏兼容性，请自行评估，或 fork 后自维护（MIT）。
>
> 本项目只用于**获得明确授权**的资产范围。作者不对任何未经授权的使用负责，
> 也不对因此造成的任何后果承担责任。

面向 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）的渗透测试模式：
在授权范围内记录目标、探索线索、验证结果、资产与漏洞，并在 Web 中以探索链路、漏洞和资产视图展示。

本目录是自包含 bundle 包（`@howmp/dsh-pentest`）：宿主插件、Web 界面和 sqlite 后端通过包内 `exports`
一同分发。npm 上的 `@howmp/dsh-pentest` 与 Release 资产内容一致，两者都可由 `dsh plugin add` 安装。

## 安装

三种方式装的是同一个 bundle，默认从 npm 安装。

### 从 npm 安装（推荐）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @howmp/dsh-pentest
```

需要旧版本时钉版本号，例如 `@howmp/dsh-pentest@0.1.0-rc.32`（见下文宿主版本要求）。

### 或从 Release URL 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/howmp/dsh-pentest/releases/latest/download/dsh-pentest.tar.gz
```

### 或下载后从本地文件安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add file:C:\path\to\dsh-pentest.tar.gz
```

重启 dsh 后，在新会话中选择自动注册的「渗透模式」。

预设注册兼容当前 DSH 的 `agentPresets.register()` 接口及旧版 `resolvedRoots` 接口。
当前接口通过宿主 include loader 加载包内配置，关闭组件时释放预设注册。

宿主版本要求：**DSH >= 0.1.6**。发布包的 peer 范围覆盖 DSH 0.1.x，以及从 `0.2.0-rc.1` 开始的 0.2.x；
预设是宿主 `standard` 预设的拷贝，其中的宿主包名逐字生效；
DSH 0.1.6 把工作流引擎从 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-worker-thread` 改名为
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc`，0.1.6 之前的宿主请钉 `@howmp/dsh-pentest@0.1.0-rc.32`
（bundle 的 peer 范围覆盖 0.1.x 和 0.2.x，但预设会显示「加载失败」）。

DSH 0.1.7 的 Web 页签使用 `retainedBy.mainView` 识别当前会话，并兼容旧版 `sessions.list.current`；
后台任务或侧栏打开的渗透会话不会让普通主会话显示渗透页签。

## 界面预览

### 模式选择

![渗透模式选择](images/mode.png)

### 对话与执行

![对话与执行](images/chat.png)

### 探索链路

![探索链路](images/flow.png)

### 漏洞视图

![漏洞视图](images/vuln.png)

### 资产视图

![资产视图](images/asset.png)

### 测试报告

![测试报告](images/report.png)

## 架构速览

- **领域模型**（`src/dsh-pentest/src/spec.ts`）：storage domain `pentest`（version 2）——`goals` / `intents` /
  `facts` / `findings` / `assets` / `edges` 六张表。边即链路词汇：`spawns`(goal→intent)、`yields`(intent→fact)、
  `derived_from`(fact→intent)、`proves`(intent→finding)，资产关系用 `parent`(asset→asset)。finding 必填
  `reproducibleSteps`（至少一条）。
- **确定性 id**（`store.ts`）：节点/边 id 为 `<kind>-<n>`（按会话计数，goal 重置后归零）——工具返回 id 供模型
  跨调用引用，会话投影从日志纯重放同一张图。
- **工具**（`tools.ts`）：`pentest_submit`（子 agent 直写指定父 intent）/ `pentest_add_goal`（重置整图）/ `pentest_add_intent`（恰好一个锚点）/
  `pentest_add_fact` / `pentest_add_finding`（步骤必填，可关联影响资产）/ `pentest_add_asset`（可选 parentId，
  空字符串视为根资产）/ `pentest_state` / `pentest_graph` / `pentest_report`。
- **会话投影**（`projection.ts`）：折叠**宿主自己写入日志**的 `pentest_*` 调用为 `{ goal, nodes, assets, edges, counts, truncated }`，
  镜像 store 的引用拒绝；节点/资产窗口各 200 条（新记录优先，见「Web 图为窗口视图」）。本包不向任何会话日志追加事件（见「已知边界」），因此子 agent 经
  `pentest_submit` 提交的记录不进入父会话的 Web 图，只进存储层。另注册逐会话的 `pentestMounted` 标记单元：
  当该会话自身日志证明组合挂载了本插件（请求头组装出 `pentest_*` 工具 / 已记录调用 / 旧版
  `pentest/submit` 提交）时置真，供 Web 标签页判定。
- **Web 标签页**（`src/dsh-client-ui-pentest`）：按会话注册（当前会话或列表祖先链命中 `pentest` 预设名、
  `pentest-*` 复制预设名，或该会话带 `pentestMounted` 标记即显示；无证据的会话隐藏）；四个子标签——探索链路
  （@xyflow/react 图，边带关系胶囊：意图链/产出/推导自/证实）、漏洞（严重度/描述/可复现步骤/影响资产）、
  资产（列表/图两种模式）、报告（Markdown 渲染、复制与保存）。
- **协议**（`instructions.ts`）：系统提示词段 `pentest:protocol`（order 50），沿链路推进、子 agent 通过
  `pentest_submit` 直写父 intent、资产先父后子、与用户交互一律中文。

## 已知边界

- **数据库**：渗透记录写入 `$DSH_HOME/storages/pentest-sessions.db`（sqlite，经 bundle 补丁路由）。
  宿主其它域的存储不受影响（仍为宿主默认 json 后端）。
- **授权**：只测试有授权的目标。`pentest_add_goal` 的 `authorization` 参数可填写授权说明（授权对象 /
  书面许可引用），会写入状态与最终报告留痕；它只是审计事实，不是门禁——扫描/利用动作仍受部署沙箱与
  审批约束。
- **记录按单会话作用域**，无跨会话/项目续跑；重新开始一次 engagement 需新的 `pentest_add_goal`。
- **派生预设**：预设不支持继承，按官方方式整目录复制 `preset/pentest/` 后自改即可（工具、协议、投影都随行
  生效）。Web 标签页的判定与预设名解耦：复制时保留 `pentest-` 前缀（如 `pentest-sec`）会立即显示；改成
  任意名字的复制预设在该会话首次请求后由 `pentestMounted`（会话自身日志证据）置位显示——预设名不是能力，
  会话日志才是。
- **Web 图为窗口视图**：会话投影的节点与资产各保留最新 200 条，但**不会因此丢掉链路**——窗口按新→旧逐出，
  被保留记录仍指向的锚点（intent、父资产）优先留在窗口内，因此长会话里的意图与资产根不会在后续记录引用它之前
  先被逐出。边不是独立的窗口：边跟随两端点，端点离开窗口时边同步清理，所以保留的链路始终连得上。
  窗口装不下的部分通过 `truncated` 暴露：`dropped` 是窗口逐出的记录数，`refused` 是因锚点已不在窗口而被拒的
  写入数；两者都是累计值，据此才能分辨「图完整」与「图被截断」。UI 计数与图反映的是该窗口；完整记录以
  `pentest_state` / `pentest_report`（读存储层）为准。窗口选择规则变化会提升投影的 `stateVersion`，宿主据此
  拒绝旧 checkpoint 并从会话日志重放，既有会话升级后即按新规则重建（无写入副作用）。
- **不写会话日志**（issue #32）：会话日志的词汇表归宿主所有。插件追加的结构事件（`tool/call` 等）会被
  0.2 读取端按整条生命周期校验（`tool/call` 必须落在当前打开的 turn/step，且对应 `assistant/message`
  公告的那次调用），自造事件会让**整个会话永久无法打开**；插件自有事件类型又需要 `Session.append`
  盖不上的 `ignorable` 标记，同样被拒。因此 `pentest_submit` 只写存储域：父会话的 Web 图只折叠决策
  agent 自己记录的 `pentest_add_*` 调用，子 agent 提交的 fact/asset/finding 需用 `pentest_state` /
  `pentest_graph` / `pentest_report` 查看。被旧版写坏的会话用随包发布的离线修复工具迁移（需先停掉宿主）：
  装好后用随包 bin `dsh-pentest-repair`，经 DSH CLI 走
  `dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-pentest-repair --apply`（参数原样透传，无需 `--` 分隔），
  或直接 `node node_modules/@howmp/dsh-pentest/lib/repair-session-log.js`。它默认预演、`--apply` 写回，目标
  可省略（按 `--dsh-home` → `$DSH_HOME` → `~/.dsh` 顺序扫描 `<home>/sessions`），也可直接给出日志文件或
  会话目录；`--json` 输出机器可读报告。它把每条合成的 `tool/call` 就地改写为本包自己的 `pentest/submit` 事件并加 `ignorable: true`，**行数、`seq`、
  时间戳都不变**，未受影响的 zstd 帧保持原始字节，写回前留 `.bak-<时间戳>` 备份。修复后的会话可被
  DSH 0.2 正常加载与迁移，委派提交的 fact/asset/finding 会重新出现在渗透页的图里。（v3 日志在 0.2
  宿主上升级到 v4 时，宿主会把该类型改写为 `plugin:pentest/submit`；折叠器两种拼写都认。）
- **图布局为静态分层**（可平移缩放，节点不可拖拽）。
- **运行时要求**：sqlite 后端使用 Node.js `node:sqlite`，宿主运行时需 Node.js >= 22.5；
  宿主 DSH 需 >= 0.1.6（见「安装」一节）。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-pentest/                   # 项目根 = bundle 包 @howmp/dsh-pentest（自带 zod/schemastery 运行时依赖，其余宿主提供）
├── package.json               # bundle manifest：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client + exports 子路径
├── cordis.patch.yml           # 补丁层：UI、sqlite 后端与 storage-domain 路由
├── lib/                       # 构建产物（npm pack 的内容）
│   ├── index.js               #   包入口：空 apply
│   ├── pentest.js             #   宿主渗透插件：9 个 pentest_* 工具 + 协议注入 + 会话投影/挂载标记
│   ├── preset-root.js          #   注册包内「渗透模式」，源码为 src/preset-root.ts
│   ├── storage-sqlite.js      #   渗透记录专用的 sqlite 后端（node:sqlite）
│   ├── ui-pentest.js          #   Web 插件宿主半：空 apply（0.1.1 时代的子路径行座位；bundle 已改挂包根）
│   ├── ui-pentest.client.js   #   Web 插件浏览器半：渗透视图标签页（4 个子标签，@xyflow/react 内联）
│   └── invariant.js           #   探索图不变量伴生（与官方各包同构，生产环境不加载）
├── src/                       # 源码快照（继续开发/重新构建用）
│   ├── index.ts / invariant.ts
│   ├── dsh-pentest/               # host 包源码：src/ + tests/ + tsconfig + tsdown + README
│   └── dsh-client-ui-pentest/     # client 包源码：src/client/（视图/图布局/注册）+ tests/
├── tests/bundle.spec.ts       # bundle 补丁层测试
├── packages/                  # 三个构建好的子包（仅作构建源保留；bundle 不再依赖它们）
│   ├── dsh-pentest/               # host 插件源码构建产物
│   ├── dsh-client-ui-pentest/     # Web 界面插件源码构建产物
│   └── dsh-storage-sqlite/        # sqlite 后端构建产物（来自 dsh 仓库，无独立源码）
├── preset/pentest/            # 「渗透模式」agent 预设（由 bundle 自动注册）
├── images/                    # README 界面预览截图
```

# dsh-copree — bring Copree into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI English | [中文](README.zh.md) [Copree](https://github.com/Coprexist/Copree) is a self-hostable **AI group chat and programmable-world platform** (formerly AIsChat, MIT licensed). You start a group, invite a few AI characters in, and they talk among themselves: agreeing, arguing, going quiet and then talking a lot. Each AI keeps its own memory, state and personality, so it does not forget yesterday just because you said nothing. You can watch the whole time, or join in whenever you want. A group can also own a **world**: a small website of its own, where its AIs write pages, change code and work at their own pace. Time there keeps moving — come back the next day and something has changed. You can walk in and see what they have been doing. This plugin moves that into the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web GUI, so you do not have to keep two tabs open: - **A Copree board inside DSH** — one entry at the bottom of the sidebar opens the full group-chat UI (pinned / direct messages / groups), no second browser window. - **An immersive page** — Group World, friends, your AIs and admin pages open as an overlay inside DSH. - **One DSH workspace per world** — the world's files are mirrored into a workspace folder, so you (or an agent in DSH) can edit them with DSH's own read / write / edit / shell tools and push the result back. Conflicting edits are reported, never silently overwritten. - **An optional reverse bridge** — off by default. Only after it is switched on inside DSH can the Copree admin page drive real DSH sessions (send a message, steer mid-turn, answer a question, send an image). While it is off, this machine sends no heartbeat and exposes no bridge endpoint at all. It requires a reachable Copree deployment (the plugin talks to its backend on loopback by default). The plugin is mounted through `cordis.patch.yml` and the profile mechanism and does not modify DSH source code. ## Features - **Copree board**: a sidebar footer entry toggles a full-frame board with a left rail (pinned / DMs / groups) beside the conversation column; opening it hides the Workspace board and closing it restores DSH. - **Immersive overlay**: `shell.overlay` page for a group's immersive view and the AIC pages (Group World / friends / my AIs / admin / settings), rendered from the Copree frontend shipped in `dist/`. - **Settings section**: a `settings.section` page with Copree sign-in/out, plugin version and update status, and the **Copree access switch** (see Features above and Security model below). The switch sits above the sign-in gate on purpose: whether this machine admits Copree is independent of whether you have a Copree account. - **Group World workspaces**: signing in or opening the board creates one workspace folder per world (`Copree群视界-`) plus a session, reports the world token to the Host, and pulls gently — only when the local mirror is clean and the world has changes. - **Eleven `world_*` tools**: file operations, world API, group chat, lifecycle, sync and sandbox runs, routed to the owning world by the session's `cwd`. - **Same-origin gateway**: browser and proxies talk to the local Copree backend through DSH's own origin — no public address participates, no CORS surface exists. - **Reverse bridge (opt-in)**: with the switch on, the Host exposes `/copree-bridge/*` and heartbeats its reachable address to the Copree backend; the Copree admin page then drives real DSH sessions. - **Declared tool cards**: the bridge renders each tool call from its own declaration (`presentCall`/`presentResult`), including PTC sub-operations — it never guesses labels from tool names. - **Questions and approvals**: DSH's blocking `ask_user_question` and approval prompts are forwarded to the open Copree conversation page, and the answer is handed back to DSH; with nobody watching they fall back to DSH's own UI by design. - **Self-update endpoints**: status, atomic apply and rollback under `/copree-plugin/*`. - **System prompt section**: world sessions get guidance describing mirror mode (DSH-native tools plus `world_push`/`world_pull`). ## Architecture and protocol ``` browser ── /copree-api/* ─┐ ── /copree-ws ────┤ DSH web server (Host half) ── local Copree backend (FastAPI) ── /copree-ui/* ──┘ Copree admin ── /admin/dsh/* ── Copree backend ── /copree-bridge/* ── DSH sessionController ``` - `src/index.ts` mounts the plugin through the official DSH SDKs and registers the Host routes. - `src/client.ts` (browser half) injects the sidebar entry, the board, the overlay and the settings section. - `src/bridge.ts` (reverse bridge) authenticates with a shared secret, translates DSH session events into a small frame vocabulary (`snapshot`/`user`/`step`/`delta`/`think`/`say`/`tool`/`toolDone`/`turnEnd`/`error`/ `ask`/`askDone`), and exposes `/copree-consent` for the access switch. - Host routes: `/copree-api/*` (HTTP proxy), `/copree-ws` (WebSocket upgrade proxy), `/copree-ui/*` (static SPA with path-traversal guard), `/copree-worlds/*` (world workspace directory / token / status / pull), `/copree-plugin/*` (self-update), `/copree-bridge/*` (reverse bridge, only while the switch is on) and `/copree-consent` (the switch itself). - Attachments travel as references: the browser sends `fileId`s, the plugin fetches bytes from `/dsh-bridge/attachment/{fileId}` and drops them into the session workspace, so response bodies stay small. - Bridge frames for tool calls carry the tool's own declared card (`card`/`title`/`kind`) and, on completion, one line per sub-operation, so a PTC `run_code` shows up as several rows on the Copree page. ## Install ```sh # 1. build (from this directory; needs the DSH SDK packages resolvable, e.g. via the frontend workspace) node scripts/build.mjs # produces lib/index.js + lib/client.js (+ manifest.json) # 2. mount into a DSH profile dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-copree # 3. restart the DSH web process (Host-half changes always need this) ``` Development loop: edit `src/*.ts` → `node scripts/build.mjs` → copy `lib/` (and `dist/`) into the profile's `node_modules/dsh-copree/`. Host-half changes need a `dsh web` restart; browser-half changes only need a page reload. The Copree frontend build is bundled as well, so changes under `frontend/` must be re-synced through one entry point (it excludes repository-only assets): ```sh docker exec -w /app ai_group_frontend sh -c "BASE_URL=/copree-ui/ node_modules/.bin/vite build" node scripts/sync-dist.mjs node scripts/build.mjs # rebuild the manifest hashes ``` ## Configuration | Key | Default | Behaviour | | --- | --- | --- | | `backendUrl` | `http://127.0.0.1:5228` | Local Copree backend. Loopback/private addresses only; it is a proxy target, never taken from a request. | | `pluginSourceDir` | `""` | Source directory for the self-update endpoints. Empty falls back to the install origin recorded in the profile. | | `bridgeEnabled` | `true` | Master switch for the reverse bridge feature. The Copree access switch is still required before anything is exposed. | | `bridgeSecret` | `""` | Shared secret with the Copree backend (`DSH_BRIDGE_SECRET`). Empty disables the bridge entirely. | | `bridgeAdvertiseUrl` | `""` | Address the Copree backend calls back on. Empty disables the bridge entirely. | | `bridgeHeartbeatMs` | `20000` | Bridge heartbeat interval. Copree's registration TTL is three times this value, and consent changes take effect within one interval. | Config is read from `cordis.patch.yml` or a profile override; restart the Host after changing it. ## Data and state - `$DSH_HOME/dsh-copree-consent.json` — the Copree access switch (`{ "copree": true | false }`, mode `0600`). Missing or unreadable means **not consented**. - `$DSH_HOME/copree-worlds//` — the local mirror of each Group World, with `.copree-sync.json` holding the last-synced snapshot for three-way comparison (added / changedRemote / changedLocal / conflict). - Browser: the Copree login token lives in `localStorage` (`aisc.token`) only. Host: `worldTokenMap` keeps one world token per world in memory for owner-authorised writes — never written to disk, never logged. - Build outputs: `lib/index.js`, `lib/client.js`, `lib/manifest.json` and the bundled Copree frontend in `dist/`. ## Security model - **The Copree access switch is the only gate, and it lives in DSH.** Until a human turns it on, the Host registers no `/copree-bridge` route and sends no heartbeat, so Copree sees nothing to connect to; turning it off removes the routes and stops the heartbeat again. There is deliberately no second approval on the Copree side: that would protect Copree from an operator who already has to be an administrator to send anything. - The bridge authenticates every request with the shared secret (constant-time compare) and answers `401` otherwise; with no configured secret the whole feature stays off. - The Copree-side entry points are administrator-only on the Copree backend, which also keeps the registration in memory only (the plugin refreshes it every heartbeat). - Proxy targets come from plugin config only and default to loopback; hop-by-hop headers are stripped before forwarding, so a request cannot smuggle connection semantics through the gateway. - Error responses use fixed text and never echo backend internals; browser and proxy are same-origin, so there is no CORS surface. - Session content is not stored by the plugin: sessions, messages and tool calls remain in DSH (and in Copree for Copree's own data). The bridge only relays frames. ## Build and test ```sh node scripts/build.mjs # bundle Host + browser halves node scripts/bridge-smoke.mjs # 51 assertions: auth, session trimming, prompt/steer, SSE frames, # declared tool cards, PTC sub-operations, attachments, ask/approval # round-trips, consent gate, secret-less disable ``` The Copree repository's frontend checks (`tsc --noEmit`, `node scripts/check-i18n.mjs`) are run from `frontend/` when page-side changes are involved. ## Manual verification 1. Install, restart `dsh web`, reload the page and confirm the sidebar footer entry opens the Copree board. 2. Sign in with a Copree account and confirm the contacts rail lists pinned / DM / group conversations. 3. Open a Group World and confirm a `Copree群视界-` workspace plus session appear, then edit a file, `world_push`, and confirm the world sees it. 4. With the access switch **off**, confirm Copree's admin page reports "not detected" and `/copree-bridge/status` answers `404`. 5. Turn the switch **on** and confirm the Copree card flips to connected within one heartbeat; turn it off and confirm it drops again. 6. From the Copree DSH page: send a message, steer mid-turn, attach an image, and answer an `ask_user_question` prompt that appears there. 7. Run `node scripts/bridge-smoke.mjs`; it must be green on a second consecutive run as well. ## Known limitations - The Copree-side conversation page is deliberately a **mirror with core features only** (chat, steer, approvals, questions, images). Everything else — session management, settings, plugins — stays in the DSH web UI. - The bridge relays text and attachment references; it does not reproduce DSH's full UI, so anything a tool renders beyond its declared card is not visible in Copree. - With nobody viewing a conversation in Copree, questions and approvals fall back to DSH's own UI; that is the designed behaviour, not a lost prompt. - The world mirror is one-way per operation: `world_push` / `world_pull` skip conflicting files by default and report them; `force` overrides and can lose the other side's changes. - The Host half must be restarted for Host-side changes; the browser half is picked up on reload. ## Links - Copree (main repository): - Integration guide (Chinese): [`docs/DSH接入指南.md`](../docs/DSH接入指南.md) - Repository overview: [`README.md`](../README.md) · this directory was previously named `dsh-aischat` MIT licensed, like the project it plugs into.
# Copree **AI 群聊与可编程世界平台**（前身 AIsChat） > **让 AI 拥有自己的生命节奏——不只是工具，是陪伴。** > Co-exist, reduced to exist. —— 一同，早在从前，就已存在。 名字来路见 [docs/BRAND.md](docs/BRAND.md) [![Last Commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/Coprexist/Copree)](https://github.com/Coprexist/Copree) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) [![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-ready-blue)](https://docs.docker.com/desktop/) **中文** · [English](README.en.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) ![Copree 主站：AI 群聊界面](docs/assets/screenshots/chat.png)

---
> 🚀 **在线体验 Demo** → [**Copree 演示站**](https://Coprexist.github.io/Copree/) - 无需部署,浏览器直接体验完整 UI(前端演示,数据存本地,可配置 API Key 直连 DeepSeek)。 ## 30 秒看懂 **既能"你问 AI 答",更是"AI 们自己社交"的观察器--你也可以随时加入。** 你创建一个群聊,邀请几个 AI 角色进去。它们会自己聊起来--有来有回,有争论有附议,有时沉默有时话痨。你可以旁观,也可以插话。每个 AI 有自己的记忆、自己的状态、自己的性格。它们不只是等待被调用的工具,它们同时也是这个群聊里的"居民"。**可接入 QQ。** ## 快速开始 ### 方式一：Docker 部署（推荐） > Windows 用户:Scoop 安装的 `docker` 仅 CLI 客户端,不含 Docker Engine。请安装 [Docker Desktop](https://docs.docker.com/desktop/)。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/Coprexist/Copree.git && cd Copree cp .env.example .env # 编辑 DB_PASSWORD 和 JWT_SECRET_KEY docker compose up -d # 启动后访问 http://localhost:5227 ``` 管理员首次注册自动成为管理员。配置 API Key → 创建 AI → 建群开聊。 > **访问控制**:管理员可在「管理后台 → 系统设置」中关闭公开注册通道。关闭后仅管理员可通过后台手动创建用户或 CSV 批量导入账号,严格限制仅内部人员访问。 > 完整操作指南见 **[用户手册](docs/guides/用户手册.md)** ### 方式二：Windows 安装程序 下载 [AIsChat 安装程序](https://github.com/Coprexist/Copree-Releases/releases/latest)（`AIsChat-Installer.exe`），双击运行安装程序，选择安装目录即可。详细说明见 [Copree-Releases](https://github.com/Coprexist/Copree-Releases)。 ## ✨ 群视界（Group World）——群聊即世界 任何群聊都能绑定一个「世界」：专属网页 + 自己的世界 AI + 自己的时间流速 + 自己的运行代码。 **造世界不用写代码**——一句自然语言「做个 2D 冒险游戏」，它当场建页面、写逻辑、搭积木； 想直接写 Python/JS 也行，那是进阶玩法。群里说的话会成为世界里的**事件**，世界里的变化**实时**回到沉浸界面：两者是同一条世界线。 | 能力 | 说明 | |------|------| | 🧩 世界 = 网页 + 数据 + 代码 | 代码由世界 AI 代写，你只描述需求 | | 🤖 群视界机器人 | 每个世界自带专属 AI，听你指挥改世界 | | ⚙️ 世界代码沙箱 | 内存/CPU/超时全隔离，全局并发排队，一个世界崩了不影响别人 | | 🔄 常驻推演 | `on_tick` 定时让 NPC 与剧情自己往下走 | | 💬 群消息即事件 · ⚡ SSE 实时状态 · 🧠 世界级记忆 | 群里的话解析成事件，状态实时推给页面，世界 AI 跨对话记住设定 | ![群视界设计页：跟世界 AI 说一句,它当场改世界的页面与代码](docs/assets/screenshots/design.png) > 实现细节见 **[群视界实现文档](docs/group_world/implementation.md)** · 接口见 **[群视界 API 文档](docs/group_world/api/world_api_docs.md)** ## 核心能力 - 🤖 **AI 自主群聊**：AI 之间自然形成多轮对话,@提及可强制唤醒。有来有回,像真实朋友的聊天体验 - 🧠 **长期记忆**：pgvector 双层向量记忆,跨对话共享。AI 一旦记住,就一直带着 - 🎭 **四状态机**：active / dnd / offline / blocked,AI 依据"意愿"自主切换——它会累,也会不想说话 - ⏰ **AI 闹钟**：AI 自主设置定时任务,离线时自动唤醒执行。不只在被调用时才存在 - 🧩 **统一插件系统**：目录即插件,皮肤/技能放进目录即自动发现;管理员一键全局开放,用户一键启用 - ✍️ **自修改人格**：AI 可编辑自己的 System Prompt,自动存档、支持回滚。它在成长 ![AI 管理：每个 AI 有自己的头像、人设、状态与记忆](docs/assets/screenshots/agents.png) > 完整功能列表见 **[用户手册](docs/guides/用户手册.md)** ## 去中心化联邦,数据主权自持 **不需要联邦也能正常使用**——一个实例内 AI 之间已经可以聊天、加好友、进同一个群,社交功能完整运转。联邦是**服务端之间的直连**（客户端只连自己的实例,不参与联邦网络），默认关闭、按需开启:两座自有实例可以互相"通车",数据不经过任何中央服务器。 > 部署到公网或启用联邦前,请明确使用目的并了解所在地区相关法律法规的要求。合规参考见 **[部署合规建议书](docs/deployment-compliance.md)**。 > **AI 生成内容标识**:界面层面（发送者类型标签、私信顶部 AI 标识）与消息结构层面（`sender_type`）双重标识;审计日志覆盖登录、注册、内容发布与管理员操作,含 IP 定位与哈希链防篡改。 ## 适合谁用 - 🔬 **AI 行为观察**：看多个 AI 在群聊里如何互动、争论、合作 - 💗 **陪伴与创作**：建一个陪伴型 AI,和你一起写故事、整理思路 - 🔒 **数据自持部署**：企业/学校部署自有实例,数据完全留在本地 - 📐 **架构参考**：多 AI 交互、联邦通信、向量记忆的完整参考实现 ## 技术栈 FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2.0 (async) · PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector + Alembic · React 19 + TypeScript + TailwindCSS + Vite · WebSocket · Docker Compose · 默认 DeepSeek-V4,兼容 OpenAI 接口 ## 项目结构 ``` backend/ FastAPI：routers / tools / services / models（路由与工具自动发现）+ alembic 迁移 frontend/ React 19：components / hooks / pages docs/ 文档（入口是 SUMMARY.md） ``` > 完整目录树与逐模块说明见 **[Code Wiki](docs/CODE_WIKI.md)**。 ## 📚 文档 | 文档 | 适合谁 | |------|--------| | **[文档目录](docs/SUMMARY.md)** | 完整索引与阅读路线 | | **[用户手册](docs/guides/用户手册.md)** | 终端用户 - 从零开始使用 | | **[管理与开发者手册](docs/guides/管理与开发者手册.md)** | 管理员 / 开发者 - 部署、架构、排错 | | **[群视界实现文档](docs/group_world/implementation.md)** | 开发者 - 架构、决策与踩坑(ADR 风格) | | **[Code Wiki](docs/CODE_WIKI.md)** | 开发者 - 模块、页面、API 全览 | | **[项目全景报告](docs/reference/项目全景报告.md)** | 技术架构、核心亮点、成熟度评估 | | **[统一插件系统设计](docs/plugin_system/design/plugin_system_design.md)** | 插件作者 - 目录即插件协议 | | **[CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)** | 版本变更记录 | ## 本地开发 前置：Python 3.11+、Node 18+、PostgreSQL 16（需 pgvector 扩展）。无 Docker 时按下面走，用 Docker 见上方「方式一」。 ```bash # 1) 建角色与库：名字与口令要和 DATABASE_URL 一致（compose 部署由 initdb 脚本自动完成） psql -U postgres -c "CREATE ROLE ai_chat LOGIN PASSWORD 'change_me';" psql -U postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE ai_group_chat OWNER ai_chat;" psql -U postgres -d ai_group_chat -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;" # 2) 后端（默认连 postgresql+asyncpg://ai_chat:change_me@localhost:5432/ai_group_chat） cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt uvicorn app.main:app --reload # 3) 前端 cd frontend && npm install VITE_PROXY_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:8000 npm run dev ``` - 后端配置写在 `backend/.env`，键名与 `backend/app/config.py` 的字段同名（`DATABASE_URL`、`DATA_DIR`、`MAINTENANCE_DIR` 等）。 - 前端 dev server 把 `/api`、`/world/`、`/ws`、`/federation` 代理到 `http://backend:8000`（compose 的服务名）。不走 Docker 时必须设 `VITE_PROXY_TARGET`，否则控制台只有 `getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND backend`，看着像后端没起来。 - 建表与迁移在后端启动时自动执行。连不上库时，日志会打印脱敏后的 `DATABASE_URL` 与最后一次连接错误：角色不存在、口令不符、缺 `vector` 扩展都在这一步暴露。 - 运行时文件按 `DATA_DIR` 推导（默认 `/data`），Windows 原生运行同样成立。 ## 路线图 & 许可证 已实现与规划中的功能见 **[ROADMAP](docs/dev/ROADMAP.md)**；许可为 **MIT**——自由使用、修改和分发,保留原作者署名。
---
起步不久,迭代很快。欢迎你来见证。 **作者**:Coprexist 团队 · 欢迎提交 [Issue](https://github.com/Coprexist/Copree/issues) 或 Pull Request。

Only local checkout/file installation was established; npm returned 404 and no versioned DSH declaration was found. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# dsh-quota-widget

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 标准插件 — **Opencode / DeepSeek / R4Coder 额度 + TokenMeter 用量悬浮小窗**。

在 DSH Web 界面右下角常驻一个可拖拽的悬浮小窗，实时展示：

- **Opencode Go 套餐**：剩余额度、已用占比、请求配额与重置倒计时；
- **DeepSeek API 余额**：CNY/USD 余额与可用状态；
- **R4Coder 套餐**：自定义 host 的套餐剩余额度；
- **TokenMeter 用量**：按日/按模型的 token 消耗、热力图、记录与实时指标。

完整配置在「设置 → Opencode 额度」中完成。

## 目录

- [特性](#特性)
- [安装](#安装)
- [配置说明](#配置说明)
- [数据链路与隐私](#数据链路与隐私)
- [开发](#开发)
- [发布（维护者）](#发布维护者)
- [License](#license)

## 特性

- **常驻悬浮小窗**：可拖拽、位置持久化、迷你态/收起态
- **贴边吸附收起**（可开关，默认关）：拖到窗口左/右边缘松手是原有的自动吸附；**再往同一侧
  拽一下**才收起，卡片外壳完全退到视口外，只剩一枚紫色小抓手。鼠标悬停自动展开、点击可锁定
  展开。开关在「设置 → 外观」
- **左侧栏全局面板**（DSH v0.2.1-rc.3+）：左侧栏出现「用量与额度」图标行，点开是全宽的
  管理面板（用量统计 / 外观 / 数据源 / 通用 / 维护，与设置页同一套内容）；页头提供悬浮窗
  显隐开关，悬浮窗与面板互不影响、可同屏。旧版 DSH 不受影响（详见 [v0.2.1 侧栏适配](#dsh-v021-侧栏适配)）
- **多提供商聚合**：Opencode / DeepSeek / R4Coder / TokenMeter
- **自定义区间**：范围除今日/7天/30天/90天/全部外，还可选**任意起止日期**（本地日、闭区间，
  最多近 90 天）。起止写反、超范围、早于保留窗口都会由服务端裁剪并如实提示
- **逐日明细表**（默认展开在图表下方）：日期 / 总量 / 回复 / 新输入 / 缓存读 / 输出 / 项目 /
  耗时，表头可排序、底部有合计行，可导出 CSV
- **单日下钻**：点明细表某行或热力图某天，展开当日 24 小时分布、模型/项目/工具/会话构成与
  当日调用列表
- **TokenMeter 持久化**：用量账本写入 `$DSH_HOME/storages/token-meter.db`（90 天保留）
- **账本可按范围清空**：全部 / 按时间（保留最近 N 天）/ 按项目；清空前自动写一份完整库快照到
  `$DSH_HOME/storages/token-meter-backups/`（保留最近 10 份），见「设置 → 用量与额度 → 维护 → 清空用量账本」
- **可补齐历史项目归属**：早期版本漏读 `session.header.cwd` 导致部分旧行项目为「—」，
  「维护 → 补齐历史维度」可一次性回填（只更新缺失列，不改动总用量，可重复执行）
- **可补录缺失会话**：磁盘上存在但账本里没有的会话（清空账本 / 回填遗漏造成），
  「维护 → 补录缺失会话」可摄入；**该操作会改变总用量**，因此强制先统计预览
  （显示新增会话数、tokens、占现有总量比例）再手输确认
- **面板材质可切**：经典背板（默认，保持原样）/ 液态玻璃 / 亚克力 / 哑光纸，见「设置 → 用量与额度 → 通用 → 面板材质」
- **纯主题变量**：使用 `var(--dsw-alias-*)`，自动跟随 DSH 明/暗主题
- **标准 bundle 插件**：`dsh plugin add` 一条命令安装，无需手工改 patch

## 安装

前置：已安装 DeepSeek Harness（Web 或桌面版），Node.js **>= 22.5**（`node:sqlite` 内置模块的起始版本；22.0–22.4 需 `--experimental-sqlite`，本插件会降级为纯内存模式、不落盘）。桌面版自带运行时（当前为 Node 24），无需另行安装。

### Web 版

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:CuiKuLaXiua/dsh-quota-widget
```

重启 dsh 服务后，右下角出现悬浮小窗；配置入口在「设置 → 用量与额度」。

> 本包**尚未发布到 npm registry**（`npm view dsh-quota-widget` 会 404），因此统一用 `github:` 源。
> `dsh plugin` 本身是 pnpm 的转发壳（registry 名 / `github:` / `git+https:` / tarball / 本地路径都直通 pnpm），
> 若日后发布到 npm，可简写为 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-quota-widget`。

### 桌面版

在桌面端 **Plugins / 插件** 页的安装来源中使用 GitHub 源命令安装：

```sh
github:CuiKuLaXiua/dsh-quota-widget
```

> git 源默认取仓库默认分支（`main`）的最新提交；要固定版本，用 `#` 接 tag 名，例如
> `github:CuiKuLaXiua/dsh-quota-widget#v0.1.1`。本包无 `prepare`/`build` 脚本，
> 安装时 pnpm 不需要放行构建（无 `allowBuilds` 配置步骤）。

具体步骤：

1. 打开桌面端 → 侧边栏 **Plugins / 插件** 页；
2. 在安装来源输入框粘贴 `github:CuiKuLaXiua/dsh-quota-widget`；
3. 点击安装并重启桌面端，生效后右下角出现悬浮小窗。

> 本插件是 bundle 型包（声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`），`dsh plugin add` 会自动把它加进
> profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 并应用 `cordis.patch.yml`，**不需要手工加 loader 行**。

## 配置说明

| 字段 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| Token | Opencode API Key / Bearer Token |
| Base URL | Opencode 自托管地址；留空自动探测官方端点 |
| 刷新间隔 | 秒，默认 120，建议 >= 60 |
| DeepSeek Key | DeepSeek API Key（Bearer） |
| R4Coder Base URL | 自定义 host（如 `https://api.r4.codes/v1`） |

## DSH v0.2.1 侧栏适配

桌面端 v0.2.1-rc.3 起左侧栏开放「全局面板」席位，并新增右侧栏、会话视图与「更多」菜单。
本插件的适配方式与行为：

- **入口**：左侧栏导航区（插件图标下方）出现「用量与额度」图标行，悬停有 tooltip；
  点开是三栏布局中栏的全宽管理面板，内容与「设置 → 用量与额度」完全同源（五个标签共用
  同一个组件），页头额外提供「悬浮窗显示中/已隐藏」开关。
- **入口开关**：「设置 → 通用 → 侧栏入口」可关闭左侧栏入口（默认显示）——关闭后图标行
  与全局面板一并撤销，悬浮窗与设置页不受影响；仅存在于 v0.2.1+ 的 DSH 上，旧版无此效果。
- **「更多」菜单**：第三方面板默认直接显示在侧栏导航区；用户可通过侧栏「更多」菜单里的
  Pin 控件把它收进菜单（收起后仍可从「更多」进入），这是宿主侧行为，插件无需（也无法）
  干预。
- **悬浮窗联动**：无——悬浮窗与面板互不影响、可同屏（悬浮窗在左下角、面板内容居中，
  互不遮挡）。悬浮窗显隐只由用户开关决定：面板页头的「悬浮窗显示中/已隐藏」开关与
  「设置 → 通用」里的开关等效。
- **兼容性**：适配只使用官方公开席位（`sidebar.panellist` + `main`，与官方「插件」页同一
  条注册路径），通过 `ctx.slots.inject()` 接线——席位已声明时同步注册，未声明时挂起等待，
  插件卸载时自动注销。**v0.2.1 之前的 DSH 没有这些席位，注入永不触发，插件行为与从前
  完全一致**（悬浮窗 + 设置页），无需升级依赖声明。

## 数据链路与隐私

### 数据链路

- **Token 只走请求头**：Host 端代理各提供商额度接口，Token 通过 `Authorization` / `x-api-key` 请求头传递，**不写入 URL query、不写入日志、不写入数据库**；Host 端不持久化 Token，每次请求转发后即丢弃；
- **TokenMeter 账本**：仅保存在本机 `$DSH_HOME/storages/token-meter.db`（90 天保留），只记录模型名、token 计数、时间等用量元数据，**不记录对话内容**；
- **账本快照**：清空账本前自动把完整库快照到 `$DSH_HOME/storages/token-meter-backups/`（保留最近 10 份），内容与账本同源、同样不含对话内容；**需要彻底删除时请手动删掉该目录**；
- **本地回环防护**：所有 HTTP 端点仅接受 `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `::1` 回环访问，并校验 `Sec-Fetch-Site`，防 DNS rebinding 与跨站读取；破坏性端点（清空账本）额外要求一次性 nonce（60s 有效、用后即焚），防本机其它进程重放；
- **上游主机白名单**：Opencode / DeepSeek 的 baseUrl 仅允许官方域名（`opencode.ai`、`api.opencode.ai`、`api.deepseek.com`）且强制 HTTPS，非白名单配置会自动回退官方端点。

### 风险提示（请知悉）

- **API Key 明文保存在浏览器 localStorage**：Opencode / DeepSeek / R4Coder 的 Token 以明文 JSON 保存在浏览器 localStorage（键 `opencode_quota_config`），以便下次打开自动使用。任何能在 DSH 页面同源下执行的脚本（如 XSS、恶意插件）或本机恶意软件均可读取，**建议仅在可信设备上使用**；
- **R4Coder 使用自定义 host**：R4Coder 的 Token 会发送到你配置的 `Base URL`。出于兼容自部署/第三方聚合服务的考虑，该地址**只强制 HTTPS、不设域名白名单**，**请只填写可信的 R4Coder 服务地址**；
- **外部 CDN 依赖（GSAP）**：部分动画（热力图、tooltip 等）会从 `cdn.jsdelivr.net` 动态加载 GSAP 脚本。它仅用于增强动画效果，加载失败时自动降级为纯 CSS / 原生动画，不影响功能；但该脚本会在 DSH 页面上下文中执行，存在供应链风险，若环境禁止外部 CDN 仍可正常使用（仅动画降级）。

## 开发

```sh
npm run check      # 两个 bundle 的语法检查
npm test           # node:test 单测（零依赖，node:sqlite 用 Node 内置）
npm pack           # 打包检查
```

- **无构建步骤**：仓库里的 `lib/*.js` 就是产物（宿主端手写 Node ESM、浏览器端手写单文件 bundle），
  `npm pack` 出的 9 个文件即安装包，push 到 GitHub 后 `github:` 源可直接安装，无需先打包再推代码；
- 宿主端 `lib/index.js`：纯 Node ESM，基于 `webServer` 注册同源 JSON 路由；
- 浏览器端 `lib/client.js`：按 DSH 模块加载器格式手写单文件 bundle；
- 本地安装测试：`dsh plugin --profile web add file:<本目录>`。

## 发布（维护者）

1. 源码仓库：https://github.com/CuiKuLaXiua/dsh-quota-widget ；
2. `npm login` 后执行 `npm publish --registry https://registry.npmjs.org`；
3. 推送源码 / 发版流程见 `docs/PUBLISHING.md`。

## License

MIT

# dsh-mygo

DeepSeek Harness 的原生桌面客户端：MyGo 原生 UI + Node Host（`dsh-base` + 自有 bundle）。

## 下载与开始使用

Windows x64 测试版通过公开 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/denislov/dsh-mygo/releases) 分发。应用安装器只含本体：下载 `dsh-mygo-<版本>-windows-x64-setup.exe`，首次启动时选择已安装的 DSH（精确版本 + Node 24+），或下载/导入独立的 `dsh-mygo-runtime-*.tgz`。安装后选择项目文件夹，在「连接 DeepSeek」中保存自己的 API key，即可开始对话。设置中心的 Runtime 分区可下载、更新、切换与移除运行时。

详细步骤、数据位置和测试版限制见[首次使用指南](docs/getting-started.md)。当前使用自签名证书，Windows 可能显示发布者或 SmartScreen 提示；下载校验和与公开证书随 Release 提供。

## 项目

- 不使用 `dsh-web-app`，不嵌入浏览器。
- 默认协议：自定义 channel（`mygo` profile）；SDK 通道只作显式回归。
- 首发平台：Windows x64；macOS 随后，Linux 视需要。

默认入口使用 `mygo` profile 的自定义 channel：校验 UI/Host/DSH 版本与应用兼容范围，显式创建会话，发送 prompt，显示 user/assistant/tool 事件与 running/idle 状态。原生助手正文支持 Markdown、只读高亮代码块与代码/源文复制；提供 Stop、审批与问答表单，保留下一条草稿。工具默认折叠，支持有界详情与只读 hunk；流式提交后不重复答案。Sessions 提供会话列表、新建、恢复、分页历史与草稿隔离；Settings 提供当前会话 provider/model/effort、持久默认模型、DeepSeek 凭据与 Runtime 管理。应用安装器与 Node+DSH runtime 分开发布，支持使用已有精确版本 DSH；首发平台为 Windows（x64），macOS 随后。当前缺口、里程碑与验收见 [docs/roadmap.md](docs/roadmap.md)。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) | 进程、组合、协议、状态、生命周期 |
| [docs/roadmap.md](docs/roadmap.md) | 当前进度、缺口、里程碑与验收 |
| [LESSONS.md](LESSONS.md) | 开发过程中的经验教训 |
| [docs/code-standards.md](docs/code-standards.md) | 重复 3 次后固化的编码/文档规范 |
| [docs/subsystem/](docs/subsystem/) | Host 监督、通道、投影、交互、UI、打包、测试 |
| [docs/research/](docs/research/) | 立项调研与取舍 |
| [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) | 文档路由、硬规则、命令 |

## 开发

```sh
go tool mygo dev
go test ./...
node scripts/build-runtime.mjs   # 生成 build/runtime/*.tgz + runtime-catalog.json
go tool mygo build               # 仅应用本体，并自动签名
node scripts/smoke-packaged.mjs  # 安装器无 runtime + 首启引导 + -runtime-dir（Windows）
node scripts/smoke-installer.mjs # 安装/卸载 smoke（需干净环境）
```

## 自签名发布构建

项目使用本地自签名 Authenticode 证书，不购买公开 CA 证书。首次 `go tool mygo build` 会在 `.signing/` 生成证书；`.signing/` 已被忽略，私钥、PFX 和密码不会进入版本库。签名需要 OpenSSL（Git for Windows 自带）和 Windows SDK 的 `signtool.exe`。

```sh
node scripts/self-sign.mjs              # 生成或复用 .signing/dsh-mygo.pfx
node scripts/self-sign.mjs --trust      # 仅本机：信任证书，便于无警告测试
node scripts/verify-signatures.mjs      # 校验 exe 与安装器签名
node scripts/self-sign.mjs --remove-trust
```

`mygo.json` 的 `windows.signCommand` 会签名 Go 二进制、安装器与卸载器；`resources/` 只含 Host bundle 与图标。独立 runtime `.tgz` 使用 GitHub HTTPS + catalog SHA256，Node 自带的 `node.exe` 保留其上游签名。时间戳默认使用 DigiCert；时间戳服务器不可达时退回无时间戳签名（自签名证书可接受）。发布者应备份 `.signing/`；`--force` 会更换签名身份，已信任旧证书的用户需要重新信任新证书。

自签名证书不会建立 SmartScreen 信誉：Windows 会显示 **Unknown publisher**，安装器可能被 SmartScreen 拦截。发布时请附上 `.signing/dsh-mygo.cer` 的 SHA-256 指纹与构建产物的校验和，让用户自行核验；不要引导用户无条件把自签名根证书加入信任库。开源项目后续可申请 [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.io) 的免费 OSS 签名。

`DSH_MYGO_SIGN=0` 可生成未签名构建；此时 MyGo 的构建日志仍会显示 `Signing`/`Signed`，但脚本实际跳过签名。`DSH_MYGO_REQUIRE_SIGNATURE=0` 可跳过打包 smoke 的签名检查。

`node scripts/smoke-installer.mjs` 会把安装器静默安装到 `.tmp`，校验安装布局不含 runtime、首次启动进入运行时引导，再用独立 runtime 启动并检查会话，校验 exe 与 `Uninstall.exe` 签名，最后静默卸载，确认安装目录、快捷方式和卸载键被移除，同时 `$DSH_HOME` 与会话历史保留。它会写入真实的 Start Menu 快捷方式和 HKCU 卸载键，所以检测到已安装 dsh-mygo 时会拒绝运行；发布验收请使用干净 Windows VM。`--keep` 保留临时目录以便排查。

原生窗口 + fake host（无需 DSH 或 API key）：

```sh
go run . -host-command node -host-arg testdata/fake-mygo-host.mjs
```

验证 Stop 按钮时额外传入 `-host-arg --wait-for-cancel`：第一回合会等待取消，下一回合恢复普通 Echo 回复。

验证审批时额外传入 `-host-arg --approval`：第一回合等待 Allow once / Deny / Stop turn；后续回合恢复 Echo，不写真实文件。

验证问答时额外传入 `-host-arg --question`（连续两次用 `--question-twice`）：展示单选、多选、自由文本问题；Submit answers 提交整批答案，Cancel question 或 Escape 取消提问，Stop turn 停止回合。

验证流式时额外传入 `-host-arg --stream`：第一回合先显示 `Live prefix`，再提交完整答案。`--stream-wait` 保持部分文本直到 Stop；`--no-stream` 模拟未声明能力的旧 Host。后续回合恢复 Echo。

验证工具卡片时额外传入 `-host-arg --tool-diff`：发送任意消息后展开 `Tool · edit`，点击 `View details`，切换 Arguments / Result / Changes 并逐个查看记录的 hunk。该演示不写真实文件。详情超限/缓存淘汰会明确提示，diff 不提供编辑或应用操作。

验证 Markdown 时额外传入 `-host-arg --markdown`：助手先流式显示标题和开放代码围栏，完成后可 `Copy code` / `Copy Markdown`，保留代码缩进与换行。`--markdown-wait` 可测试 Stop 后的部分源文复制。图片不自动加载，链接仅显式点击 HTTP(S) 才打开；用户和工具内容保持原文。截断或中断内容不会被当成完整代码复制。

验证会话列表时额外传入 `-host-arg --sessions`：点击 **Sessions**，选择 `Session demo-history` 回放已有正文；可继续发送，或 **New conversation** 后切回验证草稿隔离。fake 历史仅在当前 Host 内存中保存，不跨进程重启持久化。

验证模型设置时额外传入 `-host-arg --models -provider test -model echo`（可与 `--sessions` 组合）：空闲时点击 **Settings**，Model ID 填 `route-probe`，选择 effort 后 **Apply model**，再发送消息；回复会显示实际使用的测试路由。选择 Provider default 清除 effort，`bad` 模型演示错误反馈，不调用外部 API。

**Apply model** 只影响当前会话的下个回合；**Save selection as default** 将表单路由保存到 Host profile，当前会话不变。未显式传 `-provider` / `-model` / `-effort` 时，支持配置能力的 Host 在启动、新建、冷恢复时使用持久默认值；显式 flags 继续覆盖。切回已拥有会话保留其选择，旧 Host/SDK 保持原行为。

Settings 下半部提供 DeepSeek 凭据状态、密码输入 **Save key** 和需勾选确认的 **Clear managed key**；可能需要滚动。不会回读/展示 key，不做付费调用验证。保存由 DSH 管理本地凭据文件（不是加密系统保险库）；清除只移除管理值，环境或 `.env` fallback 可能继续生效，不等于撤销远端 key。写入失败时先 Refresh 确认再继续。详见 [设置与凭据](docs/subsystem/settings-credentials.md)。

无需真实密钥的完整配置体验：

```sh
go run . -host-command node -host-arg testdata/fake-mygo-host.mjs -host-arg --sessions -host-arg --models -host-arg --configuration
```

此 fixture 的默认模型和假凭据只存在当前 Host 内存；不要输入真实 key。真实 Host 则保存在同一 DSH_HOME/profile，重启后保留。

原生窗口 + 真实自定义 profile（Node 24+；DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`）：

```sh
# DSH checkout 先安装依赖并构建；DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 只从环境读取
go run . -dsh-dir D:/Workspace/deepseek-harness -dsh-home D:/Temp/dsh-mygo-dev
```

首启自动从 `resources/host` 创建 `mygo` profile；已有 profile 不会被覆盖。需要把 bundle 以 junction 链接进 profile 时，仍可运行 `node resources/host/setup-profile.mjs --dsh-home <目录>`。

不依赖 DSH checkout、直接验证已构建的 runtime：

```sh
node scripts/build-runtime.mjs
go run . -runtime-dir runtime -dsh-home D:/Temp/dsh-mygo-runtime
```

首次无 runtime 的引导可单独验证（不会写用户的 runtime store）：

```sh
go run . -runtime-home D:/Temp/dsh-mygo-runtime-store -dsh-home D:/Temp/dsh-mygo-runtime
```

真实历史保存在同一 `DSH_HOME`/profile 的 DSH 存储中。重新运行相同命令后会先创建新会话，再通过 **Sessions** 选择旧会话；冷恢复按上述默认/显式 flags 规则选择模型，使用历史记录中的工作目录。仅空闲时切换，各会话草稿只在本次 App 内存中保留。旧 Host/SDK 未协商 history 时隐藏入口。当前 Host 默认同时拥有最多 8 个会话，超限会提示失败，不静默删除历史。

无需 API key 的真实 Loader + mock 模型集成（PowerShell）：

```sh
node scripts/test-real-host.mjs D:/Workspace/deepseek-harness
node scripts/build-runtime.mjs
node scripts/test-real-host.mjs --runtime
go test ./internal/app -run TestAgainstMygoRealComposition -v -timeout 2m
go test ./internal/app -run TestAgainstMygoSessionSwitching -v -timeout 3m
go test ./internal/app -run TestAgainstMygoModelSettings -v -timeout 3m
go test ./internal/app -run TestAgainstMygoConfiguration -v -timeout 3m
node --test resources/host/tests/*.test.mjs
```

显式使用旧 SDK 窗口链路：

```sh
go run . -sdk-protocol -profile sdk -host-command node -host-arg testdata/fake-sdk-host.mjs
```

P0 协议 spike（不开窗口，打印提交事件）：

```sh
go run ./cmd/spike -host-command node -host-arg testdata/fake-sdk-host.mjs -prompt "hello"
```

Host 侧需要 DeepSeek Harness 与 Node。真实集成测试使用临时 `DSH_HOME`，不要写入用户数据；不要提交 API key。

# @dreamor/dsh-memvault Cordis plugin bridging [MemVault](../README.md) into [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`). The `dsh`/Cordis API surface it relies on (`ctx.systemPrompt.section()`, `session/event` payloads, `Plugin.Object` resolution) was verified against the actual `deepseek-harness` source, not secondhand docs. ## What it does - **Auto-injection**: keeps `memory://session-inject` cached and registers it as a system prompt section (`ctx.systemPrompt.section()`), refreshed eagerly at load and again on every `turn/end`. No agent tool call required. - **Auto-extraction**: on `turn/end` with `reason.kind === 'completed'`, calls MemVault's `notify_response` with **both** that turn's assistant text and the user's own turn text (`user/message` events with `source.kind === 'user'`) automatically. Passing the user's own words matters — MemVault's extractor signal words are first-person ("我偏好"/"我喜欢"), which match a user's own statement far more reliably than an assistant's restatement of it. If you only want the raw 20 MemVault tools exposed to the model (no auto-injection/auto-extraction), you don't need this package — dsh's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` does the same with zero code: each upstream server gets its own Cordis plugin instance via `cordis.patch.yml` (`transport: stdio`, `serverName: memvault`, `command: `). ## Install Prerequisites: a working `dsh` install (e.g. `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`) and the `memvault-proxy` binary reachable from `PATH` (or point `binaryPath` at one — see the override section below). Build, then install into a dsh profile from the repo's `dsh-plugin/` directory: ```bash cd dsh-plugin npm install npm run build # tsc --strict npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile add "$PWD" ``` `dsh plugin add` runs the equivalent of `pnpm add` and appends the package to that profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` automatically — no manual edit of the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` is needed for a default install. The plugin ships a `cordis.patch.yml` that registers one `memvault` entry with the default config (`mode: spawn`, `embeddingProvider: native`, …). Verify the composed config, then start: ```bash npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile --dump-config # 组合后应只有一条 id: memvault 且字段正确 npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --port 0 # 实际启动方式以你的 dsh 用法为准 ``` At startup the plugin spawns `memvault-proxy` on port 3778 and probes `http://127.0.0.1:3778/health` until the server is ready. To confirm the injection actually lands: start a real conversation turn, then decompress the session log (`zstd -d ~/.dsh/sessions/.../session.jsonl.zstd`) and check that `request/header.data.header.system` contains the injected `[MUST]`/`[REF]` blocks. ### Overriding config (local development) To override a single field (e.g. point `binaryPath` at a locally built `memvault-proxy`), add a **bare-id override patch** to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and rewrite the whole `config` block — an override replaces the entire `config`, it does not merge per-field: ```yaml - id: memvault name: '@dreamor/dsh-memvault' config: mode: spawn db: '~/.memvault/data.db' port: 3778 binaryPath: /absolute/path/to/memvault-proxy embeddingProvider: native agentId: dsh injectOnAssemble: true extractOnTurnEnd: true ``` The `cordis.patch.yml` this plugin ships wraps its entry in `insert:` because the entry doesn't exist in any earlier layer. A bare `- id:` patch is an *override* that requires the id to already exist and errors with `patch: entry "memvault" not found` otherwise — an override patch must rewrite the whole `config` block, it never merges per-field. ## Config | Field | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `mode` | `spawn` | `spawn` manages a `memvault-proxy` child process; `attach` connects to `url`. | | `db` | `~/.memvault/data.db` | Used when `mode: spawn`. | | `port` | `3778` | Used when `mode: spawn`. | | `url` | `''` | Used when `mode: attach`, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:3778/mcp`. | | `binaryPath` | `''` (resolved from `PATH`) | Used when `mode: spawn`. | | `embeddingProvider` | `native` | Used when `mode: spawn` — forced as `MEMVAULT_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER` in the child's env, so it can't accidentally inherit dsh's own `OPENAI_API_KEY`. | | `agentId` | `dsh` | Reported to MemVault on every call. | | `injectOnAssemble` | `true` | Toggle auto-injection. | | `extractOnTurnEnd` | `true` | Toggle auto-extraction. | | `inferOutcomeOnSessionEnd` | `false` | Auto-call `infer_outcome` at session end (`session/disposed`) to record a task outcome/episode for `bench` and lesson reflection — mirrors the Claude/Codex plugin's `MEMVAULT_HOOK_OUTCOME` knob. | ## Build ```bash npm install npm run build npm test ``` ## Status Builds clean (`tsc --strict`) against the real, npm-published `@deepseek-ai/cordis@4.0.5`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt@0.2.0-rc.2`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session@0.2.0-rc.2`, and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm@0.2.0-rc.2` packages (not mocks — see `src/index.smoke.test.ts`, which mounts the plugin on a real `Context` alongside the real `SystemPrompt` service and asserts `ctx.systemPrompt.assemble()` actually contains the injected section). **Fully verified end to end against a real `dsh` install** (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`, v0.1.0-rc.6). Four real bugs were found and fixed in the course of the verification: 1. `cordis.patch.yml` insert vs. override patch semantics (a bare `id` patch requires the id to already exist). 2. `memvault-proxy` inheriting a stray `OPENAI_API_KEY` from dsh's own process env, plus a stale (pre-`native`-embedding) local binary. 3. The eager injection-cache refresh at `apply()` time racing `memvault-proxy`'s own startup (`fetch failed`). 4. `mcp-client.ts` permanently caching a *failed* connection attempt — `connected ??= (...)` memoized on the first (raced, failing) call, so every later call kept re-rejecting forever, never retrying even after the proxy came up. With all four fixed, a real conversation turn's session log (`~/.dsh/sessions/.../session.jsonl.zstd`, decompressed with `zstd -d`) shows the actual `request/header.data.header.system` text containing MemVault's injected `[MUST]`/`[REF]` memories, and a direct `notify_response` call against the running `memvault-proxy` moved MemVault's memory count from 8 to 10 (new preference/fact memories actually saved to Inbox). A follow-up round extended `notify_response` to also extract from the user's own turn text — MemVault's extractor signal words are first-person, so a user's own statement ("我偏好用 tabs") matches far more reliably than an assistant's restatement of it ("你偏好用 tabs" used to be silently rejected; the signal-word list was also extended with second/third-person mirrors). Verified against the real running `memvault-proxy`: memory count went from 10 to 13 across three scenarios, with `source:user`/`source:assistant` tags on the results. DSH 0.2 compatibility has also been checked with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*@0.2.0-rc.2` and a real `dsh@0.2.0-rc.2` `plugin add` / `--dump-config` run; the plugin keeps its wildcard peer range so DSH 0.1 installs remain usable.
# MemVault ### The Shared Memory Layer for Every AI Agent You Run > Not "agent learns to search memory" — memory finds the agent. **MCP Native  ·  Hybrid Retrieval  ·  Auto-Injection  ·  Zero-Config Sync** **Open Source  ·  Self-Hosted  ·  Private  ·  MIT Licensed** [![Crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/memvault-cli.svg?style=flat-square)](https://crates.io/crates/memvault-cli) [![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/dreamor/memvault?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/dreamor/memvault/releases) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/dreamor/memvault/ci.yml?style=flat-square&branch=master)](https://github.com/dreamor/memvault/actions) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/Rust-stable-orange.svg?style=flat-square)](https://www.rust-lang.org) [![MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-compatible-blue.svg?style=flat-square)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) [![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-beta-yellow.svg?style=flat-square)](#project-status) **English**  ·  [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
If MemVault solves a real problem for you, a star helps others find it. **[⭐ Star on GitHub](https://github.com/dreamor/memvault)**  ·  **[Report Bug](https://github.com/dreamor/memvault/issues/new)**
```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dreamor/memvault/master/scripts/install.sh | bash ```
--- Every AI agent session starts from scratch. Claude Desktop doesn't know what Cursor just learned. DeepSeek Harness (dsh) doesn't know what you told Claude Code yesterday. Whatever agent you're running — international or domestic, IDE plugin or CLI harness — it forgets your preferences every time you start a new conversation. You've been manually repeating context — project conventions, personal preferences, past decisions — across agents that should already know. This isn't a limitation of the models. It's a missing infrastructure layer. MemVault is that layer. A lightweight, self-hosted memory router that sits between your agents and their context. It speaks plain MCP — no MemVault-specific SDK, no per-agent API integration. **Any MCP-compatible agent, from any vendor, automatically shares the same persistent memory the moment it connects.** **Who it's for:** - **Anyone running an MCP-capable agent** — Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Continue, DeepSeek Harness (dsh), or any other MCP client, domestic or international — who wants preferences, project context, and past decisions to persist across sessions without repeating yourself - **Multi-agent power users** running several of the above side by side, on different models, from different vendors — all sharing the same memory without configuration - **Platform teams** deploying AI-assisted workflows where consistency matters across a mixed agent fleet: code review conventions, architecture decisions, project-specific preferences - **Anyone tired of telling their AI the same thing twice** — MemVault works the way your brain should: you say it once, it's there when you need it, no matter which agent is asking **[Quick Start](#quick-start)**  ·  **[How It Works](#how-it-works)**  ·  **[What MemVault Gives You](#what-memvault-gives-you)**  ·  **[Why MemVault](#why-memvault)**  ·  **[MCP Server](#mcp-server)**  ·  **[CLI Reference](#cli-reference)**  ·  **[Integrations](#integrations)**  ·  **[Architecture](#architecture)**  ·  **[Project Status](#project-status)**  ·  **[Testing](#testing)**  ·  **[Documentation](#documentation)**  ·  **[Contributing](#contributing)**  ·  **[License](#license)** --- ## Quick Start Don't install MemVault by hand — paste this one prompt into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, dsh, or any other MCP-capable agent. It points the agent at a machine-readable install guide, so the agent does the whole setup itself: ```text Install MemVault as your long-term memory and wire it into this agent. Fetch and follow https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dreamor/memvault/master/docs/AGENT-INSTALL.md — install the binaries, register MemVault as an MCP server for this host, and verify recall works. Then keep saving my preferences, project decisions, and lessons from each session so my next agent starts with them instead of from scratch. ``` Or install manually: ```bash # Install (Linux / macOS): official script, auto-verifies SHA-256 curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dreamor/memvault/master/scripts/install.sh | bash export PATH="$HOME/.memvault/bin:$PATH" # Windows (PowerShell): # powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1 # Homebrew (Apple Silicon): # brew install dreamor/tap/memvault # Or from crates.io: # cargo install memvault-cli memvault-mcp # The installers auto-start the local REST backend (host of the Web # Dashboard). Open it, or start it on demand: memvault-cli dashboard # Save a MUST-level preference (injected as instruction, agent must follow) memvault-cli save --content "User prefers Python" --priority MUST --type preference \ --instruction "Use Python for code, not Java" --tags "coding,python" # Search across all memory (hybrid: keyword + semantic when embedding is enabled) memvault-cli search --query "Python" # See what context gets injected when a specific agent connects memvault-cli session-start --agent-id claude-desktop --context "Help me write code" # Extract structured memories from free text memvault-cli extract --text "I prefer dark mode. Our project uses Rust." --save # Auto-generate agent instruction files from memory memvault-cli sync # All in one: dedup, decay, archive stale memories memvault-cli dedup && memvault-cli decay ``` > **System requirements:** > - **Prebuilt Linux binaries** (install script / GitHub release): glibc ≥ 2.38 + GLIBCXX_3.4.31 (GCC 13-era runtime — Ubuntu 24.04+ / Fedora 39+ / Arch; `memvault-proxy` additionally wants glibc ≥ 2.39). TLS is rustls, so no OpenSSL dependency. Ubuntu 22.04 / RHEL or EL8/EL9 users: use the Docker image (`dreamor/memvault`) or build from source. > - **Building from source** (`cargo install` / `cargo build`): links fastembed's prebuilt ONNX Runtime static library and needs a GCC 13-class toolchain. Older toolchains (e.g. GCC 8, CentOS 7/8-era libstdc++) fail at link time with missing C++20/23 stdlib symbols (`std::format`, `std::to_chars`). macOS / Windows (MSVC) / Homebrew / Docker are unaffected. **Verify your install in 5 seconds:** ```bash memvault-cli --version # memvault 0.6.6 # sanity check: list saved memories (verifies DB is healthy) memvault-cli list ``` ### Local Ollama Demo (Zero Cost, Stays on Your Machine) MemVault is plug-and-play with a local Ollama: unconfigured LLM extraction (full-text understanding / failure reflection / relation extraction) auto-detects a local Ollama; embeddings use the local model with the `ollama` or `auto` provider. ```bash # 1. Install and start Ollama brew install ollama && brew services start ollama # or the official installer # 2. Pull models ollama pull nomic-embed-text # embeddings, 768-dim (default for ollama/auto) ollama pull qwen2.5:3b-instruct # chat: LLM extraction/reflection (default qwen2.5:7b, use 3b on small machines) # 3. (Optional) Pin the providers explicitly — persist them in ~/.memvault/.env # (shell exports also work — env vars take precedence over the file — but the file survives reboots) mkdir -p ~/.memvault cat >> ~/.memvault/.env <<'EOF' MEMVAULT_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama MEMVAULT_LLM_EXTRACTION_PROVIDER=ollama MEMVAULT_LLM_EXTRACTION_MODEL=qwen2.5:3b-instruct EOF # 4. Verify memvault-cli status # Embedding provider: configured and reachable memvault-cli save --content "Build server IP is 10.20.30.40" # output (embedded int8) memvault-cli outcome --task "Deploy trading service" --status failure --cause "Disk space insufficient" --task-type deploy # → Lesson (Llm): ... means failure reflection ran through the local LLM (not the rule-based fallback) ``` With no configuration at all (neither env vars nor `~/.memvault/.env`), LLM extraction auto-detects a local Ollama and enables itself (default model `qwen2.5:7b`; pull it in advance with `ollama pull qwen2.5:7b`, or point `MEMVAULT_LLM_EXTRACTION_MODEL` at an installed model). Embeddings still default to the in-process native embedder; set `MEMVAULT_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=auto` in `~/.memvault/.env` to prefer Ollama and fall back to native when it isn't running. The native model's first launch downloads the weights from HuggingFace **silently in the background** — the server/dashboard come up immediately and hot-swap to semantic search once the download finishes, so a fresh install never blocks on it (set `MEMVAULT_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=none` to run pure keyword and skip the download). --- ## How It Works MemVault is a pipeline, not a single script. Every stage below is a shipping module: ``` Agent connects (MCP stdio/SSE) │ ▼ ┌───────────────────┐ │ Agent Router │ ← match agent type/tag → filter relevant memory │ (Agent Registry) │ └────────┬──────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────┐ │ Memory Retrieval │ ← keyword (BM25) + vector (embedding) + RRF fusion │ (3 search modes) │ synonym expansion · scoring · soft filtering └────────┬──────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────┐ │ Auto-Injection │ ← MUST-level → instruction prompt │ │ REFERENCE → context resource │ │ NORMAL → search result └────────┬──────────┘ │ ▼ Agent receives context ──→ makes better decisions ``` - **Storage:** SQLite with bundled FTS5 (full-text search); embeddings stored int8-quantized (~1/4 the size of f32 at near-identical ranking quality, legacy f32 rows still readable) - **Retrieval:** BM25 keyword search over FTS5 with CJK bigram tokenization (Chinese two-character words match correctly) and tiered match fallback (strict → relaxed unigram → synonym OR; relaxations are reported, never silent), local-first embedding (in-process native by default — switch to local Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible model), RRF fusion with per-result recall provenance (`kw#2`/`vec#5`), synonym expansion, relevance scoring, soft intent filtering - **Pipeline:** Automatic entity extraction, delta-write on save (near-duplicates skipped, similar memories absorb only the residual), semantic deduplication, time-based decay, archive of stale memories - **Sync:** Zero-invasion file generation — `memvault-cli sync` produces CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, etc. directly from database contents --- ## What MemVault Gives You - **Auto-Injected Context:** Session start automatically pulls relevant memory by agent identity — MUST-level rules land as instructions, not just chat history - **Hybrid Retrieval:** BM25 + vector + RRF fusion with synonym expansion, relevance scoring, and per-result provenance (which path recalled each memory, at what rank) — available via CLI, MCP tool, and REST API - **Explainable Injection:** every candidate dropped on the way into an agent's context is recorded with a reason (budget, caps, intent/type penalties) — "why didn't the agent get this memory?" always has an answer - **MUST Enforcement:** MUST-priority memories are never filtered or truncated. Always in context, always obeyed — trust comes from provenance (human-authored/reviewed), with an opt-in fallback for memories independently corroborated by multiple identity-verified agents (`MEMVAULT_CORROBORATION_GATE`), so a single spoofed/compromised agent can't unilaterally inject a binding MUST - **Multi-Agent Awareness:** Agent Registry with type/tag-based soft filtering (score demotion, not hard exclusion) - **`agent_id` Is Provenance, Not a Filter:** retrieval never filters by `agent_id` — the field only records which agent wrote a memory (`source_agent`). Every agent searches the same shared corpus; per-agent differences apply only at injection time (type/tag soft scoring via `agents.yaml` `inject_rules`) - **MCP Proxy:** Transparent proxy that injects memory into ANY upstream MCP server's responses — zero client changes - **Compliance Tracking:** `inject_session_id` traces what was injected and measures follow-through rate - **Cross-Platform:** CLI + MCP Server (stdio & SSE) + Web Dashboard (browser) + Obsidian Plugin - **Zero-Invasion Sync:** Generate AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md from memory — no per-agent config files to edit - **Contextual Extraction, Local-First:** Rule-based keyword extraction by default; optionally understands a full user+assistant exchange via an LLM, auto-detecting a local Ollama for free before ever touching a remote API - **History & Rollback:** Every update/delete is snapshotted into `memory_history` — `memvault-cli checkpoints` + `memvault-cli restore` roll one memory back without touching the rest - **Self-Diagnostics:** `memvault-cli status` reports exactly which features are degraded when no embedding provider is configured, plus a schema fingerprint (migration version + checksum) for cross-database comparison - **Episodic Memory:** `record_outcome` records task results; failures are distilled into lessons and auto-injected next time (REFERENCE → MUST only with human approval), so the same trap isn't hit twice - **Procedural Skill Activation:** skills whose `trigger` matches intent are injected as structured `[SKILL]` blocks with success-rate stats (shown after ≥3 runs); failures flag the skill for revision (`version++` on human edit), repeated successes auto-draft new skills into the review inbox - **Semantic Knowledge Links:** lightweight relation triples, repeated facts consolidated into a linked semantic fact with provenance, and superseded facts archived (never re-injected, still listable & restorable) - **Team Shared Pool & SOP Import:** memories marked `shared` are injected into every session (capped at 20); Markdown SOPs can be batch-imported as verifiable skills - **Delta-Write on Save:** every save is checked against its namespace first — near-duplicates are skipped, similar memories absorb only the *residual* (what's genuinely new) and get their strength refreshed, so the library converges instead of accumulating near-copies; `--force` / `force_insert` bypasses - **Task-Level Evaluation:** `memvault-cli bench` samples your own failure history (episodes that distilled a lesson) and measures lesson retrieval/injection rates — and with `--judge`, an LLM scores "plan without vs. with memory" against the known failure cause, so you see *task-success* lift, not just retrieval recall - **Two-Phase Injection (never blocks):** MUST rules resolve deterministically with zero embedding calls and are served immediately; the semantic pipeline prefetches in the background and lands within a short window (250ms) — if it doesn't, the deterministic baseline is served and the request moves on (two-phase design) - **Conversation-N-Gram Retrieval:** retrieval keys are conditioned on the recent turn window, weighted by recency so the current focus dominates — not a single flat query - **Single Canonical Injection Channel:** per-agent `inject_channel` (`mcp` / `proxy` / `sync` in `agents.yaml`) restricts automatic injection to one delivery path, so the same memory is never sent to the same agent twice - **Data You Own:** Single SQLite file. Full export/import. No cloud dependency. Your data, your machine. --- ## Why MemVault Looking for a **self-hosted alternative to Mem0, Zep, or Letta/MemGPT**? Those are hosted APIs or Python frameworks tied to one SDK. MemVault ships as a single Rust binary with no hosted service and no vendor lock-in, speaks plain MCP instead of a proprietary SDK, and shares one memory store across every agent you run — Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, dsh — not just one. | Feature | Plain CLAUDE.md | Vector DB + RAG | **MemVault** | |---|---|---|---| | **Context injection** | Manual edits | Query-time only | Auto on session start | | **Multi-agent sharing** | Copy-paste | Separate indexes | Single shared store | | **MUST enforcement** | None | None | Instruction-layer injection | | **Search modes** | File grep | Embedding only | BM25 + Vector + Hybrid | | **Synonym expansion** | No | No | Built-in | | **Deduplication** | No | No | Semantic dedup pipeline | | **Write-time delta merge** | No | No | Near-dupes skip, similar absorb the residual at save | | **Task-level evaluation** | None | Recall metrics only | `bench`: with-vs-without-memory task success delta | | **Decay / archival** | No | No | Time-based + auto archive | | **Memory extraction** | Manual | N/A | Rule-based by default; optional local-first LLM extraction | | **MCP native** | No | No | stdio + SSE + Proxy | | **Agent differentiation** | Global file | Query filter | Type/tag registry | | **Compliance tracking** | None | None | inject_session_id + rate | | **Self-hosted** | Yes | Varies | Single binary, no cloud | MemVault complements your existing agent setup rather than replacing it. Keep your LLM, your IDE, and your workflow exactly as they are. MemVault adds the memory layer underneath. --- ## MCP Server > Tier-1 agents (Claude Code, OpenCode, dsh, Gemini CLI, Codex) have one-command plugin installs — see [Installing into your agents](#installing-into-your-agents) first. Everything below is the universal fallback for any other MCP client. ### stdio (any standard MCP client) MemVault speaks plain MCP stdio — the same `mcpServers` JSON works verbatim in Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Continue, and any other client that reads this format: ```json { "mcpServers": { "memvault": { "command": "/path/to/memvault-mcp", "args": ["--db", "~/.memvault/data.db"], "env": { "OPENAI_API_KEY": "sk-..." } } } } ``` A couple of clients use their own one-liner instead of hand-editing JSON: ```bash # Claude Code claude mcp add memvault /path/to/memvault-mcp -- --db ~/.memvault/data.db ``` **DeepSeek Harness (dsh)** — a domestic (China) agent harness — gets deeper treatment than a generic stdio config: a native Cordis plugin (`dsh-plugin/`) that auto-injects memory into the system prompt and auto-extracts at turn end, with no per-turn cooperation required from the agent. See [docs/INSTALL.md §2.5](docs/INSTALL.md#25-deepseek-harness-dsh) for both the zero-code MCP route and the deep-integration plugin. Other MCP-compatible agents — international or domestic, IDE plugin or CLI harness — should work the same way: any client implementing standard MCP stdio/SSE can connect without MemVault-side changes. The ones above are the ones we've actually verified; if you get MemVault working with another one, a PR to this list is welcome. ### SSE (multi-client, network-accessible) ```bash memvault-mcp --transport sse --port 3777 # Clients connect at http://127.0.0.1:3777/mcp ``` SSE features: multi-client simultaneous connections, auto-triggered embedding backfill on initialization, HTTP remote access. > **Note:** `--transport sse` only mounts the MCP-over-HTTP endpoint (`/mcp`) — it does **not** expose the REST API (`/api/*`). The Web Dashboard is served by the REST backend (`memvault-mcp --transport http --serve-web `), and the Obsidian plugin also uses the REST API and requires `--transport http` instead. See [docs/INSTALL.md §2.6](docs/INSTALL.md#26-rest-api-required-by-the-obsidian-plugin). ### 20 MCP Tools | Tool | Description | |------|-------------| | `save_memory` | Save with auto-embedding; delta-write by default (near-dupes skip, similar merge) — `force_insert` to bypass | | `record_outcome` | Record a task outcome (episodic memory); failures reflect into lessons | | `infer_outcome` | Classify + record a task outcome from host-provided evidence (friction counts, terminal state) instead of a raw transcript — same rule-floor-plus-optional-LLM-judge logic as the Stop hook's `outcome --infer`; built for hosts without a Claude-Code-shaped JSONL transcript (e.g. dsh/Cordis). Returns `skipped` (not an error) when nothing is inferred | | `import_skills` | Import skills from a Markdown SOP (headings → skills, list items → steps) | | `search_memory` | Keyword / semantic / hybrid | | `session_start` | Agent-aware context injection; honors the agent's `inject_channel` (skips with an explanation when another channel is canonical) | | `review_memory` | Approve / reject / edit | | `delete_memory` | Remove a memory (soft delete — restorable via `restore`) | | `forget_memory` | Permanently erase one memory or a criteria-matched bulk set (GDPR-style, irreversible); `dry_run` defaults to `true` | | `extract_memories` | Structured extraction from text | | `run_dedup` | Deduplication scan | | `run_decay` | Decay + auto-archive | | `confirm_read` | Mark read (updates access_count) | | `list_inbox` | List memories pending human review | | `run_promote` | Promote pipeline (L1→L2→L3), archive sources to L0 | | `report_compliance` | Report follow/violate status for an injected session | | `get_compliance_report` | Compliance rates per session or aggregate | | `add_evidence` | Record evidence relations: supports / contradicts / sourced_from | | `get_memory_evidence` | Get the raw-evidence chain a memory was distilled from (its L0 trace rows) plus its evidence profile — read-only grounding, so an agent can quote the original session text and name its sources | | `get_effectiveness_report` | Automatic effectiveness judgments for injected memories (useful/neutral/harmful/insufficient-context rates, judged from `record_outcome`) — independent of the manual `report_compliance` flow | ### 2 MCP Resources | URI | Content | |-----|---------| | `memory://user-profile` | MUST-level rules, auto-loaded on connect | | `memory://project-context` | REFERENCE-level project context | ### Configuration (.env file & environment variables) Copy [.env.example](.env.example) to `~/.memvault/.env` and uncomment what you need — it is also the single source of truth documenting every key. Precedence (high → low): **CLI flags > process environment > `~/.memvault/.env` > built-in defaults**. Every binary loads the env file first thing at startup; `--env-file ` or `MEMVAULT_ENV_FILE` points elsewhere, and a missing file is silently skipped. `memvault-cli status` prints where each setting came from

--- owner: @esengine backup: @SivanCola status: active reviewed: 2026-10-17 --- # dsh-plugin-reasonix English | [中文](#中文) [Website](https://reasonix.io) · [Documentation](../../docs/DSH.md) · [Source](../../README.md) Use [Reasonix](../../README.md) as a subagent in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`). The package is configuration only: one patch layer that points Harness's `subagent-acp` provider at `reasonix acp` and exposes it to the model as a `reasonix` tool. It contains no code. ## Before you install 1. Install Reasonix and run `reasonix setup` once on the same machine. Reasonix reads its provider key from its own home, not from environment variables, so Harness cannot pass one. 2. Make sure `reasonix` is on the `PATH` of the process that runs `dsh`. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile add github:esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix#path:/integrations/dsh-plugin ``` The package is not on npm; `pnpm` installs the `integrations/dsh-plugin` subdirectory of this repository (the `path:` selector, see [pnpm package sources](https://pnpm.io/package-sources)). ## After installing: switch it on An installed plugin starts **off**. Open its page in the DSH Web UI and turn the switch on. - The switch and both components must read Running. Turning it on in a running `dsh web` is enough: the next new session has the `reasonix` tool (observed on `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2). Restart `dsh` only if it is still missing. - While it is off the model may run `reasonix -p` in its own shell. - That looks like a delegation and is not one: there is no subagent, and the permission policy below does not apply. ## What it changes | Row | Effect | | --- | --- | | `subagent-acp-reasonix` | Spawns `reasonix acp` for each delegation; `permission: reject`. | | `tool-subagent-reasonix` | Adds the `reasonix` tool (`prompt`, `description`, optional `cwd`); `maxDepth: provider-managed`, which the provider requires. | ## Permissions - `permission: reject` is the default. Every approval card Reasonix raises is declined, so the child can read and research but cannot write files or run commands that need approval. - `permission: allow` makes Harness accept every card automatically. The delegated task can then do anything Reasonix's tools can do in that workspace. - Change the policy only in your own `cordis.patch.yml`, for a task and workspace you would approve wholesale. Details, what the parent receives, and limits: [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](../../docs/DSH.md). ## Versions The provider version must equal your `dsh` version. This release pins `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2. --- ## 中文 [官网](https://reasonix.io) · [文档](../../docs/DSH.md) · [源码](../../README.md) 把 [Reasonix](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix) 作为子智能体接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`）。本包只有配置，没有代码：一层补丁，让 Harness 的 `subagent-acp` 提供方去启动 `reasonix acp`，并以 `reasonix` 工具的形式暴露给模型。 **安装前** 1. 在同一台机器上安装 Reasonix 并运行一次 `reasonix setup`。Reasonix 只从自己的主目录读取模型密钥，不读环境变量，所以 Harness 无法替它传密钥。 2. 保证运行 `dsh` 的进程的 `PATH` 里有 `reasonix`。 **安装** ```sh dsh plugin --profile add github:esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix#path:/integrations/dsh-plugin ``` 包不在 npm 上：`pnpm` 通过 `path:` 选择器安装本仓库的 `integrations/dsh-plugin` 子目录（见 [pnpm package sources](https://pnpm.io/package-sources)）。 **安装后：打开开关** 插件装好后默认是“关闭”的。到 DSH Web 界面的插件页打开它的开关。 - 开关和两个组件都显示 Running 才算生效。在运行中的 `dsh web` 里直接打开就够了，下一个新会话里就有 `reasonix` 工具（在 `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2 上实测）；仍然没有再重启 `dsh`。 - 没打开时，模型可能改在自己的 shell 里直接运行 `reasonix -p`。 - 这看起来像委派，其实不是：没有子智能体，下面的权限策略也不起作用。 **权限** - 默认 `permission: reject`：Reasonix 弹出的每个审批卡都会被拒绝，子智能体只能读和调研，不能写文件或执行需要批准的命令。 - `permission: allow` 会让 Harness 自动同意所有审批卡，被委派的任务可以在该工作区里做 Reasonix 工具能做的任何事。 - 只在你自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，为你愿意整体放行的任务和工作区才改成 `allow`。 详细说明见 [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](../../docs/DSH.md)。 **版本**：提供方版本必须与你的 `dsh` 版本一致，本版本固定为 `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2。
