Open source · MIT · runs on your computer, model of your choice

An open-source coding agent for your terminal, desktop, browser and editor.

It reads your project, edits files and runs commands and tests. Have it ask before each step, or work on its own within limits you set. Files its edit tools changed can be rewound. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app.

Maintained by Huahui Yu.

> [!IMPORTANT] > **Community · 加入社区** — bilingual Discord for setup help (`#help` / `#求助`), workflow showcases, and feature ideas. → **** > > QQ group **DeepSeek-Reasonix官方群** (`1093562660`) → **** ([QR code](./docs/assets/qq-group.svg)) > Douyin: **做游戏的小鱼** (Douyin ID `22703872788`) · [QR code](./docs/assets/douyin.png)
## ❤️Sponsor
Thanks to Right Code for sponsoring this project! Right Code reliably provides routing services for models such as Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini, with both pay-as-you-go and monthly subscription billing options available. Invoices are available upon top-up, and enterprise and team users can receive dedicated one-on-one support. Register via this link.
Thanks to PackyCode for sponsoring this project! Access leading AI models through PackyCode with one API endpoint and one API key, with automatic failover and dedicated high-speed routes for Codex and Claude Code. Register via this link.
## What it is Reasonix is an open-source AI coding assistant. The program runs on your computer; the AI model is a service you configure, which receives what it reads. You describe a task in plain language; it reads code, edits files and runs commands and tests inside the project folder you choose, and shows you each step. You pick the model: a DeepSeek preset is built in, any OpenAI-compatible service is one config entry, and you pay the model provider directly. ## What you get - **Read, edit, run.** It reads code, edits files and runs tests and commands, all inside your project folder. - **Permission levels.** Have it ask every time, or let everyday actions run on their own; your forbid rules always hold. To see the approach first, use plan mode: it starts work only once you approve. - **Rewind.** A file is saved before it changes, so you can rewind by conversation turn without touching your git history. Only files its edit tools changed are covered, not what a shell command did. ## 30-second start Download, add a model key, open a project. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app. 1. Download and install the desktop app, Reasonix Studio, from the [releases page](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true). 2. Open it and enter your model provider and key when asked. 3. Open your project folder and write what you want, for example "add retry on failure to the http client". 4. At the level you chose, it stops and asks before anything that needs your say-so. Allow it to continue, or refuse. Prefer a terminal? Download the `reasonix` command-line tool, run `reasonix setup` to pick a model, then run `reasonix`. See [Install](#install) and [Quick start](#quick-start). ## Four ways to use it - **Desktop app (Studio).** A graphical app; the best place to start. - **Terminal.** A full-screen text interface; `reasonix run "task"` also works in scripts. - **Browser.** `reasonix web` opens a web interface on your own machine. - **Editor.** Install the extension in VS Code; other editors that support ACP (Agent Client Protocol, a common way for an editor to connect to an AI assistant) can connect to `reasonix acp`. All four are the same program underneath. What follows is for advanced users and contributors. ## Use it from DeepSeek Harness DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) can hand a task to Reasonix as a subagent over ACP. This repository publishes a plugin index for it: 1. Run `reasonix setup` on the machine that runs `dsh`. In the DSH Web UI turn on Custom plugin markets (Plugins, More) and add this index in the Discover tab: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/studio/integrations/dsh-plugin/market-index.json` 2. Install "Reasonix subagent" from it. 3. Open the plugin's page and turn its switch on. While it is off the model has no `reasonix` tool and may run `reasonix -p` in its own shell, which looks like a delegation and is not one. Setup details, the permission policy and limits are in [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](./docs/DSH.md). ## Versions Reasonix ships on two lines. See the [version roadmap announcement](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/discussions/10748) for the reasoning behind the split. | Line | Branch | Status | Get it | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Reasonix 2.x** | `studio` (this branch) | Active development | [Studio releases](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) | | **Reasonix 1.x** | [`main-v2`](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/tree/main-v2) | Maintenance / stable | `npm i -g reasonix` · [desktop download](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start) | - **Want something stable?** Stay on 1.x. It keeps receiving bug fixes, provider/API compatibility, updater and security fixes; its core architecture is no longer being extended. - **Want the new architecture?** Use 2.x Reasonix Studio. It is still moving quickly; reports are welcome. Valuable fixes, tests and behaviour from 1.x are reviewed one by one and ported or reimplemented on 2.x where they fit the new architecture. - [Moving from 1.x to 2.x](./docs/MIGRATING.md): what the two lines share, and how to run both on one machine without losing sessions. - [2.x roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md): what 2.x still has to deliver, how it ships, and the decisions still open. ## Features Technical highlights for advanced users. - **Config-driven.** Providers, the agent, enabled tools, and plugins are all declared in `reasonix.toml`. No hardcoded models. - **Multi-model & composable.** DeepSeek ships as a preset; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a config entry, not new code. Optionally run two models together (executor + planner) in separate, cache-stable sessions. - **Plugin-driven.** MCP servers contribute tools, prompts, and resources; Extension Protocol v1 sidecars can also intercept runtime events, contribute Providers and structured UI, and ship versioned plugin packages. - **Cache-aware context maintenance.** Startup injects a small stable environment summary, stale tool output is snipped/pruned before summary compaction, and the built-in tool schema contract is documented for regression review. - **Zero-friction distribution.** `CGO_ENABLED=0` single binary; cross-compile to six targets with one command. The result is a fully self-contained static binary — nothing to install on the target machine beyond the binary itself. ## Install This branch is **Reasonix 2.x**. Its desktop app is Reasonix Studio; the CLI, Studio, and editor integrations all run the same local Reasonix engine. ### Reasonix Studio (2.x) Download the package for your platform from the latest [Studio release](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) (tagged `studio-v2.*`; candidates such as `-rc.N` are marked as pre-releases): | Platform | Package | Architecture | | --- | --- | --- | | macOS | `.dmg` or `.zip` | Apple Silicon (`arm64`) / Intel (`amd64`) | | Windows | Installer `-installer.exe` or portable `.zip` | x64 | | Linux | `.deb`, `.rpm`, or `.AppImage` (download only) | x64 (`amd64`) / ARM64 (`arm64`, aarch64) | Every package ships with a `.minisig` signature, and the release carries `SHA256SUMS`. Once installed, Studio updates itself in place. The same release also carries the 2.x `reasonix` CLI as archives for `darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64`. ### Reasonix 1.x (stable) The 1.x CLI installs through npm on any supported platform, or Homebrew on macOS: ```sh npm i -g reasonix # any OS; pulls the prebuilt native binary brew install esengine/reasonix/reasonix # macOS ``` The 1.x desktop app is on the [official download page](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start). Windows installers are code-signed with a Certum code-signing certificate. ### VS Code extension The extension does not bundle the CLI; it starts your local `reasonix acp` backend and adds native chat, editor context, tool-call approvals, model selection, and workspace sessions. Install the 1.x CLI first. - **VS Code:** [install from Visual Studio Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=SivanLiu.reasonix-agent) - **VSCodium / Eclipse Theia:** [install from Open VSX Registry](https://open-vsx.org/extension/SivanLiu/reasonix-agent) - **Extension ID:** `SivanLiu.reasonix-agent` · [source and usage guide](https://github.com/SivanCola/reasonix-vscode) ### Build from source Clone the repository; `studio` builds 2.x and `main-v2` builds 1.x: ```sh git clone https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix.git cd DeepSeek-Reasonix git switch studio ``` #### CLI The CLI build requires **Go 1.25+**. The module pins a `toolchain` directive; keep `GOTOOLCHAIN=auto` so Go downloads the pinned toolchain, or install it. ```sh make build # -> bin/reasonix(.exe) make cross # -> dist/ (darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64) ``` #### Studio Studio additionally requires **Node 24+ and pnpm 10** (`npm install -g pnpm@10`) for the frontend. ```sh make studio ``` See the [Studio build guide](desktop/README.md#prerequisites) for platform webview dependencies and Linux build tags. ## Quick start ### Reasonix Studio Install and launch Studio, then connect a provider and model in the app. No CLI setup is needed. ### CLI / TUI ```sh reasonix setup # configure a provider and model reasonix # start an interactive session reasonix run "implement the TODOs in main.go" ``` In an interactive session, run `/init` when you want Reasonix to create project instructions. evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# 忆泡 · DSH 插件（dsh-memory-bubble）v0.1

把 AI 与你的日常对话，沉淀成一张可管理、可继承的暖色记忆泡泡图。
宿主半负责「抽取 / 存储 / 简报 / 注入」，客户端半负责「可视化 / 编辑 / 托盘」。

## 目录

```
plugin/
├─ package.json            dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client 声明
├─ cordis.patch.yml        loader 插入行（id: memory-bubble）
├─ lib/
│  ├─ index.js             宿主半：事件折叠、去抖总结、模型调用、简报、注入、路由、工具
│  ├─ core.js              纯逻辑：抽取合并、布局、简报、撤销、导入导出、提示词（零依赖，可单测）
│  ├─ store.js             状态持久化：<profile>/.memory-bubble/state.json（原子写 + .bak）
│  └─ client.js            客户端半：单文件、只依赖 react、无 JSX，经 __ModuleLoader__ 加载
└─ dev/
   ├─ test-core.mjs        纯逻辑测试（node dev/test-core.mjs）
   ├─ test-host.mjs        宿主集成测试：伪造 ctx + webServer，跑完整 HTTP 流程
   └─ test-client.mjs      客户端冒烟测试：伪造 ModuleLoader/react/document/fetch
```

## 用户能用到的东西

| 位置 | 组件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 左侧栏 | 「忆泡」图标（`sidebar.panellist`） | 打开整幅记忆图 |
| 主面板 | 泡泡图（`main`，key=`memory-bubble`） | 暖色泡泡、三档语义缩放、点泡看详情、改重要性滑杆、编辑/删除、冲突连线、搜索、撤销上一批、导出/导入 |
| 输入框左侧 | 「忆泡」药丸（`conversation.input.left`） | 当前会话记忆数，点开主面板 |
| 设置页 | 「忆泡」分区（`settings.section`） | 自动总结开关、去抖/最小间隔、注入方式、摘要条数、导出/导入 |
| 对话注入 | `systemPrompt.section` + `agent/pre-step` 兜底 | 每轮把稳定简报注入上下文；深度模式可写在 system prompt 里提高缓存命中 |
| 工具 | `memory_search` / `memory_brief` / `memory_remember` / `memory_link` / `memory_forget` | 让 AI 自己查记忆、主动记一条、连线、删除 |

交互要点：滚轮缩放（三档信息层级）、拖动平移、双击自适应、点泡泡看卡片、Shift+点泡泡放进本轮托盘（「注入本对话」）、点连线看关系并「重新校验冲突」、Esc 关闭卡片。

## 数据与隐私

- 全部本地：`<profile>/.memory-bubble/state.json`（自动写 `.bak`，导出在 `exports/`）。
- 不联网、不遥测；只在本机调用用户配置的默认模型做「总结」（`llm.stream`）。
- 抽取时只发送最近窗口的对话（`maxTranscriptChars`，默认 6000 字符），不发送整段历史。

## HTTP 路由（同源，客户端直接 fetch）

```
GET  /memory-bubble/api/health
GET  /memory-bubble/api/graph?sessionId=&scope=all|session
GET  /memory-bubble/api/config
POST /memory-bubble/api/config            { config | patch }
POST /memory-bubble/api/extract           { sessionId, force }     // 手动「总结这一轮」
POST /memory-bubble/api/rollback          { sessionId | batchId }  // 撤销上一批
POST /memory-bubble/api/node              { id, patch, sessionId }
POST /memory-bubble/api/node/create       { title, summary, keywords, importance, sessionId }
POST /memory-bubble/api/node/delete       { id, sessionId }
POST /memory-bubble/api/edge              { id, patch }
POST /memory-bubble/api/edge/delete       { id }
POST /memory-bubble/api/tray              { sessionId, add|remove|nodeId|clear }
POST /memory-bubble/api/session           { sessionId, enabled }
POST /memory-bubble/api/export
POST /memory-bubble/api/import            { graph }
GET  /memory-bubble/api/batch?sessionId=
```

## 自动总结的时序

1. `session/event` 折叠本会话的 `user/message`（只认 `source.kind === 'user'`，跳过运行时上下文/技能/忆泡简报自身）与 `assistant/message`。
2. `turn/end` 触发去抖（默认 15s，同一会话至少间隔 90s），`ctx.effect` 管理定时器。
3. 调 `llm.stream`（默认模型 + 最近对话 + 「已有记忆标题」避免重复），解析 JSON 抽取结果。
4. 合并进图谱：近似标题/关键词判重、追加时效、更新频率；整批写入可撤销（`rollback`）。
5. 重算布局与稳定简报；客户端下一次打开/轮询即看到新泡泡。

## 装进 DSH（后续单独对话验证）

三条路，任选其一：

1. **本地 file: 安装（推荐先试）**：在 profile 下执行 `pnpm add "file:<repo>/plugin"`，然后在 `cordis.yml` 的 loader 里加一行 `memory-bubble`（或让 `plugin_manager` 安装），刷新 Web GUI。
2. **复制进 node_modules**：把 `plugin/` 复制为 `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-memory-bubble`，在 `cordis.yml` 的 loader 列表插入 `{ id: memory-bubble, name: dsh-memory-bubble }`，刷新页面。
3. **发布 npm 后**用 `plugin_manager install_bundle` 正式安装（bundle 自带 `cordis.patch.yml`，无需手改 loader）。

> 本会话审批策略为 `never`，安装类操作会被自动拒绝，所以只在本地完成了代码与自测；安装与真机验证放到下一个对话。

## 自测

```
cd plugin
node dev/test-core.mjs     # 12 项：合并/去重/布局/简报/撤销/导入导出/解析健壮性
node dev/test-host.mjs     # 12 项：apply 注册、事件折叠、去抖、总结、编辑、托盘、工具、注入、持久化
node dev/test-client.mjs   # 客户端模块加载、四个 slot、渲染冒烟
node --check lib/client.js # 客户端单文件语法
```

当前结果：core 12/12、host 12/12、client 3/3、`node --check` 通过。

## 已知未验证点（真机待确认）

- 真实 DSH 里 `llm.stream` 的调用形状与失败表现（代码已兼容 `finish` 块报错、provider 缺失回退到 `llm.listProviders()`）。
- `agent.ctx.systemPrompt.section` 是否在运行时可见（已做特性探测，失败则只走 `agent/pre-step` 追加注入）。
- 深色模式目前用 `html[data-mb-theme]` + `prefers-color-scheme` 双兜底，接入 DSH 主题服务后可视需要切换为 `--dsw-alias-*`。
- 安装路径三选一需在真机确认，`file:` spec 是否被 `plugin_manager` 接受尚未实测。

# 忆泡 Memory Bubble

> 把 AI 日常对话里沉淀的记忆，养成一张**会呼吸的泡泡图**——人看得见、管得住；AI 读得到、带得走。

**忆泡**是一个面向「日常和 AI 聊天的人」的记忆工具：每轮对话结束后，插件用你的默认模型自动总结出一条条记忆点，画成一张暖色泡泡图。泡泡大小 = 重要性（可手动改），离中心远近 = 出现频率；AI 每轮会收到一条稳定简报，所以它**记得住你**，而你不必把整段历史重复喂给它。

- 🫧 **看得见**：每个圆是一个记忆点，点开能改；连线是记忆之间的关系，冲突会亮红灯
- 🧠 **带得走**：一键导出 JSON，换聊天窗口/换模型/换设备都能继承（其他 AI 也按同一份 schema 读取）
- ✂️ **可控上下文**：稳定简报进上下文，托盘按需钉选，避免「聊到后面 AI 忘了前面」
- 🪟 **暖色、像在泡泡里**：奶油底、蜜桃气泡、三档语义缩放，深浅色跟随系统

![默认中景视图](assets/preview.png)

> 图上每颗泡泡都是真实交互：拖动滑杆改重要性会实时变大，点连线能看关系与冲突，Shift+点泡泡放进「本轮记忆托盘」。

## 三个入口

### 1. 零门槛体验（离线原型，无需安装）

- **在线试玩（GitHub Pages）**：<https://eveneve-night.github.io/memory-bubble/>
- 或直接下载 [`prototype/index.html`](prototype/index.html)，双击用 Chrome / Edge 打开（单文件、零依赖、不联网）
- 玩法：滚轮三档缩放 → 点泡泡看详情/改重要性 → 点连线看关系 → 搜索 → 托盘注入 → 刷新后数据仍在（localStorage）

### 2. 在 DeepSeek Harness 里使用（插件）

**先下载**：[插件包 v0.1.0](https://github.com/Eveneve-night/memory-bubble/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-memory-bubble-v0.1.0.zip)（解压即得 `dsh-memory-bubble/` 目录）

#### 方式 A：本地安装（当前版本）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Eveneve-night/memory-bubble.git
cd memory-bubble
```

在 DSH 的 profile 目录里把它加进依赖，并在 loader（`cordis.yml`）插入一行 `memory-bubble`：

```bash
# profile 目录（桌面版默认在 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop）
pnpm add "file:<path-to-clone>/plugin"
```

```yaml
# cordis.yml 的 loader 列表里加入（或让 plugin_manager 安装 bundle）
- id: memory-bubble
  name: dsh-memory-bubble
```

刷新 Web GUI 后，左栏出现「忆泡」图标即安装成功。

#### 方式 B：复制进 `node_modules`

把 `plugin/` 复制为 `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-memory-bubble`，再在 `cordis.yml` 里插入上面那行。

> npm 包发布后会补上 `plugin_manager install_bundle` 的一行安装方式（bundle 自带 `cordis.patch.yml`，不需要手改 loader）。

安装后的入口：**左栏「忆泡」图标**（整幅记忆图）、**输入框左侧药丸**（当前会话记忆数）、**设置页「忆泡」分区**（自动总结开关、去抖间隔、注入方式、导入导出）。

### 3. 开发 / 自测

```bash
cd plugin
node dev/test-core.mjs     # 12 项纯逻辑测试
node dev/test-host.mjs     # 12 项宿主集成测试（伪造 ctx + 真实 HTTP 全流程）
node dev/test-client.mjs   # 客户端冒烟（伪造 ModuleLoader/react）
node --check lib/client.js
```

## 它在 AI 那边怎么工作

```
你的每一轮对话
   ├─ session/event 折叠（只认真实用户消息，跳过运行时上下文/技能注入）
   ├─ turn/end 去抖（默认 15s，同会话≥90s）→ 调默认模型抽取 JSON
   ├─ 合并入图：近似判重、追加时效、更新频率（整批可撤销）
   ├─ 稳定简报：固定顺序、动态尾注，同样的记忆产出同样的前缀（保 KV 缓存）
   └─ 下一轮注入：systemPrompt.section（primary）或 agent/pre-step（fallback）
```

AI 也能主动调用 5 个工具：`memory_brief`（读简报）、`memory_search`（检索）、`memory_remember`（记一条）、`memory_link`（连线）、`memory_forget`（遗忘/降权）。

## 数据与隐私

- 全部保存在本机 `<profile>/.memory-bubble/state.json`（临时文件 + `.bak` 原子写；导出在 `exports/`）
- 不联网、不遥测；「总结」走你已配置的默认模型（`llm.stream`）
- 抽取只发送最近窗口（默认 6000 字符），不发送整段历史
- 导出格式见 [`schema/memory-bubble-v1.schema.json`](schema/memory-bubble-v1.schema.json)，其他 AI/宿主可按此读写记忆

## 目录

```
docs/      设计与可行性文档（DESIGN §12 是实现状态；FEASIBILITY 为设计轮报告）
plugin/    DSH 插件：lib/{core,store,index,client}.js + dev/ 三套自测 + README
prototype/ 离线可点原型（单文件）
schema/    对外 import/export JSON Schema
assets/    README 截图
```

## 现状与路线

- ✅ v0.1：宿主半 + 客户端半完成，本地自检 core 12/12、host 12/12、client 3/3
- ⏳ 真机安装验证（下一个对话）：`llm.stream` 调用形状、`agent.ctx.systemPrompt` 可见性、主题 token 接入
- 🔜 发布 npm 包（一行安装）→ 更多宿主适配（Web / 移动端）→ 记忆自动归档与「遗忘曲线」

已知取舍：记忆抽取是**摘要式**的，不做向量检索（图 + 简报足够小，先把「看得见」做对）；冲突检测是启发式，需要人确认。

## License

dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck

**中文** · [English](docs/README.en.md) **拨开战争迷雾看见终点，剩下的交给 MattSkillsDeck。** 让 [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) 在 DSH 里化作游戏系统的任务面板。 你的 ⭐是我夜空中最亮的星。 *Part the fog of war, see the end — MattSkillsDeck handles the rest.* [![版本](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck?label=%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck) [![下载量](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fapi.npmjs.org%2Fdownloads%2Fpoint%2Flast-month%2Fdsh-mattpocock-skills-deck&query=%24.downloads&label=%E4%B8%8B%E8%BD%BD%E9%87%8F&suffix=%2F%E6%9C%88&color=brightgreen)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck) [![下载总量](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck?label=%E4%B8%8B%E8%BD%BD%E6%80%BB%E9%87%8F&color=red)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck) [![最近更新](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck?label=%E6%9C%80%E8%BF%91%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0&color=FE7D37)](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck/commits/main) [![月提交](https://img.shields.io/github/commit-activity/m/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck?label=%E6%8F%90%E4%BA%A4%E6%95%B0&color=DFAB01)](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck/graphs/commit-activity) [![技能包](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E6%8A%80%E8%83%BD%E5%8C%85-mattpocock%2Fskills-9D7CD8)](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) [![欢迎提交PR🌹](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E6%AC%A2%E8%BF%8E%E6%8F%90%E4%BA%A4PR%F0%9F%8C%B9-red.svg)](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck/issues) 欢迎提交PR，不要求完美无瑕，有缺陷也会在合入后进行优化而不是拒绝，星星之火🔥可以燎原！
唯一要求：使用技能 /pr 填写PR信息。

INSTALL
安装

```bash # ① 安装 DSH CLI（已装跳过） npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh # ② 安装 MattSkillsDeck —— --profile 必填：装进你实际使用的 DSH 入口对应的 profile # （装错 profile 等于没装，重启多少次都不会加载） dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck # 用自启 web 服务（dsh web） # 或者 dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck # 用 DSH Desktop 桌面应用 # 锁定最新版更稳（当前 1.9.0-beta.22）： dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck@1.9.0-beta.22 --registry https://registry.npmjs.org # 或者 dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck@1.9.0-beta.22 --registry https://registry.npmjs.org ``` > **用 GitHub 后端前的权限前提**：插件替你改 ISSUE，用的是本机 `gh` 已登录账号的权限——建标签、改票需要仓库的 `push` 权限；改指派、流转标签需要 `triage` 权限。账号在该仓库只有 `只读` 权限时，插件会把仓库如实标成只读：改票、打标签与标签流转不可用，浏览与刷新照常。

BOARD
任务板

DSH侧边栏-总览任务面板全貌。通过插件内置SKILLS的任务拆分，可以做到session并发处理。效率加倍省心。
👇 列表中展示：探索地图、实施地图、普通ISSUE。并且提供便捷按钮一键注入prompt。
 👇 实战案例：任务经过拆分，可以大量同时执行任务。
👇 地图详情：像素风卡片呈现所有可以执行的任务。
 👇 单票详情：描述、验收、进度、评论等信息不再需要打开原始文件。

STATUSBAR
对话框胶囊栏

胶囊状态栏：核心信息直接呈现，快捷入口方便高效。
👇 可接任务、故障、需要诊断分流、刷新、ISSUE处理路径表。清晰可见。
 👇 工作路线：清晰展示当前会话处理ISSUE的心路历程。

DEMAND
新增需求

新增需求：在“探索流程”和“实施流程”中二选一，通过插件引导最终将所有IDEA落地。
👇 右侧面板，按需选择不同流程。
 👇 胶囊栏，按需选择不同流程。

SKILLS
技能面板

内置 27 个技能（v1.3.1）：同时提供技能原文，在使用过程中提供便利的学习原文途径。
👇 可以注入到对话框。可以查看技能详情
 👇 技能详情页面，方便学习原始技能。

BACKENDS · ENV
多后端切换与环境检查

根据办公环境不同提供多样后端：GitHub、本地 Markdown、GitLab。
👇 在不同后端中进行切换。
 👇 环境逐项自检。如果不准确点击刷新重新检测。

VERSION
版本管理

提供简化的版本管理页面，方便查看。
👇 改动：fetch、pull、push、add、commit
 👇 提交历史
 👇 工作树

APPEARANCE
设置与外观

按钮颜色 = label标签颜色。调色板可以给每类标签配置颜色。
👇 设置主页
 👇 调色板：设置标签颜色可以改变按钮颜色。

INIT FLOW
初始化流程

六步完成工作区的初始化。
👇 第 1 步：选择工作区并新建会话
 👇 第 2 步：新会话提示选择后端
👇 第 3 步：选择后端为 GitHub
 👇 第 4 步：点击确认后注入提示词
👇 第 5 步：等待 AI 执行初始化
 👇 第 6 步：环境检测不通过时需要补齐并刷新。

JOIN
欢迎您加入我们

非常欢迎提交PR、共同维护项目，现在迭代中很缺对markdown后端的开发和完善，Gitlab目前无人力开发。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-prompt-predict
Codex-style composer predictions for DeepSeek Harness
After each reply, your next prompt is ghosted right into the composer — Tab to accept, Esc to dismiss, start typing and it's gone

🌏 中文 · English
`dsh-prompt-predict` is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/) plugin: after every assistant turn it predicts **the message you are most likely to type next** and floats it into the composer as gray ghost text. The suggestion never enters the editor — only pressing `Tab` inserts it, and even then it stays undoable — so a wrong prediction costs you nothing. ## 📑 Table of Contents - [✨ Features](#-features) - [🚀 Installation](#-installation) - [⌨️ Usage](#-usage) - [⚙️ Settings](#-settings) - [🔌 HTTP API](#-http-api) - [🧩 How it works](#-how-it-works) - [🛠️ Development](#-development) - [🔐 Security and cost](#-security-and-cost) - [🩺 Troubleshooting](#-troubleshooting) - [⚠️ Known limitations](#-known-limitations) - [📄 License](#-license) ## ✨ Features - **Single-line or multi-line** — sentences stay one line; code snippets, lists and multi-paragraph replies keep their line breaks and indentation - **A suggestion the moment a reply ends** — gray ghost text rendered at the composer's first character, matching the editor's caret position, font size and line height - **Four interactions** — `Tab` to accept, `Alt+→` (`⌥→` on macOS) to accept piece by piece, `↻` for a different suggestion, `Esc` to dismiss; typing hides it, and clearing the draft brings it back - **Lightweight context** — only the most recent user/assistant *text*; tool results, attachments and system prompts never leave your machine - **Follows the current session model by default** — nothing is hard-coded to a provider, the prediction call reuses whatever model the session itself uses; you can also pin a cheaper model - **No repeats, no dead ends** — a repeat of the previous suggestion triggers an automatic "give me a different one"; a reasoning level the real model doesn't support falls back automatically, so you never hit "settings look fine but no suggestion ever appears" - **Everything is adjustable** — on/off, provider / model, response timeout, context size and budget, output cap, reasoning effort; changes apply immediately, no DSH restart - **Light and dark** — the ghost text, settings page and history follow the system/app colour scheme (`prefers-color-scheme`), with contrast kept at WCAG AA in both - **The UI follows your language** — the plugin ships dictionaries for the languages DSH itself supports (Chinese and English), and passes every dictionary it has to the locale service. Switch Settings → Language and the whole plugin UI changes at once, including the ghost hint above the composer **and the validation errors inside Settings** (those are produced by the host, which answers in the language the client sends); no reload needed, and it falls back to Chinese when no locale service is present - **Zero runtime dependencies** — plain ESM on both the host and client side ## 🚀 Installation The plugin is published on npm. Options are ordered by convenience. ### Install inside DSH (recommended) **GUI**: open the plugins page → **Add plugin** → enter the package name `dsh-prompt-predict` → install. **Or the dsh CLI** — pin any published version with pnpm's `@version` syntax: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-prompt-predict@0.2.8 ``` Replace `--profile` with your own profile (usually `desktop` on the desktop app, `web` for the web build), then **restart DSH**. **Upgrade to the latest release** ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-prompt-predict@latest # or: bash scripts/update.sh ``` `scripts/update.sh` (optionally takes a profile name or directory) converges the dependency spec *and* the lockfile, and refuses to run while the app is still up — quit it first. The settings page also has a **Check for updates** button next to the version; it detects the running environment (desktop app / web build) and pre-fills the profile in the update command. The composer also checks automatically once per session and shows a dismissible notice when a newer version exists (dismissal is remembered per version, and the settings page can restore a dismissed notice with one click — no localStorage digging). > ⚠️ **The CLI only installs the package.** DSH loads a plugin only when it is also listed in > `dsh.profile.bundles` inside `~/.dsh/profiles//package.json`. Verified: with the package > installed but not in that list, the plugin's routes answer `404` and nothing loads. The GUI route > above handles it for you; with the CLI add `"dsh-prompt-predict"` to that array yourself, or just > run `scripts/install.sh` below, which does both steps. > You'll find the switch and all parameters under **Settings → Prompt Suggestions**. ### Install from a release tarball Every [release](https://github.com/ferrisching/dsh-prompt-predict/releases) carries the exact tarball that is on npm (`shasum` matches the registry), which is handy for offline machines or for pinning an artifact you can verify: ```bash gh release download v0.2.8 --repo ferrisching/dsh-prompt-predict --pattern '*.tgz' dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-prompt-predict-0.2.8.tgz ``` Same caveat as the CLI route above: add `"dsh-prompt-predict"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` yourself, or run `scripts/install.sh` instead. ### Install from source ```bash git clone https://github.com/ferrisching/dsh-prompt-predict.git cd dsh-prompt-predict bash scripts/install.sh # make sure the app is fully quit first (Cmd+Q) — the script refuses to run while it is up ``` The script packs this repo on the fly, installs it into the profile's `node_modules`, and adds `dsh-prompt-predict` to `dsh.profile.bundles`. The default target is `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`; for another profile: ```bash bash scripts/install.sh ~/.dsh/profiles/web ``` **Restart DSH afterwards**, then look under **Settings → Prompt Suggestions**. ### Manual install ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add dsh-prompt-predict # from npm # or link local source (symlink — handy while developing): pnpm add /path/to/dsh-prompt-predict ``` Then open that profile's `package.json` and add `"dsh-prompt-predict"` to the `dsh.profile.bundles` array, and restart DSH. ### Requirements - Verified on **DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`** (web build; the desktop app runs the same host and client code) - `node` / `pnpm`: the install script prefers DSH's own runtime under `~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/*/dependencies` and only falls back to `PATH` - macOS / Linux; Windows untested ## ⌨️ Usage 1. Chat normally, wait for the assistant to finish its turn, and leave the **composer empty** 2. About 350 ms later a gray suggestion appears, with `Tab` / `↻` / `Esc` on its right 3. Pick what you need: | Action | Effect | |---|---| | `Tab` | Accept the whole thing while the composer is focused (only now is it inserted, and it stays undoable) | | `Alt+→` (`Option+→` / `⌥→` on macOS) | **Accept piece by piece** — a couple of characters at a time in CJK, one word in Latin; the rest keeps floating, stop whenever you like | | `↻` (button on the right) | **Reroll** — ask the model for a different suggestion | | `↓` | Replace the suggestion with the next one — cycles the 2–3 candidates, and at the last one (or with a single suggestion) requests a fresh one. With no suggestion showing and an empty composer, it fetches one immediately. `Ctrl/⌘+↓` works as a fallback if the plain key is swallowed | | `↑` | With 2–3 candidates, step back to the previous one | | `Ctrl/⌘+Shift+Space` | Trigger a prediction by hand; rerolls when one is already showing | | `Esc` | Dismiss this one | | Just start typing | It disappears; **clearing the draft brings it back** (only `Esc` is a permanent dismissal) | Suggestions only appear when the composer is empty and the session isn't running. Switching sessions or interrupting a reply clears any pending suggestion. ## ⚙️ Settings **Settings → Prompt Suggestions**: | Setting | Description | Default | |---|---|---| | Enable predictions | Master switch | On | | Provider / model | Model used for the prediction call; pick "Follow current session model" to reuse the session's own model | Follow current session model | | Response timeout (advanced) | 1–60 seconds | 12 seconds | | Context size (advanced) | Small 3 / Standard 8 / Large 12 messages | Standard 8 | | Context budget (advanced) | Character cap sent to the helper call, 1000–20000 | 6000 | | Output length | How long a suggestion should be, in **characters** (20–400) — no token maths. Pinning a Latin-script language also shows the equivalent in words; CJK stays in characters because word segmentation is undefined there. The host derives a generous token safety cap from it (per language) and writes the character budget into the prompt; a reply that still gets cut is retried with more room and marked **cut off · raise the output length** | 120 | | Keep multi-line formatting | Allow code snippets/lists to keep line breaks and indentation (off = always one line; this is not about multiple suggestions) | On | | Candidates | 1 = one suggestion; 2–3 = generate that many alternatives, shown one at a time and cycled with ↑/↓ (more quota, slower) | 1 | | Replace limit | Max replaces per reply round (0–10; `0` = unlimited). At the limit it cycles the already generated suggestions instead of calling the model | 3 | | Reasoning effort (advanced) | Options are **generated from the model actually in use** (the session's model when following it); unsupported levels never appear | Off (fastest, cheapest) | | Suggestion language | `Auto` follows the conversation; pin a language and every suggestion is written in it. 14 mainstream languages are listed up front, the rest fold behind **More languages…**, and languages with regional variants get a second **Region** dropdown: Simplified Chinese (Mainland China / Singapore / Malaysia), Traditional Chinese (Taiwan / Hong Kong), English (US / UK / Australia / Canada), Portuguese (Brazil / Portugal), Spanish (Spain / Latin America (neutral) / Mexico / Argentina / Colombia), French (France / Canada), German (Germany / Austria / Switzerland), Dutch (Netherlands / Belgium). The chosen variant is named explicitly in the prompt (e.g. *Traditional Chinese (Taiwan)*, *British English*) | Auto | | Pause | Stops predictions for ten minutes with a countdown, then resumes automatically; the deadline survives a reload | Off | | History size (advanced) | How many recent predictions the settings page keeps (0–50; `0` turns history off). Records live in the app's own local storage — the Electron renderer's storage in the desktop app, the page's `localStorage` on web — and are never uploaded | 10 | The bottom of the settings page shows a **recent predictions** list (default 10, adjustable): time, session, model, latency, and whether the reasoning level was auto-downgraded, a reroll happened, the suggestion was truncated by the output cap, or the call failed (with the reason). The list stays folded to the newest run (`▸ Show all` opens the rest), the newest run's suggestion text is expanded by default, and clicking a row's `▸` expands that run's text while collapsing the previous one. Records live in the app's own local storage (the Electron renderer's storage on desktop, the page's `localStorage` on web) and are never uploaded. No more guessing why nothing appeared. - Changes take effect **immediately** — no DSH restart - Settings are stored at `~/.dsh/dsh-prompt-predict/config.json` (mode 600) - Precedence: **user-saved settings > cordis patch deploy defaults > built-in defaults** ## 🔌 HTTP API The plugin registers a same-origin prefix route `/dsh-prompt-predict` on DSH's web server; both the settings page and the composer suggestion go through it. Every endpoint is authenticated with DSH's browser cookie (`connection.requestRejection`) — off-machine callers get 401/403. | Method | Path | Description | |---|---|---| | GET | `/dsh-prompt-predict/status` | Current session model, effective settings, saved overrides, deploy defaults | | GET | `/dsh-prompt-predict/catalog` | All providers and models (for the dropdowns) | | GET | `/dsh-prompt-predict/efforts?provider=&model=` | The reasoning levels that model actually supports | | POST | `/dsh-prompt-predict/settings` | Save settings; `{ "reset": true }` restores defaults | | POST | `/dsh-prompt-predict/suggest` | `{ sessionId }` → one suggestion | Every endpoint accepts an optional **`x-dsh-locale`** header (`zh` / `en`, default Chinese) deciding which language validation errors and prediction failures come back in. The client sends the active UI language automatically. ## 🧩 How it works **Host side** (`lib/`) 1. `lib/index.js` is the plugin entry point and registers the same-origin HTTP route 2. On `suggest`, `lib/predict.mjs` trims the session down to the most recent user/assistant plain text — walking backwards under both a message-count limit and a character budget 3. That trimmed history is **framed as a single request-only user input** before it reaches the helper model: DSH assistant messages must carry a full `stream` / `replayState`, so a trimmed fragment cannot masquerade as one (same approach session-title uses) 4. The streamed reply is normalized (code fences, `Suggestion:` prefixes and wrapping quotes stripped, newlines collapsed) and returned to the client For model selection, `provider` / `model` set to `auto` means "follow the session": no route is hard-coded onto the helper call, and `predictNextPrompt` inherits whatever the session itself selected. **Client side** (`client/`) - Injects into the `conversation.composer.dock` (lifecycle mount point next to the composer) and `settings.section` slots - The ghost text is an **overlay** — it is never written into the Lexical editor; only accepting goes through `inputActions.insertText` ### Client source layout The client is built from ordered fragments in `client/src/` (`npm run build:client` writes `client/client.js`). DSH loads exactly one client script, so the split is a source-organisation aid, not native ES modules; `pretest` and `prepack` rebuild automatically. ### Real-DSH smoke test (macOS, optional) `npm run test:smoke` boots a disposable DSH profile, installs this repo as a local tarball, starts a local mock LLM and drives a headless Edge via CDP. It checks that: a real reply produces a ghost, `Tab` is ignored while another input is focused, `Tab` accepts inside the composer, reroll changes the suggestion, and pause hides/restores it. Requires the DeepSeek Harness app and Microsoft Edge; override paths with `DSH_SMOKE_DSH` and `DSH_SMOKE_EDGE`. It is deliberately not part of `npm test`. ## 🛠️ Development ```bash git clone https://github.com/ferrisching/dsh-prompt-predict.git cd dsh-prompt-predict npm test # 71 cases: 51 host-side + 20 client render smoke tests ``` ``` . ├── lib/ Host side (plain ESM, no build step) │ ├── index.js Plugin entry point, registers the HTTP route │ ├── host-route.mjs Same-origin API: status / catalog / efforts / settings / suggest │ ├── predict.mjs Session trimming, helper-model call, suggestion normalization │ ├── messages.mjs User-facing host copy (Chinese + English) │ └── config.mjs User settings persistence ├── client/ │ └── client.js Client: composer ghost-text overlay + settings page ├── test/ │ ├── predict.mjs 51 cases: trimming, cleanup, route inheritance, settings validation, degrade-retry, dedup, bilingual errors, HTTP end-to-end │ └── client-render.mjs 20 cases: renders the ghost overlay and settings page through a tiny React stand-in, incl. both locales and dictionary self-checks ├── scripts/ │ ├── install.sh One-shot install from a local pack │ └── update.sh Upgrade a profile to the npm latest ├── cordis.patch.yml Plugin mount patch └── package.json ``` > `test/client-render.mjs` is the only automated safety net for the client side: no browser needed — a tiny React stand-in expands the components into a plain object tree so the test can assert that the ghost shows up and that `Tab` / `↻` / `Esc` are all there. It exists because of a real incident: the overlay referenced a variable it never read from props, the render threw, React's error boundary swallowed it, and the symptom was "the API returns a suggestion but nothing ever appears" — while every host-side test was green. The tests need no DSH runtime: a fake ctx plus a local HTTP server cover route registration, settings validation, route inheritance and end-to-end calls. ## 🔐 Security and cost - **One** small helper call per assistant turn by default; an extra attempt only happens when the reply hits the length limit, the reasoning level needs downgrading, or a suggestion needs rerolling — **four calls is the hard ceiling** (primary, reasoning-level fallback, length retry, reroll), and they share a single timeout budget - Suggestions are **not written to the session log**; only after you accept with `Tab` and send does the text become a real message - Only trimmed user/assistant plain text is sent — tool results, attachments and system prompts never leave the machine - Both the settings page and the suggestion endpoint sit behind DSH's own browser-cookie authentication ## 🩺 Troubleshooting **No suggestion appears at all** - It runs only after an assistant turn ends (about 350 ms later), never while the reply is still streaming. - The composer must be empty. If you already have a draft, the prediction is skipped on purpose — no call is made. - A brand-new session with no messages has nothing to predict from. - Check Settings → Prompt suggestions: *Enable predictions* must be on, the session must not be paused, and **Recent predictions** must not show an error. **"Prediction failed: …" shows under the composer** (it appears after two failures in a row) | Reason text | What to do | |---|---| | `Request timed out` | Raise *Response timeout* in Advanced | | `Provider "…" is unavailable` / `has no model "…"` | Pin a provider and model instead of following the session model | | `Prompt prediction is turned off` | Turn the switch back on | | anything else | Open Settings → Prompt suggestions → **Recent predictions**; the row carries the host's exact reason | **Suggestions come in the wrong language** - `Auto` (the default) detects the language from your recent messages by majority vote over the last five, so a message that is mostly a pasted log can skew it. - Pin one instead: Settings → *Suggestion language* (with a *Region* picker for Chinese, English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German and Dutch). - The UI language does **not** affect the suggestion language — those are two separate settings. **A suggestion ends with "cut off · raise the output length"** - Raise *Output length*. A capped reply is already retried once with more room before the marker appears. - Reasoning models can spend a large part of the budget before writing any text; if this happens often, raise the length or keep *Reasoning effort* off (the default). **Tab does nothing** - `Tab` is intercepted only while a suggestion is visible; with no ghost it behaves normally. - Click into the composer first — the overlay is positioned over the editor's caret box, and `Tab` acts on the focused editor. **Ghost text sits on top of what I typed** - Fixed in `0.2.7`: it hides on paste, IME composition and drag-and-drop, and it no longer appears while the composer has a draft. Upgrade if you still see this. **"Recent predictions" is empty** - Records are local to the app's own storage, are wiped by the *Clear* button, and runs recorded before `0.2.5` carry no suggestion text. **I upgraded but nothing changed** - Host-side changes (settings fields, prompt construction) apply after **restarting the app**; client-side changes apply after **reloading the window**. The version label in `package.json` is not rewritten by a window reload. ## ⚠️ Known limitations - Verified only on DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`; other versions untested - Depends on the host's `conversation.composer.dock` and `settings.section` slot names — a major DSH update may require adapting - Predictions consume quota on the selected model; pinning a fast small model is cheaper than following a reasoning model ## 📄 License [MIT](LICENSE) © ferrisching Free to use, modify and distribute, including in closed-source commercial projects — just keep the copyright notice and license text. See [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md) for the change history ([中文](./CHANGELOG_zh.md)).

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # dsh-plugin-session-file-purge **Delete a DeepSeek Harness session *and* the files that session produced.** - 📖 **写给人的介绍（中文，可分享）**：[介绍.md](介绍.md) — 为什么需要它、怎么工作、怎么用、有哪些限制 - 📚 安装 / 接口 / 配置 / 排障：[中文说明](#中文说明) · [English](#english) --- ## 中文说明 ### 为什么需要这个插件 DSH 与大多数 harness 一样，**没有「会话 ↔ 文件」的台账**：会话日志里只有会话自身的数据，模型通过 shell、python、构建脚本写出来的文件，运行时一概不知道。所以现有的会话删除插件（例如 [`@pepsi-ai/dsh-plugin-session-delete`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pepsi-ai/dsh-plugin-session-delete)）只能删掉会话日志、投影缓存和工作区记账——工作目录里那些生成物，还得你自己动手清理。 这个插件补上这一段：**会话开始时给工作目录做一次基线快照，删除会话时把「基线之后新建/改动过的文件」列成可勾选的清单，先把选中项移入回收站，再删会话本身。** ``` ┌─ 删除会话 ─────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 会话：季度汇报整理 (1) │ │ 会话 ID：session-00000000-… │ │ │ │ 本次会话产生或改动的文件 │ │ 新建 · 3 [全选] [全不选] │ │ ☑ report.docx 1.2 MB │ │ ☑ charts/revenue.png 240 KB │ │ ☑ data/raw.csv 18 KB │ │ 改动 · 1 [全选] [全不选] │ │ ☐ src/config.yaml 2 KB │ │ 合计：3 · 1.4 MB │ │ [不清理文件，只删除会话] │ │ │ │ [取消] [移入回收站（保留会话）] [移入回收站并删除会话] │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ### 为什么用文件系统快照，而不是解析工具调用 会话日志里确实有 `write`/`edit`/`present` 这类工具调用的参数，理论上能抽出路径，但： - 日志是 zstd 压缩的内部格式，解析它等于依赖未公开的实现细节； - 更致命的是**漏报**：`python build.py` 生成 20 个文件，日志里只有一个命令字符串，一个路径都拿不到；`npm run build`、重定向、脚本批处理全都一样。 文件系统快照没有这个问题：不管谁写的、怎么写出来的，只要文件在会话开始后出现或变化，就能被发现。代价是首次快照要遍历目录（`node_modules`、`.git`、各类缓存目录默认跳过），超大仓库首次快照会有几秒延迟感。 ### 功能 - **基线快照**：会话第一个回合开始时（`turn/start`，任何工具执行之前）记录工作目录中每个文件的 `路径 → 大小/修改时间`，存到 `~/.dsh/session-file-purge/baselines/.json`。 - **可勾选清单**：删除会话时列出「新建」和「改动」两组文件；新建默认勾选，「改动」默认不勾选（这类文件在会话开始前就存在，整文件移走风险更大）。两组各自有全选/全不选，显示单文件大小与合计。 - **先回收站、后删除**：选中文件按原相对路径移入 `~/.dsh/session-file-purge/trash/<时间戳>-<会话短id>/files/` 并写入 `manifest.json`；随后才删除会话日志、投影缓存、工作区记账。被移空的文件夹一并删掉，仍非空的目录不动。 - **可撤销**：结束页有「撤销：把文件放回去」；侧边栏行菜单与弹窗里都能打开「文件回收站」，逐批放回或永久删除。 - **只清文件不删会话**：侧边栏行菜单的「清理本会话产生的文件…」只做回收站这一步。 - **Agent 工具** `session_files`：`mode: "list"` 列出某会话产生/改动的文件，`mode: "purge"` 按 `paths` 移入回收站。 ### 安装 ```sh # GitHub（仓库根目录就是这个包） dsh plugin --profile add github:FJHin/dsh-plugin-session-file-purge # 本地 checkout dsh plugin --profile add file:/path/to/dsh-plugin-session-file-purge ``` 安装后**重启该 profile**（新的 bundle 在组合阶段解析，运行中的实例不会热加载一个新增的 bundle）。 本包不依赖任何运行时第三方库：宿主端只用 `node:fs`/`node:os`/`node:path`，客户端 bundle 通过宿主提供的模块表 `require('react')` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`。唯一的 peer 是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`，且标记为 optional——compositor 里没有工具注册表时插件仍会加载（只是不注册 agent 工具）。 包清单同时声明了兼容范围：`engines.dsh: ">=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0"`（本插件验证过的 DSH 版本区间，含 prerelease）与 `dsh.manifestVersion: 1`（清单格式）。DSH 当前的安装器与 loader 不强制这两项，所以它们是声明而不是护栏——升级到区间之外的大版本时，请先看「已知限制」里 `storageDomain` 表结构那条。 与 [`@pepsi-ai/dsh-plugin-session-delete`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pepsi-ai/dsh-plugin-session-delete) 的关系：两者提供同一套界面（会话头部垃圾桶按钮 + 侧边栏「⋯」菜单项 + 风险确认弹窗），会话删除链路也走同一套 `storageDomain` 表。**同时启用会出现两个垃圾桶按钮、两层弹窗**，二选一即可。选择用本插件时，把另一个在自己的 profile patch 里关掉： ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles//cordis.patch.yml - id: chameleon-session-delete name: "@pepsi-ai/dsh-plugin-session-delete" disabled: true ``` ### 界面入口 | 入口 | 行为 | |---|---| | 会话头部垃圾桶按钮 | 打开删除流程：确认会话 → 文件清单 → 移入回收站并删会话 | | 侧边栏会话行「⋯」菜单 → 删除会话（含产生的文件）… | 同上，不需要切换会话 | | 侧边栏会话行「⋯」菜单 → 清理本会话产生的文件… | 直接进入文件清单，**只移文件、保留会话** | | 侧边栏会话行「⋯」菜单 → 打开文件回收站… | 回收站面板：逐批放回 / 永久删除 | | 弹窗结束页 | 撤销（把本批文件放回原处）、打开回收站 | 侧边栏的「⋯」菜单在客户端是硬编码的，没有扩展槽，所以这三个菜单项是注入 DOM 实现的；头部按钮走 `conversation.session.header.actions` 槽、弹窗与回收站面板走 `shell.overlay` 槽。 ### HTTP 接口 | 方法 | 路径 | 作用 | |---|---|---| | GET | `/__sespurge/ping` | 探活：返回插件名与宿主 pid | | GET | `/__sespurge/session/list` | 会话列表（标题/id/是否运行/是否有基线），供客户端把侧边栏标题对到会话 id | | POST | `/__sespurge/plan` | `{sessionId}` → 待清理清单（**只读，不改动任何文件**） | | POST | `/__sespurge/purge` | `{sessionId, paths[]}` → 移入回收站，保留会话 | | POST | A session log holds the session's own data; the files a model writes through the shell, python, or a build script are invisible to it. Session-delete plugins such as [`@pepsi-ai/dsh-plugin-session-delete`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pepsi-ai/dsh-plugin-session-delete) therefore remove the session log, projection cache and workspace accounting — and leave every generated file in your working directory for you to clean up by hand. This plugin closes that gap: **it snapshots the working directory when a session starts, lists the files created or changed since that snapshot when you delete the session, moves the checked ones into a trash directory, and only then removes the session.** ### Why a filesystem snapshot and not the tool-call log The transcript does carry `write`/`edit`/`present` arguments, so paths could be scraped from it — but the log is a compressed internal format, and more importantly it under-reports badly: `python build.py`, `npm run build`, a redirect or any script writes files that never appear as a path anywhere in the log. A filesystem diff sees every writer. The cost is one directory walk per session start (`node_modules`, `.git` and build caches are skipped), which is noticeable only on very large trees. ### Features - **Baseline snapshot** on the session's first `turn/start`, before any tool runs: `path → size/mtime` for the whole working directory, stored under `~/.dsh/session-file-purge/baselines/.json`. - **Checkbox list** at deletion time, split into *created* (checked by default) and *changed* (unchecked — those existed before the session, so moving them whole is riskier), with per-group select-all and per-file sizes. - **Trash first, delete second**: checked files move to `~/.dsh/session-file-purge/trash/-/files/` preserving their relative paths, with a `manifest.json`; the session log, projection cache and workspace accounting are removed only afterwards. Folders the purge emptied are removed; folders that still hold files are left alone. - **Undo**: the final step restores the batch; a trash panel in the sidebar lists every batch with restore and delete-for-good. - **Files only**: a sidebar item purges a session's files while keeping the session. - **Agent tool** `session_files`: `mode: "list"` or `mode: "purge"` with explicit `paths`. ### Install ```sh # from GitHub (the repository root is the package) dsh plugin --profile add github:FJHin/dsh-plugin-session-file-purge # from a local checkout dsh plugin --profile add file:/path/to/dsh-plugin-session-file-purge ``` Restart the profile afterwards: a newly added bundle is resolved during composition and is not hot-loaded into a running instance. No third-party runtime dependencies: the host half uses only `node:fs`/`node:os`/`node:path`, and the client bundle reaches the shared UI through the module table (`require('react')`, `require('@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives')`). The only peer, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, is optional, so a composition without the tool registry still loads the plugin. The manifest also declares its compatibility window: `engines.dsh: ">=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0"` (the DSH versions this plugin was verified against, prereleases included) and `dsh.manifestVersion: 1` (manifest format). Neither is enforced by the current installer or loader — they are declarations. Before jumping to a major version outside that range, check the `storageDomain` note under *Known limitations*. ### HTTP API | Method | Path | Purpose | |---|---|---| | GET | `/__sespurge/ping` | liveness: plugin name and host pid | | GET | `/__sespurge/session/list` | session list (title/id/running/has-baseline) | | POST | `/__sespurge/plan` | `{sessionId}` → what a purge would move (read-only) | | POST | `/__sespurge/purge` | `{sessionId, paths[]}` → trash the selection, keep the session | | POST | `/__sespurge/cleanup` | `{sessionId, paths[], deleteSession}` → trash, then delete | | GET | `/__sespurge/trash` | trash batches | | POST | `/__sespurge/trash/restore` | `{id, paths?}` → restore one file or a whole batch | | POST | `/__sespurge/trash/drop` | `{id}` → delete a batch for good | Paths are always relative to the session's working directory and are re-validated with `resolveInside`; anything escaping the root is refused and reported in `failed`. **Admission comes before the parameters**: every handler first calls `ctx.get('connection').admit(req)`, the gate `/api` itself passes through — a Host/Origin fence (loopback, the bound address or a trusted host; same origin; `sec-fetch-site: cross-site` always refused → `403`) and then the browser session (a launch-token-derived cookie, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, bound to this hostname and port, signed with a key the browser cannot mint → `401` when missing or stale). With no `connection` service the route answers `503` and fails closed. A POST must also declare `content-type: application/json` (`415` otherwise), which removes the cross-site "simple request" path entirely. Net effect: session titles, file moves and trash contents are visible only to the window that can already drive this UI. ### Configuration | Field | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `maxEntries` | `200000` | files visited per snapshot/diff before the result is marked `truncated` | | `baselineBudgetMs` | `30000` | time budget for a baseline snapshot | | `planBudgetMs` | `20000` | time budget for building the cleanup list | | `trashRetentionDays` | `30` | trash retention; expired batches are dropped by the next purge | > **A trap for plugin authors**: this plugin deliberately does **not** export `Config`. A cordis plugin that exports `Config` declares a schemastery schema, and the loader validates the row's config through `Config['~standard'].validate(...)`. Exporting a plain defaults object throws during config resolution, so the row silently never activates: the module is imported, `apply` is never called, no HTTP route is registered — while the client bundle still gets published (that scan only looks for the `dsh.client` declaration). The symptom is confusing: a working new UI over a host that answers 404/405 to everything. `test/plugin-contract.mjs` reproduces the loader step so this cannot regress. ### Safety - Every route is admitted by the harness' `connection.admit(req)` (Host/Origin fence plus the launch-token-derived browser cookie): `401` unauthenticated, `403` from a foreign origin, `503` when no `connection` service exists; POSTs must be `application/json`. - `plan` is read-only; only `purge`/`cleanup` move files, and they `rename` (falling back to copy-then-remove across devices). - Every client- or model-supplied path goes through `resolveInside(root, path)`. - `node_modules`, `.git` and build caches never enter a snapshot or a list. - Nothing is deleted silently: selected files go to the trash, and `drop` is the only real deletion, scoped to a trash batch. - Only *created* files start checked; *changed* files are listed with an explicit warning. - No network access, no credentials, no writes outside `~/.dsh/session-file-purge/` and the moves you confirm. ### Known limitations - A session that started before the plugin was installed has no baseline and cannot have its files identified. - Files that already existed and were never touched during the session are not listed. - Files **you** edited during the session land in the *changed* group (a snapshot cannot tell who wrote what). - Scans are budgeted (`maxEntries`, default 200,000 files, plus a time budget); a truncated scan says so in the dialog. - A long-lived session accumulates a long *created* list (it also includes things you placed in the working directory yourself). Only the newest 400 created files start checked; the rest are listed unchecked. - The dialog renders at most 2,000 file rows (the totals and the API response stay complete). - Request bodies are capped at 4 MB, which only a pathological selection of tens of thousands of paths would reach. - The trash does not expire on its own except through the retention check on the next purge. - The session-deletion chain relies on the `session_projcache` / `workspace` storage tables and needs re-checking after a major DSH upgrade (verified against `0.2.0-rc.2`). - Only files inside the working directory are considered. ### Troubleshooting See `~/.dsh/session-file-purge/diagnostics.log` (one line per lifecycle step: `module-load`, `apply`, `http-register`, `http-admission-*`, …) and `GET /__sespurge/ping` — a `401` there from `curl` is the admission gate working, not a failure (`503` means the composition has no `connection` service). `node tools/verify-live.mjs` walks the read-only routes against a running harness and prints sessions, baselines and trash batches; add `--plan ` to inspect what a purge would move (still read-only). ### License MIT. 里没有工具注册表时插件仍会加载（只是不注册 agent 工具）。 包清单同时声明了兼容范围：`engines.dsh: ">=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0"`（本插件验证过的 DSH 版本区间，含 prerelease）与 `dsh.manifestVersion: 1`（清单格式）。DSH 当前的安装器与 loader 不强制这两项，所以它们是声明而不是护栏——升级到区间之外的大版本时，请先看「已知限制」里 `storageDomain` 表结构那条。 与 [`@pepsi-ai/dsh-plugin-session-delete`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pepsi-ai/dsh-plugin-session-delete) 的关系：两者提供同一套界面（会话头部垃圾桶按钮 + 侧边栏「⋯」菜单项 + 风险确认弹窗），会话删除链路也走同一套 `storageDomain` 表。**同时启用会出现两个垃圾桶按钮、两层弹窗**，二选一即可。选择用本插件时，把另一个在自己的 profile patch 里关掉： ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles//cordis.patch.yml - id: chameleon-session-delete name: "@pepsi-ai/dsh-plugin-session-delete" disabled: true ``` ### 界面入口 | 入口 | 行为 | |---|---| | 会话头部垃圾桶按钮 | 打开删除流程：确认会话 → 文件清单 → 移入回收站并删会话 | | 侧边栏会话行「⋯」菜单 → 删除会话（含产生的文件）… | 同上，不需要切换会话 | | 侧边栏会话行「⋯」菜单 → 清理本会话产生的文件… | 直接进入文件清单，**只移文件、保留会话** | | 侧边栏会话行「⋯」菜单 → 打开文件回收站… | 回收站面板：逐批放回 / 永久删除 | | 弹窗结束页 | 撤销（把本批文件放回原处）、打开回收站 | 侧边栏的「⋯」菜单在客户端是硬编码的，没有扩展槽，所以这三个菜单项是注入 DOM 实现的；头部按钮走 `conversation.session.header.actions` 槽、弹窗与回收站面板走 `shell.overlay` 槽。 ### HTTP 接口 | 方法 | 路径 | 作用 | |---|---|---| | GET | `/__sespurge/ping` | 探活：返回插件名与宿主 pid | | GET | `/__sespurge/session/list` | 会话列表（标题/id/是否运行/是否有基线），供客户端把侧边栏标题对到会话 id | | POST | `/__sespurge/plan` | `{sessionId}` → 待清理清单（**只读，不改动任何文件**） | | POST | `/__sespurge/purge` | `{sessionId, paths[]}` → 移入回收站，保留会话 | | POST | `/__sespurge/cleanup` | `{sessionId, paths[], deleteSession}` → 移入回收站（可选）并删除会话 | | GET | `/__sespurge/trash` | 回收站批次列表 | | POST | `/__sespurge/trash/restore` | `{id, paths?}` → 放回指定文件或整批 | | POST | `/__sespurge/trash/drop` | `{id}` → 永久删除某一批 | `sessionId` 必须是 `` 或 `session-`；`paths` 一律相对工作目录，服务端用 `resolveInside` 校验，`../` 之类的越界路径会被拒绝并计入响应里的 `failed`。 **每条路由的第一步是准入检查**，而不是读参数：handler 调用 `ctx.get('connection').admit(req)`——就是 `/api` 自己走的那道闸。它先做 Host/Origin 栅栏（Host 必须是回环地址/监听地址/可信主机，Origin 必须同源，`sec-fetch-site: cross-site` 一律拒绝，失败 `403`），再校验浏览器会话（cookie 由进程启动 token 派生、HttpOnly、SameSite=Strict、绑定当前 hostname 与端口、用浏览器无法伪造的密钥签名，缺失或过期 `401`）。组合里没有 `connection` 服务时一律 `503`——**失败关闭，绝不放行**。POST 还必须声明 `content-type: application/json`，否则 `415`，这样跨站表单、`` 探针连"简单请求"都凑不出来。结果：会话标题、文件移动、回收站内容只对"能驱动这个 Web UI 的那个窗口"可见。 ### 配置 profile 行的 `config` 支持这些字段（正整数，缺省用默认值）： | 字段 | 默认 | 含义 | |---|---|---| | `maxEntries` | `200000` | 一次快照/对比最多访问的文件数，超过则标记 `truncated` | | `baselineBudgetMs` | `30000` | 基线快照的时间预算 | | `planBudgetMs` | `20000` | 生成清理清单的时间预算 | | `trashRetentionDays` | `30` | 回收站保留天数，超期批次在下次清理动作时删除 | > **给插件作者的一个坑**：本插件刻意**不**导出 `Config`。cordis 的加载器会把插件导出的 `Config` 当成 schemastery 配置模式，用 `Config['~standard'].validate(行配置)` 校验；导出一个普通默认值对象会让这一步直接抛错，row 静默不激活——模块确实被 import 了，但 `apply` 永远不会被调用，HTTP 路由一条都不会注册，而客户端 bundle 照常发布（扫描只看 `dsh.client` 声明）。现象非常迷惑：**界面是新的、功能全报 404/405**。`test/plugin-contract.mjs` 复刻了加载器这一步来防止回归。 ### 安全设计 - **身份与来源校验**：所有路由先过宿主的 `connection.admit(req)`（Host/Origin 栅栏 + 启动 token 派生的浏览器会话 cookie），未认证 `401`、跨源 `403`、无 `connection` 服务 `503`；POST 另要求 `application/json`。 - **只快照、只对比，不改文件**：`plan` 完全只读；只有 `purge`/`cleanup` 才移动文件，且优先 `rename`（跨盘或被占用时退化为复制后删除）。 - **越界拦截**：所有来自客户端或模型的路径都过 `resolveInside(root, path)`，解析后必须仍在会话工作目录内。 - **不碰依赖和版本库**：`node_modules`、`.git`、`.hg`、`.venv`、`__pycache__`、`.next`、`.gradle` 等从不进入快照，也从不出现在清单里。 - **不静默删除**：任何选中文件先入回收站；`drop` 是唯一真正删除的接口，且只作用于回收站内的批次。 - **默认勾选保守**：只默认勾选「新建」文件；「改动」文件默认不勾，并在列表里显式提示风险。 - **不采集任何数据**：不使用网络，不读取凭据，不写工作目录以外的位置（除 `~/.dsh/session-file-purge/` 下的基线与回收站）。 ### 已知限制 - **基线只在会话开始时建立**。插件安装之前就已经开始的会话没有基线，弹窗会提示「无法判断哪些文件是它产生的」，此时只能删会话本身。 - **会话开始时就存在、且整段会话都没变过的文件不会被列出**——它们不是这次会话的产物，这是设计意图。 - **你在会话进行中亲手改的文件也会进「改动」组**（快照看不出是谁改的）。它不是默认勾选项，但请留意。 - **扫描有预算**：单次快照/对比最多访问 `maxEntries` 个文件（默认 20 万）或超出时间预算即截断，弹窗会提示，截断时清单可能不完整（宁可漏报也不误报）。 - **长会话的清单会很大**：基线是会话开始时建立的，会话活得越久，`plan` 列出的「新建」就越多（也包含你自己后来放进工作目录的东西）。为此**默认只勾选最新的 400 个新建文件**，其余仍然列出但默认不勾——请按需手动勾。 - **弹窗最多渲染 2000 行**文件（更长的清单只显示前 2000 条，但「合计」和接口返回的仍是完整清单）。 - **请求体上限 4 MB**：路径清单本身很小，正常使用不会触及；一次选中上万条极端路径时才会遇到。 - **回收站不会自动过期**，除非下一次清理动作触发保留期检查；也可以手动删 `~/.dsh/session-file-purge/trash` 下的目录。 - **会话删除链路复用了 `storageDomain` 的 `session_projcache` / `workspace` 表结构**，DSH 大版本升级后需要跟着核对（本版本对 `0.2.0-rc.2` 验证）。 - 只清理**工作目录内**的文件；会话写到 `/tmp`、其他盘符或家目录别处的文件不在范围内。 ### 排障 `~/.dsh/session-file-purge/diagnostics.log` 记录插件启动过程，每行是 `时间 事件 详情`： | 事件 | 含义 | |---|---| | `module-load` | 宿主端模块被 import（说明 row 存在、包能被解析） | | `apply` | `apply` 开始执行，详情带 `webServer present: true/false` | | `http-register` | HTTP 路由注册成功，详情说明走的是 `direct`/`inject`/`poll` 哪条路 | | `http-register-skipped` | 拿到了服务但没有 `register()` 方法 | | `inject-no-webServer` | 延迟注入回调里没有 webServer 服务 | - 只有 `module-load`、没有 `apply` → 插件未被激活（见上一节「给插件作者的一个坑」）。 - 有 `apply`、没有 `http-register` → webServer 服务时序问题；插件已用「直接取 / 延迟注入 / 轮询」三条路兜底。 - `GET /__sespurge/ping` 返回插件名与 pid，一条命令判断宿主端是否活着。**用 `curl` 或未带浏览器会话的 `fetch` 打它会得到 `401`——这本身就证明路由已注册、准入闸门生效**（`503` 则是组合里没有 `connection` 服务）。 - `node tools/verify-live.mjs` 同理：不指定 `--cookie` 时它会打印 `401` 并说明这是预期；把窗口当前使用的 cookie 传进去（`--cookie "="`）才会走完只读检查。 ### 开发 ``` src/index.js 宿主端：快照调度、清单、回收站、会话删除链路、HTTP 接口、agent 工具 src/scan.js 目录遍历与基线对比（忽略规则、预算、越界校验） src/trash.js 回收站：清单、移入、放回、永久删除 src/diagnostics.js 启动诊断日志 src/client.js 客户端 bundle：头部按钮、两步弹窗、回收站面板、侧边栏注入 test/plugin-contract.mjs 插件契约测试（复刻加载器的 Config / 激活判定） test/bundle-install.mjs bundle 安装契约（包名 / bundles 条目 / patch 行名 / node_modules 目录名必须一致） test/scan-rules.mjs 遍历忽略规则、越界校验、基线对比、预算截断 test/harness.mjs 宿主端行为测试（假 ctx + 假 storageDomain） test/client-smoke.mjs 客户端 bundle 冒烟测试（假 React + 假 fetch） tools/run-tests.mjs 跑全部测试套件 tools/verify-live.mjs 对运行中的 harness 做只读验证（ping / 会话列表 / 回收站，可选一次只读 plan） tools/asar-read.mjs 从桌面版 app.asar 里读单个文件，便于查证运行时内部实现 ``` ```sh node tools/run-tests.mjs # 或 npm test node tools/verify-live.mjs # 针对运行中的实例，只读 node tools/verify-live.mjs --plan ``` 五套测试都是纯 `node`，不需要安装任何依赖（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 由测试自己 stub）。两个最值得记住的： - 改了忽略规则或路径校验 → 务必跑 `test/scan-rules.mjs`，它是唯一会阻止「清单里出现不该出现的文件」的防线； - 改了包名、`cordis.patch.yml` 的行名或导出路径 → 跑 `test/bundle-install.mjs`，它复刻启动器的四步解析（bundles 条目 → 目录 → patch → 按行名导入模块），这四处名字不一致时 bundle 会被**静默跳过**。 ### 许可 MIT。 --- ## English ### Why this exists Like most harnesses, DSH keeps **no per-session ledger of files**. A session log holds the session's own data; the files a model writes through the shell, python, or a build script are invisible to it. Session-delete plugins such as [`@pepsi-ai/dsh-plugin-session-delete`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pepsi-ai/dsh-plugin-session-delete) therefore remove the session log, projection cache and workspace accounting — and leave every generated file in your working directory for you to clean up by hand. This plugin closes that gap: **it snapshots the working directory when a session starts, lists the files created or changed since that snapshot when you delete the session, moves the checked ones into a trash directory, and only then removes the session.** ### Why a filesystem snapshot and not the tool-call log The transcript does carry `write`/`edit`/`present` arguments, so paths could be scraped from it — but the log is a compressed internal format, and more importantly it under-reports badly: `python build.py`, `npm run build`, a redirect or any script writes files that never appear as a path anywhere in the log. A filesystem diff sees every writer. The cost is one directory walk per session start (`node_modules`, `.git` and build caches are skipped), which is noticeable only on very large trees. ### Features - **Baseline snapshot** on the session's first `turn/start`, before any tool runs: `path → size/mtime` for the whole working directory, stored under `~/.dsh/session-file-purge/baselines/.json`. - **Checkbox list** at deletion time, split into *created* (checked by default) and *changed* (unchecked — those existed before the session, so moving them whole is riskier), with per-group select-all and per-file sizes. - **Trash first, delete second**: checked files move to `~/.dsh/session-file-purge/trash/-/files/` preserving their relative paths, with a `manifest.json`; the session log, projection cache and workspace accounting are removed only afterwards. Folders the purge emptied are removed; folders that still hold files are left alone. - **Undo**: the final step restores the batch; a trash panel in the sidebar lists every batch with restore and delete-for-good. - **Files only**: a sidebar item purges a session's files while keeping the session. - **Agent tool** `session_files`: `mode: "list"` or `mode: "purge"` with explicit `paths`. ### Install ```sh # from GitHub (the repository root is the package) dsh plugin --profile add github:FJHin/dsh-plugin-session-file-purge # from a local checkout dsh plugin --profile add file:/path/to/dsh-plugin-session-file-purge ``` Restart the profile afterwards: a newly added bundle is resolved during composition and is not hot-loaded into a running instance.
