# dsh-lead-mode

English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Adds a Lead mode to DSH. One preset, one skill, one self-check command, two reminders.

Once installed, the model works the way a Lead does: split the work, delegate it, accept the result. It delegates hands-on work instead of doing everything alone.

## What you get

Four things. None of them touch dsh itself.

| Capability | Entry point | What you do |
|---|---|---|
| Lead mode preset | "Lead 模式" in the preset list | Switch to it |
| Lead working method skill | `/skill lead-mode`; the model also loads it on its own | Nothing |
| Dependency self-check | `/lead-mode` | Run it when dependencies look wrong |
| Two upfront reminders | Automatic | Nothing |

### 1. The Lead mode preset

Switch to it and the session's model becomes a Lead.

The preset is the official `standard` preset row for row, all 22 of them, with only the persona replaced. No tool is dropped: bash, file read/write, search, web, todo, skill, goal, plan, compaction, subagent and workflow are all there.

So switching to Lead mode costs you no capability. It changes how the model works, not what it can do.

### 2. The Lead working method skill

A working method for splitting, delegating and accepting work, shipped inside the package.

It is not tied to the preset. Any session can load it, two ways:

- The model loads it when it judges the task needs it (the skill is marked model-invocable)
- You run `/skill lead-mode` yourself

It covers: agreeing on the goal before starting, making a delegation self-contained, keeping write scopes disjoint, the list/get/claim/complete flow for shared tasks, how to wait on teammates, where a teammate's model comes from, and doing the final verification yourself.

Two of those facts only show up when you read the runtime source:

| Fact | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| A teammate settling notifies you automatically, carrying its closing message | Finish your turn after delegating; you do not need to sit and watch |
| A task change does not wake an idle Lead | Do not count on "it marked the task complete, so I know"; that path only wakes a caller currently inside `wait_agent` |

So the skill's default is: finish your turn after delegating and let the notification wake you (the user sees progress immediately), and use one `wait_agent` only when the current turn cannot continue without the result. Never loop `wait_agent`, and never poll with repeated `list_agents`.

Tell the teammate to put the **deliverable in its closing message** — that message is what comes back to you with the notification.

### 3. The dependency self-check command

`/lead-mode` reports the current dependency state.

| Reported | Content |
|---|---|
| Team runtime | Mounted or not; its `maxMembers` when mounted |
| lead-mode preset | Registered or not |
| Missing pieces | The version-pinned install command |

Everything in place returns success. Anything missing returns error. Nothing is skipped silently.

### 4. Two upfront reminders

This is the main reason the plugin exists: **when the session has no Team tools, it tells you to enable the official Agent Teams instead of letting the model work alone.**

Two channels:

| Channel | Who sees it | When it appears |
|---|---|---|
| First persona section | The model | As soon as you switch to Lead mode. It is section 0 of the system prompt |
| Startup warn and `/lead-mode` | You | When the Team runtime is detected missing |

Both say the same thing: without the `spawn_teammate` tool set, stop and tell the user what to install.

The model will not pretend it can delegate, and it will not pass `subagent` off as a teammate.

## Enable the Team runtime first

Lead mode delegates through `spawn_teammate`, `send_message`, and `team_task_*`. Those come from the official dsh Team runtime, which this plugin does not ship.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your profile name> add @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile@0.2.1-rc.3
```

**The version pin is required.** Without it npm resolves `latest`, which is 0.1.5-alpha.2 — built for 0.1.x hosts and it will not mount on a 0.2.1 host. `next` points at 0.2.1-rc.3, which is the correct one. Restart dsh afterwards.

Not sure whether it is installed? Run `/lead-mode` in dsh; it reports dependency state.

## Install this plugin

Two routes, pick one.

From npm:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your profile name> add dsh-lead-mode
```

From GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your profile name> add https://github.com/xiebaiyuan/dsh-lead-mode
```

Restart dsh afterwards, then pick "Lead 模式" in the preset list.

## Usage

Three steps.

**1. Switch to Lead mode.** Pick "Lead 模式" in a new session's preset list. The first system-prompt section becomes the Lead persona, and the reminder at its top goes in with it.

**2. Run `/lead-mode` to check dependencies.** This command delegates nothing; it only reports state. When something is missing it prints the version-pinned install command.

**3. Let the model work.** With the delegation tools in place, the model splits the work, delegates to teammates, and waits for all of them before wrapping up. Without them, its first move is to tell you to enable the Team runtime.

## Friendly link: dsh-context

This plugin only does Lead mode. Visualising Team state and comms is **dsh-context**'s job, and that is a separate project:

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Repository | https://github.com/bowenliang123/dsh-context |
| Author | bowenliang123 |
| License | Apache-2.0 |
| Install | `dsh plugin --profile <your profile name> add dsh-context` |

It does not ship with this plugin, and it is not a dependency of it. This plugin only points at it from the docs and the skill.

### Why point there at all

Tool calls read one at a time. `list_agents` gives one line of status; `team_task_list` gives task ownership. Seeing who is doing what, and who said what to whom, takes a page.

dsh-context adds a **Fleet / 编队** tab to every session (right of **Context**), and the right sidebar's **Context** panel carries the same card.

| Surface | Shows |
|---|---|
| Summary | Member status, live context, estimated cost, task progress |
| Agent Network | The current agent, its parents, every subagent, one card each |
| Fleet Members | Each member's role, model, latest reply, run time, steps, active task count |
| Tasks | Team tasks and subagent delegations together, grouped by owner, with blocked-by chains |
| Agent Comms | Who said what to whom. Team relays, mailbox deliveries, and the runtime's settlement notices |

Picking a member on the graph or the member board narrows Tasks and Agent Comms to that one agent. Opening a message in Agent Comms shows the full record: which session log it came from, its sequence, whether the runtime wrote the settlement notice or the child sent it, and the complete closing report.

The Lead mode skill names this entry point too, so the model points you here instead of restating progress itself.

## Required official bundles and versions

This plugin ships none of the packages below. The host or an official bundle provides them; this plugin only declares version requirements in `peerDependencies`.

| Package | Requirement | Provided by | When missing |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile` | `0.2.1-rc.3` | You install it explicitly | Cannot delegate; `/lead-mode` returns error; startup warn |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh` | `>=0.2.1-rc.2` | Host | Will not install |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `^4.0.5` | Host | Will not install |
| `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` | `^3.18.5` | Host | Will not install |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset-registry` | `>=0.2.1-rc.2` | Host | Preset row does not take effect; `/lead-mode` reports unknown |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` | `>=0.2.1-rc.2` | Host | Skill not registered; startup warn |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-commands` | `>=0.2.1-rc.2` | Host | `/lead-mode` not registered; startup warn |

The target host version is `dshTarget` in `package.json`: `0.2.1-rc.3`.

## Why the install command pins a version

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile` has three dist-tags on npm:

| dist-tag | Version | Host it fits |
|---|---|---|
| `latest` | 0.1.5-alpha.2 | 0.1.x |
| `alpha` | 0.2.1-alpha.5 | the 0.2.1 prerelease line |
| `next` | 0.2.1-rc.3 | 0.2.1 |

Bare package name resolves `latest`, which installs 0.1.5-alpha.2. That build targets 0.1.x hosts and does not mount on a 0.2.1 host. After installing it, no Team tools appear in dsh and `/lead-mode` still reports "not mounted".

Measured on 2026-10-26 with npm 11.20.0:

```
$ npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile version
0.1.5-alpha.2
```

So every install command in this plugin carries `@0.2.1-rc.3`: the persona prefix, the `/lead-mode` output, the startup warn, and SKILL.md. `test/preset.test.mjs` and `test/smoke.test.mjs` both assert that string, so a future edit cannot quietly drop back to the bare name.

For the `alpha` line, pin `@0.2.1-alpha.5` yourself; do not use the bare name.

## Difference from the official standard preset

One place only: the persona. The other 21 rows are copied field for field from `standard`.

| Item | standard | lead-mode |
|---|---|---|
| persona prefix | `You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.` | Chinese Lead persona plus an Agent Teams precondition check |
| other 21 rows | — | identical to standard, field for field |

The four classic subagent rows (`tool-subagent-control`, `tool-subagent-list-agents`, `tool-subagent`, `tool-subagent-fork`) stay enabled. Nothing is disabled. The Team tools are a host decision, not a preset decision.

## Why the preset does not carry the Team runtime

`apply()` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team` listens on the global `agent/created` event and installs Team tools on every agent. It is a host-plane plugin; putting it in a preset would leak it into every session.

So this plugin stays at: preset, skill, reminder. Whether the Team runtime is on is decided by the user through the official profile package.

## Layout

```
package.json            package metadata; dsh.bundle.patch points at cordis.patch.yml
cordis.patch.yml        two insert rows: this plugin and the lead-mode preset
lib/index.js            host half: register the skill, register the command, startup check
skills/lead-mode/       the Lead working method
dsh-plugin.naming.json  naming manifest
test/                   behaviour assertions, zero dependencies
```

## Development

```bash
node --check lib/index.js
node --test test/*.test.mjs
node scripts/check-patch.mjs
```

Tests are zero-dependency. No `npm install` needed. The directory form of `node --test` is accepted only on Node 22+; on Node 20 the shell expands the glob.

## Releasing

Push a tag to trigger `.github/workflows/release.yml`. Publishing goes through npm Trusted Publishing (OIDC). No token is stored and no 2FA prompt appears.

Configure the Trusted Publisher once on npmjs.com:

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Organization or user | `xiebaiyuan` |
| Repository | `dsh-lead-mode` |
| Workflow filename | `release.yml` |
| Allowed actions | Tick `npm publish` |

`npm stage publish` is allowed by default. With only that ticked, CI can stage but a human still has to approve before the version goes live.

Once configured:

```bash
npm version patch --no-git-tag-version
git commit -am "chore: bump to 0.1.3"
git tag v0.1.3
git push origin main --tags
```

The tag version must equal `package.json`'s version, or the workflow exits without publishing. npm rejects a second publish of the same version, so bump the version every time.

## License

MIT

# ajtc-chain-engine

> DeepSeek Harness（**dsh**）插件 · 把 **AJTC 自动化触发链系统**（引擎 + 链 + 记忆）直接装进 dsh，支持通过 **dsh 插件市场** 一键安装。
>
> **🎯 定位**：面向 Agent 的**执行层治理**插件——以 `iron-laws`（硬规则）/ `deletionGuard`（删除·不可逆操作护栏）/ `verificationGate`（声称完成前须有证据）保证「AI 诚实 + 不破坏持久状态」；与 `dsh-gov`（企业级权限 / 成本治理）**互补而非竞争**。

[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-ready-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2EA44F)](LICENSE)

AJTC（Automated JSON Trigger-Chain）是一套事件队列 + 黑板 + 统一信封架构的触发链引擎：把复杂多步骤任务拆成「节点图」，每个节点受治理约束（铁律、验收门、预算护栏）。本插件把整套引擎 **vendored** 进一个 dsh 包，并注册三个工具让 dsh agent 直接调度它。

---

## ✨ 特性

- **开箱即用**：内置**离线 mock 模型**（确定性、可复现、零外部依赖），零配置即可验证链路结构。
- **记忆后端可配置**：记忆系统支持 TencentDB Agent-Memory MemoryCore（远程）或本地文件后端，由环境变量切换；后端不可达时优雅降级，不影响链运行。
- **默认铁律随包携带**：通用治理铁律 `iron-laws.json` 作为默认参考随插件分发，可经 `ajtc_recall_memory` 召回；用户可让 agent 自行建立专属铁律系统。
- **治理护栏内置**：链内已有删除护栏、验证门、预算上限等机械约束，非自由发挥。
- **安装即 marketplace 可见**：仓库打 `dsh-plugin` 话题标签后，可被 dsh 插件市场扫描并一键安装。

---

## 📦 安装

### 方式一：命令行（推荐，可回滚、可写进脚本）

```bash
# 安装到 web profile（桌面端一般用 desktop；写错 profile 会出现"装了却没反应"）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:<owner>/ajtc-chain-engine

# 查看已装
dsh plugin --profile web list

# 卸载
dsh plugin --profile web remove ajtc-chain-engine
```

> 安装会把本包写入该 profile 的 `package.json` 依赖，并登记进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，重启 dsh 后生效。

### 方式二：插件市场（图形界面）

1. 先装一个插件市场（如 [`@springbrand/dsh-plugin-marketplace`](https://dshpluginhub.ai/en/plugins/springbrand-dsh-plugin-marketplace) 或 `github:mengxingGG/dsh-plugin-marketplace`）。
2. 打开 **Settings → Plugin Marketplace**，搜索 `ajtc-chain-engine`，点击 **Install**。
3. 重启 dsh。

> 要让本仓库出现在市场目录里，只需在 GitHub 仓库设置页添加话题 **`dsh-plugin`** 即可（市场按该话题扫描公开仓库，并校验根 `package.json` 是否声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`）。

---

## ⚙️ 配置（可选）

| 环境变量 | 作用 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MEMORY_BACKEND` | 记忆后端：`local`（本地文件）或 `tencentdb`（远程 MemoryCore） | `local` |
| `MEMCORE_BASE_URL` | TencentDB Agent-Memory MemoryCore 端点（`tencentdb` 模式生效；不可达时优雅降级） | `http://127.0.0.1:8420` |
| `MEMCORE_API_KEY` | MemoryCore 访问密钥（可选，视部署方要求） | 空 |
| `MEMORY_LOCAL_DIR` | 本地后端存储目录（`local` 模式生效） | `engine/.runtime/memory` |
| `AJTC_SHADOW_DIR` | 影子回放录制目录（安装到只读 node_modules 时务必指向可写目录） | 包内 `.runtime/shadow` |

完整示例见 [`engine/.env.example`](engine/.env.example)。

---

## 🛠 工具

插件向 dsh 注册三个工具：

| 工具 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `ajtc_list_chains` | 列出全部已注册触发链（id / 标题 / 节点数） |
| `ajtc_run_chain` | 运行某条链：`{ chainId, goal?, mock=true, json=true }` |
| `ajtc_recall_memory` | 在策展记忆层按关键词召回约束与历史决策 |

示例对话（在 dsh 里）：

> 「用 `gen.chain-governance` 审一下当前改动」→ 自动调用 `ajtc_run_chain`
> 「查一下删除相关的铁律」→ 自动调用 `ajtc_recall_memory`

---

## 🧠 记忆打包策略

为保证体积与隐私可控，插件**默认只携带通用记忆层模板**（不携带任何用户项目记忆）：

```
memory/
├── README.md                 # 记忆层说明：默认铁律位置、如何自建铁律系统、资产登记仅模板
└── asset-registry.template.md # 资产登记**模板**（占位符，用户按需填写或仅保留模板）
```

> 默认铁律注册表位于 `engine/chains/governance/iron-laws.json`，作为通用治理参考随包分发；用户可让 agent 在其基础上建立自己的铁律系统（新增 / 修订铁律写回该文件或由用户指定位置）。
> `asset-registry` 仅作为模板存在：用户可选择「仅保存模板」或填入自己的资产登记。
> 每日开发日志等过程性记忆**不随插件分发**；如需本地沉淀，自行在 `memory/` 下维护。

---

## 🏗 架构

```
ajtc-chain-engine/                ← dsh 插件包（Cordis 包）
├── index.js                      ← Cordis 插件入口：apply(ctx) 注册工具 + 注入 system prompt
├── cordis.patch.yml             ← 插入 profile layer 栈
├── package.json                  ← 含 dsh.bundle.patch / dsh.manifestVersion
├── engine/                       ← vendored AJTC 运行时（CommonJS，独立子进程隔离）
│   ├── src/                      ← cli.js + engine/* + adapters/* + genesis/*
│   ├── chains/                   ← 通用触发链（genesis / governance / generic-pipeline / explainer / extract / summarize / identity / video-to-knowledge / demo 等）
│   ├── schemas/                  ← 链 JSON Schema
│   └── .env.example
├── memory/                       ← 通用记忆层模板（资产登记模板 + 说明）
└── scripts/                      ← 可选本地工具
```

**运行时隔离**：`index.js`（ESM）通过 `child_process.spawn` 调用 `engine/src/cli.js`（CommonJS），互不污染模块系统；影子回放录制经 `AJTC_SHADOW_DIR` 重定向到可写目录，避免写入只读的 `node_modules`。

---

## 🔧 本地开发 / 自托管发布

```bash
# 在 dsh profile 里从本地路径装（开发调试）
dsh plugin --profile web add file:$(pwd)

# 发布到 npm（让市场也能从 npm 安装）
npm publish          # 需先 npm login；files 字段已限定只发布必要文件

# 打 dsh-plugin 话题，让市场收录
# → GitHub 仓库 Settings → Topics → 添加 dsh-plugin
```

---

## 📄 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)。AJTC 引擎与本项目均为社区维护，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。

# bioresearcher-skills

[![skills.sh](https://www.skills.sh/b/yeyuan98/bioresearcher-skills)](https://www.skills.sh/yeyuan98/bioresearcher-skills)
[![License: Apache-2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache--2.0-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)

Agent Skills ([agentskills.io](https://agentskills.io) open standard) for
**biomedical research with the [biomcp-ts](https://github.com/yeyuan98/biomcp-ts)
MCP server** — deep multi-aspect research with citations, PubMed weekly
update processing, uv Python environment bootstrap, and automated local
runtime onboarding. Works in opencode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI,
and every harness that reads `SKILL.md`.

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`bioresearcher-onboard`](./skills/bioresearcher-onboard/SKILL.md) | Bootstraps a project-local biomcp MCP server runtime in `.bioresearcher-runtime/`: downloads portable Node.js 22 (if missing), vendors biomcp with fast mirror support (official or npmmirror), configures optional features (R, Biowasm, SQLite), and registers the server in OpenCode, Claude Code, Cursor, ZCode, Pi, CodeBuddy, or WorkBuddy. |
| [`bioresearcher-plot-making`](./skills/bioresearcher-plot-making/SKILL.md) | Biomedical visualization router and plotting engine: classifies research data and produces publication-ready scientific figures (structural protein-binder complexes, conformational dynamics, literature method summaries, developmental case registers, and evidence tables) with built-in QA gates. |
| [`bioresearcher-deep-research`](./skills/bioresearcher-deep-research/SKILL.md) | Orchestrates multi-aspect biomedical research (literature, trials, genes, variants, drugs, diseases, patents, omics) through biomcp-ts: interview → plan review → decompose → parallel-or-sequential research → cited Markdown + HTML report. 18 domain reference guides included. |
| [`bioresearcher-pubmed-weekly`](./skills/bioresearcher-pubmed-weekly/SKILL.md) | Downloads the past week's PubMed updatefiles from NCBI and parses them (pure-Python streaming parser, handles `<PubmedArticle>` **and** `<DeleteCitation>`) into one Excel workbook. |
| [`bioresearcher-python-setup-uv`](./skills/bioresearcher-python-setup-uv/SKILL.md) | Bootstraps a project-local uv-managed Python environment (official or China mirror). |

## Install

Requires the biomcp-ts MCP server — either bootstrap it automatically with
the [`bioresearcher-onboard`](./skills/bioresearcher-onboard/SKILL.md) skill, or
see [docs/biomcp-ts-setup.md](./docs/biomcp-ts-setup.md) for manual wiring.

**Any harness (skills CLI):**

```bash
npx skills add yeyuan98/bioresearcher-skills
```

To run onboarding immediately:

```bash
npx skills add yeyuan98/bioresearcher-skills --skill bioresearcher-onboard
```

**Claude Code (plugin marketplace):**

```
/plugin marketplace add yeyuan98/bioresearcher-skills
/plugin install bioresearcher@bioresearcher-skills
```

Installing the plugin also bundles the pinned **core-only** biomcp MCP server
(`.claude-plugin/mcp.json`): it auto-starts with the plugin — no manual
`.mcp.json` — and its tools surface as `mcp__plugin_bioresearcher_biomcp__*`.
Requires Node.js >= 22.13 with `npx` on PATH (the first tool call pays the
npx download). The plugin also ships the `bioresearcher-dr-worker` subagent
used by the deep-research skill's parallel fan-out. Manual wiring is only
needed for other harnesses or the all-features server variant — and a manual
registration does not deduplicate against the bundled one (commands differ),
so disable one of them via `/mcp`. See
[docs/biomcp-ts-setup.md](./docs/biomcp-ts-setup.md) for the permission model.

**Plain git clone** (pick the directory your harness reads):
`.opencode/skills/`, `.claude/skills/`, `.agents/skills/`, `.codex/skills/`,
or `.gemini/skills/`:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yeyuan98/bioresearcher-skills .opencode/skills/bioresearcher-skills
```

Gemini CLI: `gemini skills install https://github.com/yeyuan98/bioresearcher-skills` (skills install is currently a preview-channel command).

**WorkBuddy (connector market):** the same server + skills ship as a
WorkBuddy connector — see [docs/connector-workbuddy.md](./docs/connector-workbuddy.md).
Releases from v1.3.0 on carry a `bioresearcher-connector_workbuddy-v*.tar.gz`
bundle for market submission.

**OpenCode (plugin / connector):** the same server + skills + subagent ship as an
OpenCode plugin (opencode v2 only, >= 2.0.29) — see
[docs/connector-opencode.md](./docs/connector-opencode.md).
Published to npm as `opencode-bioresearcher` (`"plugins": ["opencode-bioresearcher"]`
in `opencode.json`; the biomcp MCP server is config-driven). Releases also carry
a `bioresearcher-connector_opencode-v*.tar.gz` bundle for local or offline installation.

**DeepSeek Harness (plugin / connector):** the same server + skills + subagent ship as a
DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin — see [docs/connector-dsh.md](./docs/connector-dsh.md).
Releases carry a `bioresearcher-connector_dsh-v*.tar.gz` bundle for profile
or overlay patch installation (`dsh plugin --profile web add ./bioresearcher`).

## Development

```bash
node scripts/ci/lint-frontmatter.mjs   # strict-6 Agent Skills conformance
node scripts/ci/lint-agents.mjs        # plugin subagent frontmatter + manifest agreement
node scripts/ci/check-drift.mjs        # skills.json <-> metadata <-> CHANGELOG + VERSION slots
node scripts/ci/check-links.mjs        # links + duplicate headings
bash scripts/ci/check-bundle.sh        # <=1000 files / <=10 MiB per skill
bash scripts/ci/check-legacy-names.sh  # no retired biomcp-python tool names
node scripts/ci/check-tool-names.mjs   # biomcp tool refs match pinned registry
node scripts/ci/check-marketplace.mjs  # .claude-plugin validation
node scripts/ci/check-skill-scripts.mjs # skill python scripts: selftest + help smoke
node scripts/ci/build-connector-workbuddy.mjs  # WorkBuddy connector bundle -> dist/
node scripts/ci/build-connector-opencode.mjs   # OpenCode connector bundle -> dist/
node scripts/ci/build-connector-dsh.mjs        # DeepSeek Harness connector bundle -> dist/
```

CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs all of the above plus the official
`skills-ref` validator and a local `npx skills add ./ --list` discovery
smoke. Releases are cut automatically on push to `main` when `VERSION`
changes (notes extracted from `CHANGELOG.md`).

### Empirical agent tests

`agent-test/` holds a unified, **manually-run** test suite that drives the
real opencode v2 CLI (>= 2.0.29) against these skills and a live keyless
biomcp-ts MCP server (costs LLM tokens; never run in CI):

```bash
node agent-test/run.mjs --list
node agent-test/run.mjs --only skills-q01-discovery
node agent-test/run.mjs            # all cases
```

See [agent-test/README.md](./agent-test/README.md) for the case schema and
the 12 mechanical check types. Sibling plugin test suites:
- [Claude Code plugin tests](./agent-test/claude-plugin-specific/README.md)
- [OpenCode plugin tests](./agent-test/opencode-plugin-specific/README.md)
- [DeepSeek Harness plugin tests](./agent-test/dsh-plugin-specific/README.md)

## Docs

- [biomcp-ts MCP setup](./docs/biomcp-ts-setup.md) — wiring, auth, rate limits
- [Migration from the opencode plugin](./docs/migration-from-plugin.md) — tool-name map + openFDA downgrades
- [Exposure checklist](./docs/exposure.md) — directory submission mechanics
- [Demos & partner docs](./demos/README.md) — bilingual (zh/en) Agent + MCP
  publication documents with true-run demo artifacts and a self-contained
  replay runner (`node demos/run-demo.mjs --list`); the same material powers
  the [GitHub Pages showroom](https://yeyuan98.github.io/bioresearcher-skills/)
  (source: `demos/website/`, built by `pages.yml` — enable Pages → Source:
  GitHub Actions once)

## License

Apache-2.0. Extracted and retargeted from
[opencode-bioresearcher-plugin](https://github.com/yeyuan98/opencode-bioresearcher-plugin) v1.7.2
(personal project of the same author).

# dsh-harnmem

[HarnMem](https://github.com/ys118/harnmem) memory for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a byte-stable hot-memory index injected into the system prompt, five
`harnmem_*` tools for on-demand recall and writes, and session-end extraction that turns a
finished conversation into durable memories.

The plugin is a thin adapter. Storage, retrieval, deduplication and lifecycle live in
`@harnmem/core`; this package only maps DSH host hooks onto the core facade
(`docs/design/08-dsh-adapter.md` is the implementation contract).

## What it does

- **Injection** — one prompt section (`harnmem:hot-index`, order `4050`) renders the
  in-memory hot index. Text is identical across turns (provider prefix cache stays warm);
  it is rebuilt only at session start, compaction, after a `memory_write` in the same
  session, on a local-day rollover, and after manual consolidation. An empty store
  injects `""` (zero tokens). On the first prompt of a fresh process the snapshot may not
  be ready yet, so the section falls back to a synchronous disk render of the persisted
  index; both paths share one layout function and are byte-identical.
- **Tools** — `harnmem_write`, `harnmem_search`, `harnmem_read`, `harnmem_forget`,
  `harnmem_status`. They are thin wrappers; no retrieval logic lives here. The prefix is
  configurable (`toolPrefix`): the bare `memory_*` names belong to `dsh-auto-memory`, and
  DSH keeps the first registration, so prefixed names are the only ones that can never be
  shadowed.
- **Session end** — user/assistant messages and tool names are accumulated from
  `session/event` (≤200 entries, ≤2 KB each; eviction drops the oldest non-user entry
  first, so early user prompts survive tool noise) and handed to `sessionEnd` when the agent
  is disposed. The dispose handlers return their promise, de-duplicate concurrent disposal,
  and bound the extraction race at `llmTimeoutMs` (60 s). Extraction runs `autoExtract` gates
  in core; without a host LLM the result is `no_llm` and nothing is written.
- **Quit path / resume catch-up** — the host tears the provider adapters down before
  `plugin_unload`, so no LLM call can run at quit. The session journal is durable: on
  the next open of the same session the digest is hydrated from it and, once
  `minUserMessages` (default 3) prompts are covered, `sessionEnd` runs with
  `reason:"resume_catchup"` while the LLM is alive. The `extract` audit events are the
  cross-process watermark, so a completed extraction is never repeated; newer turns
  are extracted on a later open.
- **Child agents** — subagents (`delegationDepth > 0`, `parentSession`, or
  `subagentDepth > 0`) get a read-only engine: they can search/read but never auto-write
  or extract. Only root agents persist memories.

## Install

From npm:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-harnmem
```

For development against a repo checkout, install the local path instead:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/packages/dsh-harnmem
```

The package declares `dsh.manifestVersion: 1` and `dsh.bundle.patch: ./cordis.patch.yml`, so
the reconcile step activates a layer; `cordis.patch.yml` inserts one row (`id: dsh-harnmem`,
`name: dsh-harnmem`). Remove with:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-harnmem
```

Config can be set in that patch row, or overridden per profile in
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` by targeting the same id.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `home` | `$HARNMEM_HOME` or `~/.harnmem` | Memory store root (plain files, shared by all harness adapters) |
| `injectMaxTokens` | `1200` | Hot-index token budget |
| `hotEntries` | `24` | Max entries in the hot index |
| `autoExtract` | `true` | Run session-end extraction when a host LLM is available |
| `minUserMessages` | `3` | User prompts required before extraction (also gates the resume catch-up) |
| `projectScope` | `true` | Attribute project-scope memories to the session cwd project |
| `llmTimeoutMs` | `60000` | Bound for extraction (never blocks shutdown; measured 10.8–14.1 s headless, 33.3 s desktop catch-up) |
| `consolidateEveryWrites` | `25` | Mechanical consolidation interval (0 disables) |
| `toolPrefix` | `harnmem_` | Prefix for the five model-facing tools (env `HARNMEM_TOOL_PREFIX`) |
| `log` | `on` | File log mode: `off` / `errors` / `on` (env `HARNMEM_LOG`); writes `~/.harnmem/logs/dsh.jsonl` |

Example profile patch:

```yaml
- id: dsh-harnmem
  config:
    home: /home/me/.harnmem
    injectMaxTokens: 1500
    autoExtract: true
```

## Memory store

Plain files under `~/.harnmem` (or `$HARNMEM_HOME`): one Markdown file per memory with
YAML-subset frontmatter, a rebuildable index, an audit log, and a migration ledger. No
server, no database, no network calls from the core — the only network path is the host
LLM bridge used for session-end extraction.

## Memory browser panel

The DSH web GUI (the desktop app renders the same GUI) shows a **Memory** icon in the left
sidebar (`sidebar.panellist`, id `harnmem`, order 60). It opens a read-only browser for the
store: no new config keys, no new runtime dependency, and nothing to install beyond the
plugin itself.

| View | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Overview | Store home and current project, totals (records, active, superseded, archived, pinned, bytes, tokens, shards, projects, trash), the injection-budget meter, health issues (over budget, duplicate candidates, orphans, last consolidation), index freshness, per-shard table, registered and unregistered projects, and extraction status (pending/failed). |
| Memories | Shard selector (all / user / each project), type and status filters, and a local search over title, description, preview, tags and id. Rows carry type/status/pinned badges, importance, size and relative update time. Inactive records stay visible for inspection; only active ones take part in injection. |
| Detail | Opens from a row (a drill-in, not a fifth tab): every frontmatter field, the rendered Markdown body, tags/entities/links/backlinks, the supersede (`history`) chain, and the raw file with frontmatter. Links, backlinks and history rows are clickable. |
| Index | The verbatim `MEMORY.md` hot-index text per shard (or every shard part separated by `<!-- harnmem shard: … -->`), with byte count and generation time. |
| Injection preview | Re-renders the injected block through `renderHotContextSync()` — the same core function the adapter uses, so the text matches what the model receives byte for byte — with the token estimate against the budget, the injected ids and the shard list. |

The panel is **read-only**: there is no write, delete, pin or forget action. Writes remain
with the model tools (`harnmem_write`, …) and the `harnmem` CLI, where the audit trail
lives. The host side reads the store directly through `MemoryInspector` (`@harnmem/core`):
it never opens the memory engine, never calls `HarnMem.open()`, never writes to disk and
never calls an LLM, so it cannot race the adapter's own engine or mutate `projects.json`.

### Host routes

Six JSON endpoints under `/api/harnmem/`, all `GET`, registered through the host
`connection` service (on a host without `connection.fetch` — headless ACP, test trees — the
panel is silently absent and the plugin still loads):

| Route | Query | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/harnmem/overview.get` | `cwd` (optional) | `InspectOverview` |
| `/api/harnmem/memories.list` | `shard=<all\|user\|projectId>`, `includeInactive=0\|1` | `InspectList` |
| `/api/harnmem/memory.read` | `id`, `history=1` (optional) | `InspectMemory` or `null` |
| `/api/harnmem/context.preview` | `cwd`, `budgetTokens`, `hotEntries` (optional) | `InspectContext` |
| `/api/harnmem/index.read` | `shard` (optional) | `InspectIndexText` |
| `/api/harnmem/projects.list` | — | `InspectProject[]` |

Every response uses the `{ok:true,data}` / `{ok:false,error}` envelope with
`cache-control: no-store`; bad parameters return `400`, non-GET methods `405`, internal
failures `500`. The browser bundle (`dist/client.js`) is built by `tsdown` into the
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: "dsh-harnmem", … })` format and is declared through
`exports["./client"]`; its only runtime requirement is React.

### Refresh and troubleshooting

- Views fetch when they open; the panel's refresh button (or a page reload) re-fetches.
  There is no background polling, so a memory written by a tool call shows up after one
  refresh.
- After changing plugin code, rebuild (`pnpm --filter dsh-harnmem build`, i.e. `tsc` +
  `tsdown`) and restart DSH — plugin code is loaded at startup. A page refresh alone only
  re-fetches data and cannot pick up new code.
- No icon? Confirm the profile runs the DSH web GUI (headless hosts skip the browser half
  by design) and that the host half applied: `~/.harnmem/logs/dsh.jsonl` should contain
  `plugin.apply` and `panel.api.ready` (with `routes: 6`, or `panel.api.unavailable` when
  the connection service is absent), and devtools should show `/api/harnmem/overview.get`
  returning 200 — a 404 means an older host build is loaded.
- Empty panel? `~/.harnmem` may not exist yet: the overview reports an `empty_home` issue
  and every list stays empty until the first memory is written.

## Security

- No credentials, tokens or cookies should be stored; core redacts obvious secrets before
  injection and keeps sensitive records out of the default search path.
- `memory_forget` moves records to a 30-day trash by default; `hard: true` deletes
  physically and is audited.
- The plugin never writes to DSH's own config, session logs or profile directory.

## Compatibility

| Component | Version | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| DSH runtime | `0.2.1-rc.2` | asar probe for `agent/created`, `agent/pre-step`, `session/event`, `agent/disposed`, `systemPrompt.section`, `tools.register`, `defineTool` |
| DSH checkout used for types | `0.1.3-alpha.1` | `packages/dsh-harnmem/src/dsh-types.d.ts` ambient declarations |
| Node.js | `>=22.15` | `node:zlib` zstd for migration, `node:test` for tests |

The running host resolves `@deepseek-ai/*` from its own `app.asar`; the rc builds published on
npm (`0.1.5-rc.3`) are older than the `0.2.1-rc.2` runtime. The adapter therefore compiles
against the ambient declarations in `src/dsh-types.d.ts` and declares host packages as
*optional* peers: without a host module it degrades to injection-only / `no_llm` instead of
crashing. pnpm's peer auto-install does pull the published rc builds into the workspace
`node_modules` for local development, but they are not the runtime versions and are never
bundled.

## Observability

Every lifecycle decision is logged with the `[dsh-harnmem]` prefix and, when a file log is
enabled (the trial default), mirrored as JSON lines to `~/.harnmem/logs/dsh.jsonl`:
`plugin.apply`, `plugin.ready`, `session.created`, `session.started`, `snapshot.rebuilt`
(reason, sha, bytes), `snapshot.failed`, `session.compacted`, `session.end`
(status/added/superseded/skipped/skipReason/digest size/user messages/turns/elapsed),
`session.endTimeout`, `session.disposed`, `tools.registered`, `digest.hydrated`,
`extract.catchup`, `extract.catchupFailed`, and the extraction LLM bridge
(`llm.call`, `llm.response`, `llm.callFailed`, `llm.reasoningUnsupported`). Core also appends
`kind:"extract"` events to `~/.harnmem/state/audit.jsonl` for every extraction outcome.
Tests read these entries.

## Known limitations

- **Extraction is verified end-to-end in the real runtime (2026-10-23).** A disposable ACP
  profile booting the installed DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 held 3 real user turns; on dispose the
  adapter logged `session.end status=done added=3`, `audit.jsonl` recorded one `extract`
  event and three `write` events, three memory files were written, and the next session
  injected them (719 B / 170 tokens). The desktop GUI repeat is tracked in N1. This path
  used to be silent because `memory_write` was shadowed by `dsh-auto-memory`, the digest
  evicted early prompts, the dispose handler was fire-and-forget, the 8 s budget raced a
  ~11 s extraction, and the LLM bridge imported a host-internal module that a `link:` install
  cannot resolve; all five are fixed (see `docs/research/dsh-write-silence-2026-10-23.md`).
- **Quit-time extraction is deferred, not lost (2026-10-24).** At `plugin_unload` the
  provider adapters are already gone (`code:"NO_ADAPTER"` in ms), so the write happens
  on the next open of the same session instead (the desktop app resumes the last
  session on launch). Verified in the real headless runtime: `digest.hydrated` 6
  entries / 3 users → `extract.catchup added:1` → one memory file; the dispose that
  followed logged `already_extracted`. A session that is never reopened is not
  extracted (the journal is kept).
- **A `link:`/path install is still not the product install.** The plugin resolves its host
  packages structurally (`ctx.get`, structural types) and declares them as optional peers;
  installing into a production profile is a user decision, and a path install also needs
  `@harnmem/core` resolvable (publish core first, N7).
- `agent/session-start` is unverified in DSH 0.2.1: it is registered defensively and only
  upgrades the snapshot on resume.
- Token accounting for extraction calls is not exposed by the streaming API, so
  `completionTokens` is omitted. Reasoning models can spend most of the token budget on
  hidden reasoning; the bridge requests a 4,096-token floor and falls back through
  `none`/`minimal`/`low`/default reasoning effort.
- `context.systemPrompt.context()` is intentionally not used: it materializes a durable
  user-role snapshot that would break prefix stability. The first prompt of a fresh process
  is covered by the synchronous cold-start fallback (`@harnmem/core`'s
  `renderHotContextSync`, byte-identical to the engine block).

## Development

```bash
pnpm install                     # at the repo root, links @harnmem/core
pnpm --filter dsh-harnmem build
pnpm --filter dsh-harnmem typecheck
node --test packages/dsh-harnmem/test/*.test.mjs
npm pack --dry-run               # inside packages/dsh-harnmem
```

# HarnMem

**Cross-harness agent memory that lives in plain files.**

> HarnMem = *harness* + *memory* (`harn` is also a Scots word for "brains").
> One user, one machine, one memory store — shared by every coding agent you use.

![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg)
![Status: v0.3.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-v0.3.0-blue.svg)
![CI](https://github.com/ys118/harnmem/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)
![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@harnmem/core?label=npm)
![Runtime deps: 0](https://img.shields.io/badge/runtime%20deps-0-brightgreen.svg)
![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A522.15-blue.svg)

HarnMem is a portable memory system for coding agents. It stores memories as
plain Markdown files under `~/.harnmem/`, retrieves them with a local
deterministic engine, and injects a small, byte-stable hot index into each
harness session. The same store is readable by every adapter and by the CLI, so
a memory written in one harness is available in another — no server, no vector
database, no embedding model, and no runtime dependencies in the engine.

- **Packages:** `@harnmem/core` (engine), `@harnmem/cli` (`harnmem` command),
  `pi-harnmem` (pi extension), `dsh-harnmem` (DSH plugin) — all published on
  npm at 0.3.0. Install the CLI with `npm install -g @harnmem/cli`.
- **License:** MIT.
- **Status:** v0.3.0 — core, CLI/migration, the pi adapter and the DSH adapter
  are usable and tested end to end; the Claude Code adapter is designed but not
  built, and its memory store can already be migrated with `harnmem import claude`.

## Why another memory plugin?

| Approach | Limitation for this use case |
| --- | --- |
| mem0 / Zep / Letta / OpenViking | Requires a service, vector database or Docker; heavy to install and operate |
| pi-memory | Effective inside pi, but not shared with other harnesses and no lifecycle governance |
| dsh-auto-memory | DSH-only; cross-session but not cross-harness |
| Built-in harness memory (e.g. ZCode) | Tied to one harness; store layout not reusable |
| Just put everything in `AGENTS.md` | No retrieval, no governance; grows noisy until models ignore it |

HarnMem's bet: **the source of truth is the file system, retrieval happens in
the local process, and lifecycle decisions are explainable and reversible.**

## Features

- **Cross-harness by construction.** The store and data model are
  harness-agnostic; adapters are thin. The pi adapter is the first one, and the
  CLI can read the same store without any harness.
- **File-native SSOT.** One memory per Markdown file with YAML frontmatter.
  Indexes and digests are derived and rebuildable; a corrupt index costs a
  rebuild, never data.
- **Zero runtime dependencies.** `@harnmem/core` and `@harnmem/cli` use only
  Node.js built-ins. No native modules, no downloads, no background daemon.
- **Precise recall without embeddings.** CJK-aware tokenization (character
  bigrams), BM25F field weighting, entity/tag/time filters, two-hop link
  diffusion, and an explainable score blending lexical relevance with
  importance, confidence, recency, usage, pins, links and staleness.
- **Memory that ages well.** ADD-only writes with bi-temporal supersede keep
  history; mechanical dedupe/merge keeps the store small; value-based retention
  moves entries active -> archived -> trashed; `trash/` + restore and an
  append-only `state/audit.jsonl` keep it auditable.
- **KV-cache-friendly injection.** The injected block is rebuilt only on session
  start, compaction, memory writes and day rollover, and is byte-identical
  between turns, so prompt caches keep hitting.
- **A vocabulary that grows with your corpus.** The shipped synonym tables are
  generic on purpose; `harnmem synonyms suggest` reads your own memories, asks a
  model for interchangeable terms a co-occurrence pass could never find (Chinese
  jargon usually shares no characters), validates every group against the corpus,
  and writes reviewed proposals to a local `-suggested` table. `synonyms check`
  reports the rank gain before you keep it.
- **Measured, not asserted.** A deterministic evaluation harness covers 12
  scenario suites with hard functional gates and advisory performance gates;
  ablations show which retrieval signals matter.
- **Safe migration.** Importers for DSH, pi, ZCode, Claude Code and Markdown trees
  (plus a relaxed JSON/JSONL/stdin contract) default to dry-run, back up the source,
  record a ledger, verify source integrity, and support per-run rollback. Not sure what
  you have? `harnmem import auto` probes the known stores and prints a plan.

## Quick start

Requirements: **Node.js 22.15+** and **pnpm 10** (`corepack enable`).

```bash
corepack enable
pnpm install
pnpm -r build
pnpm test            # core + CLI test suites (node --test)
```

### pi adapter

```bash
# Try it without installing: load the built extension in a one-shot pi session.
pi -e ./packages/pi-harnmem/dist/index.js -p "Remember: I prefer pnpm over npm."

# Install it as a persistent pi extension.
pi install ./packages/pi-harnmem
```

The extension injects the hot index before each turn, registers the memory
tools (`memory_write`, `memory_search`, `memory_read`, `memory_forget`,
`memory_status`), adds `/memory`, and runs a bounded extraction at session end.
Configuration lives in `~/.harnmem/config.json` (or `$HARNMEM_HOME/config.json`).

### DSH adapter

```bash
pnpm --filter dsh-harnmem build
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./packages/dsh-harnmem
```

The plugin mounts as a cordis plugin: it injects the same hot index through
`systemPrompt.section` (byte-stable, with a synchronous cold-start fallback),
registers five tools prefixed `harnmem_` (`harnmem_write`, `harnmem_search`,
`harnmem_read`, `harnmem_forget`, `harnmem_status`; the bare `memory_*` names
belong to `dsh-auto-memory`, which DSH keeps when both plugins are installed),
keeps subagent sessions read-only, and runs a bounded session-end extraction
through the host LLM service. Lifecycle and extraction decisions are written to
`~/.harnmem/logs/dsh.jsonl` (`log: "on"` is the trial default), and every
extraction outcome is emitted as a `kind:"extract"` event in
`~/.harnmem/state/audit.jsonl`. It requires DSH 0.2.x and never opens a network
connection of its own.

### CLI

```bash
node packages/cli/dist/main.js --help
node packages/cli/dist/main.js stats
node packages/cli/dist/main.js search "deployment rule" --limit 5
node packages/cli/dist/main.js write --type feedback \
  --title "Never force-push main" \
  --content "Why: shared repo. How to apply: open a PR." --importance 7

# Migrate legacy memories: dry-run by default, then --apply
node packages/cli/dist/main.js import auto          # probe known stores (DSH/pi/ZCode/Claude Code)
node packages/cli/dist/main.js import dsh
node packages/cli/dist/main.js import md --path ./notes --apply   # any Markdown tree
node packages/cli/dist/main.js import json --path export.json      # any JSON/JSONL export

# Grow the local synonym table from your own memories (nothing is auto-applied)
node packages/cli/dist/main.js synonyms list
node packages/cli/dist/main.js synonyms suggest --llm-url http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 --llm-model qwen3:8b
node packages/cli/dist/main.js synonyms check
```

### Evaluation

```bash
node evals/gen/generate.mjs           # generate deterministic corpora
node evals/gen/generate.mjs --check   # prove a second generation is byte-identical
pnpm eval                             # all suites
pnpm eval:gate                        # hard gates (perf gates are advisory)
```

## Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  subgraph Harnesses
    PI[pi extension]
    DSH[DSH plugin]
    CC[Claude Code adapter - design]
  end
  CLI[harnmem CLI + migration]
  CORE["@harnmem/core<br/>store · retrieval · writing · lifecycle · extraction"]
  PI --> CORE
  DSH --> CORE
  CC -.-> CORE
  CLI --> CORE
  CORE --> STD[(~/.harnmem plain files)]
  CORE --> IDX[(rebuildable BM25F index)]
```

A session looks like this:

1. **Session start / resume:** the adapter calls `ensureContext()`; core returns
   a hot index (pinned entries, high-value entries, recent entries, digest
   lines) within a token budget. The adapter injects it into the system prompt
   once and keeps it byte-stable until it is invalidated.
2. **During the session:** the model uses the memory tools (or the CLI) to
   write, search, read, forget and inspect memories. Writes are deduplicated
   and scoped; conflicting facts supersede old ones instead of overwriting
   history.
3. **Session end:** the adapter sends a transcript digest to one bounded LLM
   call, then writes the extracted memories (deduped against the existing
   store, with a confidence threshold and an idempotent cursor).
4. **Between sessions:** consolidation merges near-duplicates, retires stale
   entries by value/age, and (optionally) writes topic digests.

## What a memory looks like

```markdown
---
schema: 1
id: mem_01J8Z6Q0K4T9B2M7R5X3C8V1ND
type: feedback
category: workflow
scope: project
project: my-app-4f2a91c3d0
title: Never force-push main
description: Shared repository requires PRs; force-push rewrites others' history.
importance: 7
confidence: 0.9
pinned: false
status: active
created: 1760918400000
updated: 1760918400000
tags: [git, workflow]
links: []
supersedes: []
---

**Why:** `main` is shared; rewriting history disrupts other contributors.
**How to apply:** push feature branches and open a pull request.
```

Types are `user`, `feedback`, `project` and `reference`. Records are
append-only: a corrected fact creates a new record and marks the old one
`status: superseded` with `valid_to` set, so "what did I believe last month?"
is still answerable.

## Data layout

Default `~/.harnmem/` (Windows: `C:\Users\<you>\.harnmem\`):

```
~/.harnmem/
├── config.json          # optional user config (budgets, weights, governance)
├── VERSION              # store layout version
├── memories/            # SSOT: one .md file per memory
│   ├── user/            # global, cross-project scope
│   └── projects/<projectId>/
├── digests/             # optional topic digests produced by consolidation
├── prompts/             # prompt assets deployed on first run (editable)
├── data/                # synonym tables, one file per language, deployed on first run (editable)
├── projects.json        # project identity registry (git remote/path -> id)
├── index/               # derived indexes; safe to delete, rebuilt on demand
├── sessions/            # raw session journals used as extraction input
├── state/               # sequence numbers, audit log, cursors, usage overlay
├── trash/               # soft-deleted entries (30-day grace, restorable)
└── logs/                # adapter logs, e.g. logs/pi.jsonl
```

The schema and migration mapping are specified in
[`docs/design/02-data-model.md`](docs/design/02-data-model.md).

## Retrieval and ranking

Retrieval is deliberately local and explainable:

- tokenizer: English words + Chinese character bigrams (queries avoid
  boundary-unigram noise);
- BM25F over title/description/tags/entities/body with per-field weights;
- a scored blend: lexical relevance, importance, confidence, recency
  (`0.995^hours`), usage, pin, two-hop link diffusion, and a staleness penalty;
- MMR diversification and a token budget for injection;
- abstention when the best lexical evidence is too weak (prevents injecting
  irrelevant context).

The formula and its calibration are documented in
[`docs/design/03-retrieval.md`](docs/design/03-retrieval.md).

## Evaluation results

The harness is deterministic (no LLM, no network) and runs in about a minute; the numbers below come from the tracked [`eval-report.md`](evals/results/eval-report.md):

| Metric | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Suites / queries / documents | 12 (S1-S12) / 565 / 27,510 |
| Macro Recall@10 | **1.000** |
| MRR | **0.891** |
| nDCG@10 | **0.911** |
| Cross-language (zh <-> en) recall gap | 0.000 |
| Functional gates | all passing |
| Advisory performance items | 10k import ~12 s; warm search p95 ~16 ms; index ~2.9x canonical store |

The advisory items are recorded rather than hidden: import is a one-time
migration cost, and the index-size/latency targets for very large stores are on
the roadmap. Details, per-suite numbers, ablations and gate definitions are in
[`docs/design/05-evaluation.md`](docs/design/05-evaluation.md) and
[`evals/README.md`](evals/README.md).

## Harness support

| Harness | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| pi 1.3.0 | **Supported** | Extension with injection, tools, `/memory`, session-end extraction; verified end to end |
| DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1 | **Supported** (0.2.x) | Cordis plugin (`dsh-harnmem`); verified against the desktop runtime with a disposable profile and a local mock endpoint |
| CLI (any harness) | **Supported** | `harnmem` commands read/write the same store |
| Claude Code | Design (migration available) | [`docs/design/09-claude-adapter.md`](docs/design/09-claude-adapter.md) (MCP stdio server + hooks); `harnmem import claude` migrates its existing memory store today |
| Other harnesses | Welcome | See the adapter contract and `CONTRIBUTING.md` |

## Documentation

Start with the [documentation index](docs/README.md). Highlights:

- [User guide](docs/user-guide.md)
- [FAQ](docs/faq.md)
- [Design overview](docs/design/00-overview.md)
- [Data model](docs/design/02-data-model.md)
- [Retrieval](docs/design/03-retrieval.md)
- [Write lifecycle](docs/design/04-write-and-lifecycle.md)
- [Evaluation](docs/design/05-evaluation.md)
- [Adapter contract](docs/design/07-adapter-contract.md)
- [Migration onboarding](docs/design/10-migration-onboarding.md)
- [Adapter authoring guide](docs/adapter-authoring.md)

## Roadmap

See [`docs/ROADMAP.md`](docs/ROADMAP.md) for the current status (verified
numbers, the running trial, known issues) and the ordered next steps.

- Implement the Claude Code adapter (MCP stdio + hooks).
- Persist and incrementally update indexes so large stores warm up faster;
  reduce index size.
- Validate npm installs on Linux/macOS/Windows and publish provenance for
  every release.
- Harden concurrent writes across harnesses sharing one home.
- Add an optional, opt-in reranker or LLM selector for ambiguous recalls
  (never required for basic use).

## Security and privacy

HarnMem is local-first: no telemetry, no background service, and the engine never
opens a network connection. The CLI is offline by default too; the only outbound
call is the opt-in `harnmem synonyms suggest --llm-url` bridge, which runs solely
when you pass an endpoint. Memory content is sensitive by nature — back up
`~/.harnmem/`, keep it out of version control, and read
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) before reporting a vulnerability. The store uses
symlink/path containment checks, size caps, sensitive-value redaction, soft
delete and an audit log; see the design docs for details.

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome. Start with [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), follow
the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md), and run `pnpm test` and
`pnpm eval:gate` before opening a pull request. Note the contribution gate:
issues and pull requests from new contributors are auto-closed by default and
reopened once a maintainer approves them with `lgtmi` (issues) or `lgtm`
(issues and pull requests). Merging `master` is PR-only and requires the owner's
approval. Questions and ideas are welcome in
[Discussions](https://github.com/ys118/harnmem/discussions). Security issues go
through the private process in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## License

<sub>大鲸鱼在线写插件</sub>

# dsh-session-progress

> 你是不是还在为了不知道大肥鱼在吃多少白饭，到底干活干到哪了而烦恼？别担心！让我来助你！全新进度条让你实时了解大鲸鱼在干嘛！将进度条接入大模型注入上下文，让鲸鱼去监督鲸鱼！可选监督大模型、可调思考强度、可变进度条颜色、可变进度条样式，懂鱼更懂你！

![侧栏实机：一条淡蓝色带从左往右爬过会话行](dev/sidebar.png)

> 一条会自己爬的色带，长在 DSH 侧栏的每一行会话上。它不催你，也不打断任何东西——只是有个便宜的小模型每 30 秒瞄一眼鲸鱼在干嘛，然后把答案画成一行像素。

## 先说清楚它是什么

AI 干活最难受的地方不是慢，是**不知道它在哪**。

一轮跑了二十分钟，你只能盯着最后一个工具调用猜：是卡住了，是在跑测试，还是已经快好了？点进去翻日志，翻完发现它只是在等一个超时。

这个插件把那个答案变成侧栏上一条会动的东西。你刷手机回来，扫一眼色带的位置，就知道该继续等还是该进去看看。

它和普通的进度条不一样在三件事：

- 色带**铺在整行底下**，不是另一根独立的条。标题、时间、悬停按钮照常可读可点——一个 DOM 节点都没往行里插，用的是 `::after` 和两个 CSS 变量。
- **判断的也是模型**。真正干活的那个没空汇报，就派一个最轻的读一遍当前轮次的上下文，让它说「大概到 62% 了」。提示里带着它自己上一次给的数字和阶段名，所以卡住了它会往下调，不会为了好看一路抬到 95。
- **它自己在花钱**。每 30 秒一次小调用，约 1–2k 输入 token，默认最多同时盯 3 个会话。这笔钱单独记账，面板顶栏能看到判断模型累计吃掉了多少 token——你主对话的账单不受影响。

## 装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Yu-jianhai/dsh-session-progress
```

然后**完全退出 DSH 再打开**。`hmr` 在我们这台机器上是关的，只刷新窗口不会加载新代码。

想锁版本就跟 commit：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Yu-jianhai/dsh-session-progress#<commit-sha>
```

纯 JavaScript、`lib/` 已提交，**没有构建步骤**，不需要给 pnpm 授权跑 `prepare`。卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-session-progress
```

## 用起来是什么样

| 位置 | 你会看到什么 |
|---|---|
| 侧栏会话行 | 整行宽的色带，宽度就是进度。默认 `#90AFFF`、60% 不透明、900ms 缓动——每采一次样，它往前跳一步 |
| 设置 → 插件 → 会话进度条 | 模型、思考强度、采样间隔、同屏数量、颜色、不透明度、样式、动画、彩虹，改哪个下面那行预览就跟着变；「保存」后表单显示的是**宿主实际存下的值**，「恢复默认」把全部打回出厂 |
| 左侧栏「进度日志」 | 判断模型的每一次采样，一个会话一列、从左到右并排；最左边是历史轮次列 |
| 设置页里那张同名卡片 | 只是个入口——点按钮直接打开上面那块面板，不在这儿再复制一份数据 |

## 它是怎么想的

1. 你发一条消息 → 这个会话开始采样，色带从 `seedP`（4%）起步，先给你一点"动了"的反馈；
2. 之后每 30 秒一次。提示里带着**上一次的数字 + 当时它写的阶段名**（「当前进度：45%（当时阶段是「改接口」）」），请它对照这半小时的记录自己判断：又推进了多少、有没有停滞返工、上次是不是估高了。
   往前往后都照单全收，宿主只封顶 95——**方向是它的**，不是宿主的。
3. 你在一轮没跑完时又插嘴 → 剩余工作量变了，`interjectDelayMs`（2.5 秒）后补采一次，并明确告诉它"目标变了，按新要求重估"，日志里那条会挂一个橙色「重估」。
4. `turn/end`（不管什么原因结束）→ 立刻补满 100，停 700ms，再花 420ms 淡出。
5. 采样失败 → 保留上一次的值。色带只在会话真的在跑的时候存在。

被中断的轮次会把当时到几成记下来。下次同一个会话再开跑，色带**从那个数字接着爬**，而不是退回 0；判断模型也会被告知"上一轮被打断，已到 X%"，免得它把接续的活当成新活估成个位数。

## 面板

面板有两套皮肤，在设置里「面板样式」切换，**只影响这块日志面板**，侧栏色带不受影响：

| 皮肤 | 样子 |
|---|---|
| 新 · 分组卡片（默认） | 每个会话一张圆角卡片，列头是一整块**染了该会话色相**的色块（标题、百分比、次数、曲线都在块里），行与行之间只有一条极淡的分隔线，按钮是胶囊形 |
| 旧 · 紧凑列表 | 0.20 那版：贴着内容的紧凑列，列头是中性色的一行字 |

一个会话一列，列头两行：色点 + 会话名，下面是「当前百分比 · 采样次数」、最近一次的时间，右边一条**最近 24 次估计的曲线**（最旧在左）。一条采样一行：时间 / 百分比 / 涨跌（`+7` 绿、`-5` 橙）/ 阶段名 / 耗时；最右边的小箭头表示能点开，点开才看模型、档位、token 拆分和 JSON 原文。

最左边是**历史轮次**列：一个结束（或被打断）的回合一小块，写着 `#轮次`、完成/中断徽章和最后一次的百分比。它跟着首屏一起加载，但**一次只发 40 轮**，列底还有「再看 40 轮」；下一页用 `historyBefore=<最早那行的 at>` 当游标，所以这期间新结束的回合不会把队列顶乱。

行是**完整的**——展开能看到模型、档位、耗时和 JSON 原文。0.20.1 曾经为了省流量把行裁成八个字段，结果详情面板里耗时全是 `0s`、展开是空的；四十行的分页比削字段划算得多（首屏约 18 KB）。

列本身贴着内容长，不会在屏幕下半截拖出三个空盒子；条目多了就在列内滚动，「还有 N 条」往下放。

## 配置

配置文件：`~/.dsh/session-progress.config.json`（UI 保存的值优先于 `cordis.patch.yml`）。

| 键 | 默认 | 范围 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | — | 总开关 |
| `provider` | `deepseek-account` | — | 模型提供方 |
| `model` | `deepseek-flash` | — | 判断用的模型 |
| `reasoningEffort` | `off` | — | 思考强度；模型没有这档时**按档位距离取最近的**一档并打日志 |
| `intervalMs` | `30000` | 5000–3600000 | 采样间隔 |
| `interjectDelayMs` | `2500` | 500–30000 | 插嘴后多久补采一次 |
| `firstDelayMs` | `8000` | 0–3600000 | 本轮首次采样前的等待，让模型先做点事 |
| `maxSessions` | `3` | 1–10 | 同屏显示的进度条数量，也是同时采样的上限 |
| `maxContextChars` | `6000` | — | 送进模型的上下文上限（超出截尾） |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | — | 单次采样超时 |
| `seedP` | `4` | — | 首次采样回来之前的起步宽度 |
| `color` | `#90AFFF` | `#RRGGBB` | 色带颜色；非十六进制会被忽略并保留旧值 |
| `opacity` | `0.6` | 0.05–1 | 色带不透明度 |
| `style` | `band` | 六种之一 | 色带形状，见下节 |
| `flow` | `true` | 布尔 | 色带里那道流动的光开不开 |
| `flowSpeed` | `slow` | `slow` / `normal` / `fast` | 光走一圈：慢 10.5s、标准 5.9s、快 3s |
| `flowQuality` | `medium` | `refract` / `high` / `medium` / `low` / `off` | 表面那层的质感，见「流动的质感」 |
| `rainbow` | `false` | 布尔 | 实验：色带换成会走的彩虹 |

**思考强度以模型目录为准。** 设置页的下拉、采样时传给 adapter 的值、启动时打印的 `offered: …`，都来自同一份 `listModels()`；`resolveModelInfo()` 跟它对不上时以目录为准（`deepseek-flash` 的目录里就有 `off`）。

## 外观

六个选项：颜色、不透明度、样式、流动动画、动画速率、动画质量。下面那行预览是**用当前数值真画出来的**，拖颜色的时候侧栏的色带会跟着变。

预览是实时的，也是**临时**的：不保存就离开，会还原成已保存的值。宿主每 2 秒会广播一次自己保存的样式，插件把"未保存的预览"和"已保存的值"分开记，所以广播顶不回去。

六种形状（`style`）：

| 值 | 样子 | 什么时候用 |
|---|---|---|
| `band` | 渐变横幅，右端 10px 渐隐 | 默认。最像"进度条"，高对比但不抢标题 |
| `solid` | 纯色实条，右端 1px 亮边 | 最克制；侧栏窄、颜色又淡时比 `band` 更清楚 |
| `underline` | 3px 细线贴行底 | 不想压住标题和时间的读法 |
| `stripe` | 45° 斜纹叠在底色上 | 进度变化慢、但希望"在跑"这件事一直显眼 |
| `glow` | 左淡右亮 + 内侧亮边 + 柔光 | 视觉最重，适合只在少数会话上开 |
| `segments` | 按 20% 切格 | 想一眼看出"到第几格" |

颜色要写成 `#RRGGBB`。取色器（包括那支吸管）偶尔会回 `rgb(18, 171, 52)` 这种写法，插件会先自己归一化；实在解析不出来就保留旧值，不会把配置写坏。

想先肉眼挑，打开 `dev/styles.html`（`node dev/gen-styles.mjs` 从真实源码生成：六种样式 × 三种进度 × 三种不透明度 × 三种颜色）。

### 流动的质感

色带里有一道光在走。判断模型半分钟才给一次新数字，中间这段时间靠它让人知道"还在动"。质感分五档：

| 值 | 效果 | 代价 |
|---|---|---|
| `refract` 实验 · 流光 | 两道低对比的光带**反向**平移（一亮一暗，各自一个周期刚好接上），填充层带玻璃浮雕边——上沿提亮、下沿压暗，看起来像表面自己在流 | 多一层 `blur(1.5px)` 合成；卡就往 `medium` 退。它永远在文字**下面**，不糊字 |
| `high` 高级 | 水波 + 光学：`feTurbulence` + `feDisplacementMap` 让光的边缘随水波摆，再叠 `backdrop-filter` 把底下颜色晕开、提亮 | GPU 吃最多 |
| `medium` 中等（默认） | 只有水波扭曲，边缘像水面裂纹那样左右摆 | 中等 |
| `low` 低 | 扁平高光，形状不动（0.10 及以前的样子） | 几乎为零 |
| `off` 关 | 没有光 | 零 |

那几张 SVG 滤镜由插件挂在 `<body>` 里，启动时建、卸载时删，规则里只是 `filter: url(#…)` 引用。不联网、不依赖外部资源。万一壳子造不出滤镜，会**静默退回纯色高光**——引用一个不存在的 `filter` 会让整个元素都不画，这种失败必须挡住。

想看五档差别，打开 `dev/water.html`（`node dev/gen-water.mjs`）：上面等比例、下面放大 2.6 倍，底部写着每档 `filter` / `backdrop-filter` 的实际取值。

### 实验 · 彩虹走马灯

颜色那栏底下的开关。打开后色带不是涂单色，而是一段**会走的彩虹**：

- 七段色**等距排开、交给浏览器插值**（红橙黄绿青蓝紫再回红），所以是化开的，不是六条硬边。循环 168px，用一个周期 170.592px（`168 / sin(100°)`）走出去，首尾同相，多宽都看不到接缝；
- 速度跟着「动画速率」：慢 7s、标准 4.4s、快 2.6s；
- 表面那层同时被借来当**光晕**：同一份光谱 `blur(6px)` 之后用 `mix-blend-mode: screen` 叠上去，是加光不是加颜料——用普通透明度整条会糊成粉彩；
- 光晕被裁在色带里，不漏到旁边的行；彩虹层上压 12% 黑纱，否则白字走到黄绿段上会看不清；
- 关掉「流动动画」它就变成**静止的彩虹**——那个开关管的是"动不动"，不是"有没有颜色"。

## 换一台机器 / 别的 provider

`provider` / `model` 的两个默认值只是**偏好**，不是硬依赖。宿主第一次读到模型目录时会核对：

1. 配置的模型在 → 直接用；
2. 不在 → 按名字挑个便宜的顶上（`mini`/`lite`/`small`/`nano`/`haiku` 优先，其次 `flash`/`fast`/`instant`，最后 `turbo`，都没有取目录第一个），实际生效的路线写进 `/config` 的 `effectiveRoute`，设置页显示一行「原配置的模型在本机不存在，已自动改用 X」；
3. 目录是空的（这台机器还没配任何 provider）→ **一次模型都不调**，`/config` 回 `catalogEmpty: true`，界面直接告诉你「先去配一个 provider」。

所以 `cordis.patch.yml` 里**不写死** provider/model：别人 clone 下来装上，第一次运行就知道该用什么。想锁定，在设置卡里选一次，值会落到本机配置文件。

## 原理（为什么不用 React 组件）

DSH 给每个会话行渲染了稳定属性 `data-row-key="session:<id>"`，但**没有**一个常显的行内插槽：running 时 `sidebar.session.row.leading` 被状态点占着，行尾按钮只在悬停时出现。

所以本插件一个 DOM 节点都不往行里插，只做两件事：

1. 注入一张固定样式表：给行加 `position: relative; isolation: isolate`，用 `::after` 画色带（宽度取 `--dsp-p`、不透明度取 `--dsp-o`，`z-index: -1` 待在行背景之上、文字之下），用 `::before` 画表面那层；
2. 每次进度变化时重写另一张很小的样式表，按 id 写 `[data-row-key="session:<id>"]{--dsp-p:42%;--dsp-o:.6}`。

`--dsp-p` 用 `@property` 注册成 `<percentage>`，于是"改变量"就等于"CSS 原生过渡"，不需要 React 重绘，也不受会话行重渲染影响。（`inherits` 必须是 `true`：变量写在行上、由伪元素读取，否则伪元素拿到初始值 `0%`，宽度永远是 0。）

运行态不轮询，只听宿主事件：

```js
ctx.on('session/event',      (session, event) => event.type === 'turn/start' ? run() : event.type === 'turn/end' ? idle() : null)
ctx.on('api-session/status', (sessionId, running) => …)
ctx.on('agent/status',       ({ agent, status }) => …)
```

动画也不是散的：色带的动作全部由一张表决定（`SURFACES`：动作、图案、有没有滤镜、浮雕），周期 264px、位移 268.073px 只算一次，两段 `@keyframes` 由这个数生成后写进样式表。加一档只改表，改一下周期也只改一个数。

### 端点（只监听回环地址）

| 路径 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `/plugins/dsh-session-progress/events` | SSE，首帧全量，之后每次变化一帧（内容没变就不发） |
| `/plugins/dsh-session-progress/snapshot` | 一次性 JSON 快照 |
| `/plugins/dsh-session-progress/log` | 采样历史（环形缓冲 300 条 + 关闭的 600 条），支持 `since` 增量 |
| `/plugins/dsh-session-progress/config` | 读 / 写配置 |
| `/plugins/dsh-session-progress/debug` | 运行态、采样器、实际档位、模型目录、客户端版本 |

这些端点拒绝非本机 `Host` 的请求，不会对外网暴露。

## 已知取舍

- **依赖 `data-row-key` 这个内部属性。** 宿主改渲染方式时色带会静默消失——不崩溃、不错位、不污染别人的界面。
- **列头用会话名，不用 id。** 取值顺序：`session/title` 的标题 → 该会话第一条用户消息（截 40 字）→ 短 id。新会话在自动命名之前，会先用你发的那句话当名字。
- **自动换模型只看名字。** 名字里没有便宜档线索时取目录第一个，可能正好是贵的那个；设置页改一次即可锁定。
- **拖拽排序时会闪一下。** 宿主用 `::before`/`::after` 画插入指示线，跟我们的伪元素撞一瞬。
- **颜色是字面色，不走主题 token。** `#90AFFF` 是需求指定的值，暗色主题下偏亮；只有下拉菜单这类原生控件交给 `--dsw-alias-*`。
- **会真的花 token。** 每会话每 30 秒一次真实调用（约 1–2k 输入 token），默认最多 3 个会话。把 `intervalMs` 调大或 `enabled: false` 随时停。
- **采样不并发。** 同一会话上一拍没回来，这一拍就跳过。

## 开发

```sh
node scripts/snapshot.cjs pre-<你要干什么>   # 开工先拍快照，崩了一键回滚
npm test                                     # 十套
npm run check
```

- **改代码前先读 [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)**（60 秒开工流程）和 [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](ARCHITECTURE.md)（符号索引），**报错先查 [`PROBLEMS.md`](PROBLEMS.md)**（每条都真炸过一次：现象 → 原因 → 修法 → 哪条测试守着）。
- `node scripts/snapshot.cjs <label>` 把源码、测试、探针页、文档打包到 `backups/`（不进 git，带 git rev 与逐文件 sha256）；`node scripts/restore.cjs latest` 原地恢复，并删掉快照之后新增的散文件。
- `test/host-smoke.mjs`：宿主半侧冒烟，用临时 state 文件，不碰你真实的 `~/.dsh/*.json`。
- `test/direction.mjs`：`nextProgress` 的方向规则——上下都收、封顶 95、解析失败保留原值。
- `test/client-boot.mjs`：桩 DOM 把浏览器半侧整个启动，喂真实 SSE 帧，断言样式表真的写出来、清理真的收干净。纯函数测试看不到这类错——`render()` 里一个未定义标识符会让色带**整条消失**，控制台只有一行 `bad frame`。
- `test/render.mjs`：四个 slot（`main` / `sidebar.panellist` / `plugins.bundle.config` / `settings.plugins.tab`）用空 payload 与满 payload 各渲染一次。0.11.2 那次白屏就是 `data.active` 空指针——`Number(null) === 0` 骗过了守卫，只有真渲染才发现。
- `test/route-fallback.mjs`：模拟别人的机器——目录里没有默认模型时自动改用便宜模型、目录为空时一次模型都不调。
- `test/perf-contract.mjs`：空转成本三条线（增量 `/log`、SSE 去重、落盘瘦身）、客户端自报版本、历史行裁剪。
- `dev/release.cjs`：发版用，「大鲸鱼在线写插件」那句由它加到正文开头，别再手拼 `curl`。
- `dev/harness.html`、`dev/flow.html`、`dev/water.html`、`dev/panel.html`、`dev/styles.html`：把真实行结构、真实 CSS、真实采样数据拉进独立页面，没有宿主也能比对观感。
- 浏览器侧没有 JSX、没有构建：`lib/client.js` 是 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 形式，React 从 `require('react')` 拿。

repository 地址即 GitHub 公开仓库；插件市场收录要另外向 awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin 提 PR（没有 npm 关键字自动发现）。
scripts 用带引号的 glob 而不是『node --test test/』：Node 22+ 传目录会把它当模块入口解析，报 Cannot find module .../test；测试文件统一命名 *.test.js。
icon 必须是包内相对路径（不能是 emoji 或 URL），格式限 SVG/PNG/JPEG/WebP 且 ≤256KiB。
engines.dsh 一旦声明，@deepseek-ai/dsh* 的 peerDependencies 就不再参与内核兼容判定（dsh-app-boot 的 if/else），所以范围要自己定得合理：整个 0.2 大版本放行，避免内核打补丁就整插件被拒。
peerDependencies 只是给 pnpm 解析用的声明，全部 optional，不实际安装内核包。
peer 范围必须逐个小版本枚举预发布分支：node-semver 只放行「元组相同且自身带预发布标签」的比较符，所以 >=0.2.0-rc.0 <0.3.0-0 匹配不到 0.2.1-rc.2（内核当前版本），用户装包会撞 ERESOLVE。这里枚举到 0.2.9 覆盖整条 0.2 线；内核进入 0.3 或新增小版本时要同步扩这个范围。
files 必须包含 cordis.patch.yml，否则安装后校验 dsh.bundle 会 not-bundle 失败并回滚。
客户端入口只由 exports["./client"] 决定，没有 dsh.client.entry/files 这种字段；dsh.client 只认 platform/inject/external/immediately 四个键，未知键被静默忽略。
dsh.client.inject 只列真的会用的：ui-settings 声明 settings.section 槽，locale 提供中文文案。react 在外壳基座模块表里，不必列。写错包名会让整张启动图组合失败。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# 收纳间 dsh-closet

> DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的临时脚本与日志管理器：**按工作区登记脚本、只读扫描遗留物、一键清运进可还原回收站。**

中文 | [English](./README.en.md)

DSH 干活时会留下大量临时脚本和日志 —— `fix-xxx.ps1`、`upgrade-xxx.ps1`、`restart-dsh.log`、`*.bak`…… 事后没人记得哪个还能用、哪个已经过期、哪个可以删。

收纳间就是给这些产物准备的**一个抽屉**：放进去的都记在册上，没放的会被扫出来问你，清掉的先进回收站，随时能捞回来。

## 三条铁律

1. **跟着工作区走**：数据存在 `<工作区>/.dsh-fix/`，换工作区就是换一个抽屉，绝不往用户目录乱写。
2. **扫描永不删除**：`closet_scan` 只列清单、给理由，一个字节都不动。
3. **清理只做移动**：`closet_clean` 把文件移进 `.dsh-fix/trash/<批次>/`，附带 `manifest.json` 记录原路径，随时可还原；真正的删除只有「过期清理」一处入口，默认 30 天后才允许，且默认只做预演。

## 目录结构

```
<工作区>/
└── .dsh-fix/                    # 收纳间（dataDir 可配置）
    ├── registry.json            # 登记册：路径/语言/用途/状态/运行次数
    ├── logs/<脚本名>/            # 每次执行的完整输出，按时间戳分文件
    │   └── 20261018-165530.log
    └── trash/<批次>/             # 回收站
        ├── manifest.json        # 每个文件的原路径与体积
        └── <搬进来的文件>
```

## 工具

装上插件后，AI 可以直接调用 8 个工具：

| 工具 | 作用 | 会改文件吗 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `closet_workspaces` | 列出 DSH 里已登记的工作区（标题、路径、会话数、目录是否还在），最新的排前面；`onlyExisting: true` 只留目录还在的 | 否 |
| `closet_register` | 登记一个脚本：路径、用途、语言、状态（active/done/obsolete） | 只写登记册 |
| `closet_list` | 列出登记册，并标注「文件还在不在」 | 否 |
| `closet_scan` | 扫描工作区，列出疑似遗留物及判定理由；`skipTracked: true` 可完全不显示已被 git 跟踪的文件 | **否** |
| `closet_run` | 按语言执行登记过的脚本，输出写进日志 | 只写日志 |
| `closet_clean` | 把指定文件移进回收站（可还原）；**已被 git 跟踪的文件会被拒收**，确需清运要带 `force: true` | 移动 |
| `closet_trash` | 查看回收站批次；`expire: true` 才做过期清理（默认预演） | 只在过期清理时删除 |
| `closet_logs` | 列出某个脚本的执行日志，或读取某份日志的末尾 | 否 |

也可以在 GUI 的 **设置 → 脚本与日志** 面板里点点点。

### 一个典型回合

```
用户：这次排查完了，把临时脚本收拾一下
AI  ：closet_register { path: ".dsh-fix/upgrade-wbc.ps1", purpose: "升级 workbuddy 连接器", status: "done" }
AI  ：closet_scan → 发现 8 个遗留物（3 个 .bak、2 个日志、3 个临时脚本），附判定理由
用户：前 5 个可以清
AI  ：closet_clean { paths: [...] } → 已移入回收站批次 20261018-165530
```

## 支持的语言

按扩展名自动识别，多语言通用：

| 语言 | 扩展名 | 缺省解释器 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PowerShell | `.ps1` `.psm1` `.psd1` | `pwsh`，缺失时退到 `powershell.exe` |
| Node | `.js` `.mjs` `.cjs` `.ts` | `node` |
| Python | `.py` | `python`，缺失时退到 `py -3` |
| 批处理 | `.bat` `.cmd` | `cmd.exe /d /c` |
| Shell | `.sh` `.bash` `.zsh` | `bash` |

解释器路径可在配置里覆盖，见下。

## 配置

写在插件条目的 `config` 下（`cordis.yml`，或安装后由 `cordis.patch.yml` 注入的默认值）：

```yaml
dsh-closet:
  enabled: true
  dataDir: .dsh-fix              # 收纳间目录名，相对工作区
  trashRetentionDays: 30         # 回收站保留天数
  ignore: []                     # 额外忽略的目录名或 glob，如 ['*.bak', 'build']
  maxScanFiles: 5000             # 扫描上限，防止在大仓库里扫穿
  maxScanDepth: 64               # 扫描最大深度
  runTimeoutMs: 120000           # 单次执行超时（毫秒）
  maxLogBytes: 2097152           # 单个日志文件上限（字节）
  maxCleanBatch: 200             # 单次最多清运多少项
  maxCleanBytes: 209715200       # 单次最多清运多少字节（200 MB）
  interpreters: {}               # 覆盖解释器，键为语言名，值为 argv 数组
```

`ignore` 里写错的值会被丢弃而不是「忽略一切」——配置写坏只会让扫描结果变多，不会让它变空。

## 面板

安装后在 **设置 → 脚本与日志** 里：

- 已登记脚本：状态、路径、运行次数；文件已被删掉的会标红提示。
- 顶部下拉框：自动列出 DSH 里所有已登记的工作区，选一个就能直接看它的脚本、扫描结果和日志，不用再手打路径；也仍然可以手动填任意目录。
- 扫描遗留物：勾选后点「移进回收站」，一次一批。表头第一个复选框可一键全选（被 git 跟踪的文件不参与），部分勾选时显示半选状态。
- 每行文件下方有两个按钮：**打开位置**（资源管理器里选中它，不执行任何东西）与 **打开文件**（交给系统默认程序）。可执行文件（`.ps1`/`.bat`/`.exe` 等）点「打开文件」前会先弹一次确认——用默认程序打开它们等于运行它。
- 回收站：按批次列出体积与条目，可一键还原。
- 执行日志：按脚本分组，点开看最近 200 行。

面板接口走 `/dsh-closet/api/*`，只接受同源请求（拒 `cross-site` 与 `origin: null`）。

## 安全设计

- **不会误删**：`closet_clean` 只移动；真正删除只有 `closet_trash { expire: true }` 一条路，默认 `dryRun`。
- **不动版本库里的东西**：扫描会照常列出已被 git 跟踪的文件（标 `tracked` + 「⚠ 已被 git 跟踪」），但判定固定为「待确认」，`closet_clean` 默认整批拒收；确需处理要显式带 `force: true`。工作区不是 git 仓库或本机没装 git 时，保护自动降级并在结果里明说。
- **不会越界**：只能处理**工作区内**的文件；`..` 穿越、大小写变体、软链接/目录联接绕过都被拦截（字面路径与真实路径双重校验）。
- **不会扫穿**：`node_modules`、`.git` 等默认跳过，软链接不跟随，深度与文件数有上限。
- **不会写坏**：`registry.json` 走「写临时文件 → rename」的原子写；文件损坏时先改名留存现场再重建。
- **不会拖死**：脚本执行有超时保护，超时用 `taskkill /T` 连同子进程整棵树杀掉（POSIX 走进程组）。
- **打开文件不注入命令**：`/open` 只用 `spawn(command, [args])` 起进程，从不拼 shell 字符串；路径先过「字面在工作区内 → realPath 之后仍在工作区内 → 文件真实存在」三道闸，外部字符串拼不出可执行命令。**默认动作是「打开位置」（资源管理器里选中），不是执行**。

## 开发

```bash
npm test           # 单测 129 + 端到端冒烟 21 + 文档一致性；零依赖，全用 Node 内置 test runner
npm run test:unit  # 只跑单测
npm run lint:syntax
```

项目结构：

```
lib/
├── store.js    登记册读写（原子写、路径规范化、语言识别）
├── scan.js     遗留物扫描（只读）
├── run.js      多语言执行（spawn + 日志 + 超时 + 进程树强杀）
├── trash.js    回收站（移动/还原/过期清理）
├── config.js   配置归一化 + 原生 Schemastery schema（拿不到内核依赖时用自带的兼容 schema）
├── routes.js   HTTP 面板接口
├── client.js   设置面板（CJS factory 单文件，无需构建）
├── workspaces.js 读 DSH 的工作区登记表（只读，拿不到就降级返回空列表）
├── open.js     用系统程序打开文件/位置（路径三重校验，spawn 不拼 shell）
└── index.js    插件入口，8 个工具的定义与装配

test/
├── *.test.js       单测（store / scan / run / trash / contract）
├── smoke.mjs       端到端冒烟：真 ctx + 真文件系统，工具与路由都跑一遍
├── docs-check.mjs  文档与实现一致性（工具名 / 模块 / 版本号）
└── host-stubs.js   把 @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm 等宿主包替换成桩，让纯 Node 也能 import 入口
```

`store` / `scan` / `run` / `trash` 四层**不依赖 DSH**，可以单独用、单独测、换宿主也能跑。

`lib/client.js` 是手写的 `window.__ModuleLoader__` CJS factory，改完不需要重启，HMR 会自己刷新（React 组件状态会丢）。改 `lib/index.js`、`package.json` 或 `cordis.patch.yml` 需要重启 DSH。

## 许可

MIT

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-ensp

> 让 AI 直接开华为 eNSP 做网络实验：后台批量驱动 GUI、telnet 下发命令、读写 `.topo`、自动出实验报告。

[![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/YunoSeng/dsh-ensp)](https://github.com/YunoSeng/dsh-ensp/releases)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/YunoSeng/dsh-ensp)](LICENSE)

一个 [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（DeepSeek Harness）插件。给 AI 装上这套工具后，它能自己打开拓扑、启动设备、下发配置、验证连通性、截图，最后生成两份带截图的 Word 实验报告。

**实测环境**：Windows 10/11 + eNSP 1.3.00.100（client 1.2.0.500）+ DSH。所有坐标、坑、耗时都在真机上验证过，下面标 ⚠ 的是换机器要重新确认的点。

---

## 它解决什么问题

AI 操控 eNSP 最慢、最容易翻车的环节是**点鼠标**：真实点击要移动指针、抢前台、等窗口响应，一场实验几百次点击，每次几十毫秒到几秒，还会打到用户正在用的窗口里。

这个插件做了两件事：

1. **把界面动作批量化并提到提权桥上执行**——一整套点击写进一次调用，启动成本约 0.3 s，之后每步 15–90 ms。
2. **把大部分操作改走别的通道**——telnet 下发命令、直接读写 `.topo` 文件、窗口 DC 截图（不抢焦点、不怕被遮挡），只有必须点界面的地方才真的动鼠标。

### 速度对比（本机实测）

| 操作 | 手工 / 逐条调用 | 用本插件 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 下发一条配置命令 | 开窗口 + 打字 ≈ 3–5 s | telnet **60 ms** |
| 读拓扑（设备名/型号/端口/IP 规划） | 截图肉眼找 | 解析 `.topo` **1 ms** |
| 主窗口截图 | 全屏截图 200 ms+，还怕遮挡 | 窗口 DC **74 ms** |
| 启动全部 11 台设备 | 手工点 + 盲等 | `start_all` **8.7 s**（含等所有端口起来） |
| 保存配置 | 进用户视图 + `save` + 答 `y` | 自动完成 **0.3 s** |
| 一次 `ensp_gui` 调用 | —— | 批内每步 15–90 ms |

---

## 环境要求

| 项 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| 系统 | Windows（依赖 UIPI / `ShellExecuteW` / BitBlt，非 Windows 不适用） |
| eNSP | 华为 eNSP（实测 1.3.00.100，客户端 1.2.0.500） |
| 宿主 | DSH Desktop（插件以 `cordis.patch.yml` bundle 形式加载） |
| Python | 3.9+ 且带 `pywin32` + `Pillow`（提权桥用，插件会自动探测候选解释器，也可用配置指定）。生成 docx 用 DSH 自带 Python（含 `python-docx`） |
| 权限 | 建议 **DSH 以管理员身份运行**（原因见 [UAC](#uac会弹几次授权框)） |

---

## 安装

插件是标准的 DSH bundle：`package.json` 里声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`，DSH 启动时按 `cordis.patch.yml` 加载 `index.js`。装法三选一：

| 方式 | 命令 / 写法 | 适合 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 本地 link（开发） | `"dsh-ensp": "link:E:/dsh-plugins/dsh-ensp"` | 改了代码重启即生效，自己改插件时用 |
| 直接从 GitHub 装 | `pnpm add github:YunoSeng/dsh-ensp#v0.1.0` | 不改代码，只想要某一版 |
| Release zip | [下载 zip](https://github.com/YunoSeng/dsh-ensp/releases) 解压后用 `link:` 挂上 | 不想装 git、或机器不能访问 GitHub |

下面以本地 link 为例（同理可换成 `github:` 写法）：

1. 克隆到本地任意目录：

   ```powershell
   git clone https://github.com/YunoSeng/dsh-ensp.git E:\dsh-plugins\dsh-ensp
   ```

2. 在你的 DSH profile（例如 `C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\web\package.json`）里挂上它：

   ```json
   {
     "dependencies": {
       "dsh-ensp": "link:E:/dsh-plugins/dsh-ensp"
     },
     "dsh": {
       "profile": {
         "bundles": ["dsh-ensp"]
       }
     }
   }
   ```

   再让 Node 能解析到这个包（junction / symlink 二选一）：

   ```powershell
   New-Item -ItemType Junction `
     -Path "C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-ensp" `
     -Target "E:\dsh-plugins\dsh-ensp"
   ```

3. 重启 DSH。技能目录里会出现 `ensp-automation`，工具列表里会出现 `ensp_*` 六个工具。

4. 验证：让 AI 调一次 `ensp_status`，返回 `bridge.available: true`、`bridge.elevated: true` 就说明提权桥通了。

> 插件会以 `runas` 启动一个提权 Python 侧车（`lib/bridge.py`）来点界面。**这是全插件唯一主动请求提权的地方**，细节见 [UAC](#uac会弹几次授权框)。

---

## 提供的工具

| 工具 | 用途 | 典型耗时 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ensp_status` | 开工前探明现状：桥是否可用/已提权、已打开的 eNSP 实例与窗口、本机装了哪些版本、已打开的设备窗口、`.topo` 里的设备与标注、控制台端口是否已开放 | 0.4–1 s |
| `ensp_gui` | 把一整套界面动作塞进一次调用：`start_all` / `stop_all` / `open_console` / `close_console` + 全部底层 op（点击、拖拽、滚轮、打字、按键、截图、读控件） | 0.3 s + 15–90 ms/步 |
| `ensp_shot` | 截图：`main`（主窗口）/ `device`（设备命令行窗口）/ `screen`（整屏），窗口 DC 位图 | 74 ms / 0.7–4.6 s |
| `ensp_cli` | telnet 下发 VRP 命令，自动处理分屏、提示符、AAA 登录、`save` 确认；可选把同样命令用**真实键盘**回显到设备窗口并截图 | 60 ms（+截图 3 s） |
| `ensp_topo` | 纯文件操作：列设备、改设备名、改 PC/Server IP、重排控制台端口（永不原地改源文件） | 1–5 ms |
| `ensp_doc` | 从截图清单一次生成两份 docx：说明版（每图一句话 + 账号表）、纯截图版 | 1–1.5 s |

另外注册了一个技能 `ensp-automation`（`skills/ensp-automation/SKILL.md`），把实测坐标、端口、四层验证流程、错误目录喂给模型——不用每次重新摸索。

### 分层通道：能用轻的就不用重的

```
ensp_topo（读文件） < ensp_cli（telnet） < ensp_shot（窗口 DC） < ensp_gui（消息投递） < ensp_gui（真实点击）
     1 ms              60 ms/条             74 ms            ~20 ms/步            ~50 ms/步 + 抢前台
```

模型被要求在不需要界面的时候**绝不碰界面**。

---

## 几个被真机教出来的设计

- **点击守卫**：真实点击必须带 `expect`（`"ensp"` / 窗口标题 / 句柄）。用户很可能开着别的全屏窗口把 eNSP 盖住，裸点击会打到别人的窗口里。带 `expect` 时桥会先"置顶→取消置顶"把 eNSP 抬到最上层，再确认该坐标真的属于 eNSP 才按下，否则**拒绝点击**并报错。
- **激活链**：`SwitchToThisWindow` → `SetForegroundWindow` → 置顶抬升 → 真实点击标题栏，任一步成功即止，并用 `GetForegroundWindow` 复核。发按键前必须激活成功，否则 `safetype` 直接拒绝，而不是把命令打进用户正在用的窗口。
- **设备窗口只能"双击图标"打开**：eNSP 会在 0.2–0.7 s 内把外部 `ShowWindow` 显示出来的设备窗口重新隐藏，唯一可靠路径是模拟人类双击画布图标（图标坐标 = `.topo` 的 `cx/cy` + 画布偏移，偏移由隐藏 `Edit` 标签锚点与 `edit_left/edit_top` 实时匹配算出）。
- **`save` 自动落盘**：本批命令里只要有一条不是 `display/ping/tracert/dir` 这类只读命令，`ensp_cli` 就会自动 `return` → `save` → 答 `[Y/N]`，结果放进返回值的 `saved.ok`，实验不会"重开就没了"。
- **启动/停止自己等结果**：点完工具栏会轮询各设备的 `com_port` 直到所有控制台端口开放（或超时），模型不用 sleep 猜时间。
- **不改宿主、不注入进程**：所有 win32 调用集中在 `lib/bridge.py` 一个文件里，通过临时文件（job 模式）或本机 TCP（serve 模式）通信。

---

## 遮挡、前台与最小化：什么时候必须置顶

用户最在意的体验是"别在我屏幕前面乱弹窗口"。先看清每条通道对窗口状态的敏感度（实测）：

| 动作 | 被别的窗口**盖住** | 窗口**最小化 / 隐藏** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 窗口 DC 截图（`ensp_shot`） | ✅ 正常，不需要置顶也不需要焦点 | ❌ 黑图或**旧画面**（看起来成功，内容却是几分钟前的） |
| 消息投递点击 `postclick` | ✅ 生效（不走桌面合成） | ⚠️ 发得进去，控件未必处理 |
| 真实点击 `click`（SendInput） | ❌ 落到最上层窗口上 → 必须带 `expect`，桥会先抬升再校验归属 | ❌ 无效 |
| 真实键盘 `safetype` / `key` | ❌ 按键进前台程序 → 必须先激活 | ❌ 拒绝执行 |
| telnet `ensp_cli` | ✅ 与窗口状态完全无关 | ✅ 与窗口状态完全无关 |

由此定下默认策略：**telnet 下发、主窗口截图、`.topo` 读写全部在后台完成**，不激活、不前置窗口；只有"截设备命令行窗口"和"点非客户区（工具栏/菜单）"才把 eNSP 拉到前台，做完立刻用 `close_console` 收掉窗口。

> 最小化是个隐蔽的坑：最小化窗口的 `rect` 是 `-32000` 的废值、客户区 0×0，算出来的图标坐标全在屏幕外（症状：7 个偏移位置都点不中，报"面板可能不在可见画布内"）。插件现在会自动 `SW_RESTORE` 还原主窗口或控制台窗口再操作，代价是那一次动作必定占前台。

---

## UAC：会弹几次授权框

提权桥靠 `ShellExecuteW(None, "runas", pythonw.exe, …)` 启动，**这是唯一主动提权的地方**。弹框次数 = 提权 job 数：

| 工具调用 | 需要的 job 数 |
| --- | --- |
| `ensp_cli`（纯 telnet，含自动 `save`） | **0** |
| `ensp_topo` / `ensp_doc` | **0** |
| `ensp_status` / `ensp_shot target=main` | 1 |
| `ensp_gui` 一批 | 1，另外每个 `open_console` 各 +1 |
| `ensp_shot target=device`，控制台已开 | 2 |
| `ensp_shot target=device`，控制台没开（冷） | 7 |
| `ensp_cli` + `echo_to_window` 截图 | 2 |

所以在 **UAC 默认 + DSH 非提权** 的机器上，一场完整实验会弹 20–60 次授权框（而且 UAC 弹在安全桌面上，自动化点不到它）。三种解法：

| 做法 | 弹框次数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **以管理员身份运行 DSH** | **0** | `runas` 变成继承权限，最省事 |
| `mode: "serve"` | **1** | 常驻提权侧车，整个会话只弹一次，之后走本机 TCP 复用 |
| UAC 改"从不通知" | 0 | 降低整机安全，不建议给别人配 |

自检：`ensp_status.bridge.elevated` 必须是 `true`，`bridge.transport` 会告诉你当前是 `job` 还是 `serve`。提权失败（例如用户在授权框上点了取消）时 `ShellExecuteW` 返回 **1223**，工具会把原因写进 `notes`。

---

## 配置项

在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config` 里覆盖（全部有默认值）：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enspExecutable` | `C:/Program Files/Huawei/eNSP/eNSP_Client.exe` | 没有运行实例时用来拉起 |
| `pythonExecutable` / `pythonCandidates` | 自动探测 | 提权桥用的 Python |
| `docsPythonExecutable` | DSH 自带 Python | 生成 docx 用的 Python |
| `mode` | `job` | `job`＝每次动作起一个提权进程（最快最干净）；`serve`＝常驻侧车（UAC 受限机器用） |
| `timeoutMs` | `180000` | 单批 GUI 动作超时 |
| `restrictToWorkspace` | `true` | 只允许读写会话工作区内的文件 |
| `toolbarStart` / `toolbarStop` | `[659,56]` / `[698,56]` | 工具栏按钮相对主窗口左上角的位置（换分辨率/缩放要重测）⚠ |
| `iconHalfSize` | `[32,28]` | 设备图标中心相对 `.topo` `cx,cy` 的偏移 ⚠ |
| `injectPrompt` / `registerSkill` / `textTakeoverNotice` | `true` | 是否注入系统提示 / 注册技能 / 点击前提醒接管鼠标 |

---

## 目录结构

```
index.js                  插件入口：6 个工具、1 个技能、1 段系统提示
cordis.patch.yml          bundle 清单（DSH 按它加载）
lib/bridge.py             提权 GUI 桥（唯一的 win32 调用方，约 1200 行）
lib/launch.py             ShellExecuteW("runas") 拉起 bridge.py
lib/bridge-client.js      桥的客户端：探测 Python、临时文件 / TCP 通信、超时
lib/cli.js                telnet 会话：提示符、分屏、AAA 登录、save 确认
lib/topo.js               .topo 解析/改写、改名建议
lib/make_docs.py          两份 docx 的排版（python-docx）
skills/ensp-automation/   实测操作手册（模型读的 SKILL.md）
locale/{zh,en}.json       插件显示名
```

---

## 已知边界

- **坐标与窗口边框、DPI 缩放强相关**。本机是 100% 缩放、客户区 1440×810；换机器第一次用 `ensp_status` 对一遍，必要时改 `toolbarStart` / `iconHalfSize`。
- **不要给 eNSP 的自绘状态栏发 `SB_GETPARTS` 之类的 WM_USER 消息**——客户端会直接崩溃。要判断选中数量就截图。
- **拓扑别手搓**：手工拼出来的最小 `.topo` 打开是空白画布（缺 `shapes`/`txttips`）。加设备、连线交给 GUI。
- **复制拓扑文件夹后个别拓扑会崩**（设备多、含 S5700 的尤其明显），先试再批量。
- **USG6000V 防火墙可能起不来**：控制台只回 `##` 之类的垃圾，或端口始终不开放。工具会把它报进 `notes` 并继续其余部分。
- **丢配置**：`stop_all`、重启设备、关拓扑都会让 RAM 里没 `save` 的改动全部丢失。插件默认自动保存，除非显式传 `save: false`。
- 只支持 Windows；只接管 eNSP，不碰其它程序。

---

## 开发与调试

插件运行时的两个依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`、`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 由宿主提供。要脱离宿主单测工具定义：

```js
import { apply, Config } from './index.js'

const registered = []
apply({
  tools: { register: (tool) => registered.push(tool) },
  skills: { register: () => {} },
  systemPrompt: { section: () => {} },
}, Config({}))

const exec = { agent: { session: { header: { cwd: process.cwd() } } } }
const status = await registered.find((t) => t.name === 'ensp_status').execute({}, exec)
```

GUI 桥可以单独驱动，便于调试坐标：

```powershell
python lib\launch.py --job job.json     # 用 runas 起一个提权进程，跑 job.json 里的步骤
```

工具返回值必须能无损 JSON 化（DSH 会校验），插件内部用 `lossless()` 统一处理 `undefined` / `NaN` / 非普通对象。

---

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © YunoSeng
